<file path="lib/core/services/device_contact_service.dart">
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_contacts/flutter_contacts.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';

class DeviceContactService {
  /// Saves an owner's name and phone number to the native device contacts.
  /// Handles platform check and contacts runtime permissions.
  static Future<bool> saveOwnerToContacts({
    required String name,
    required String phone,
    bool showFeedback = true,
  }) async {
    // Only supported on mobile devices (Android / iOS)
    if (kIsWeb || (!Platform.isAndroid && !Platform.isIOS)) {
      if (showFeedback) {
        Get.snackbar(
          'غير مدعوم',
          'ميزة حفظ جهات الاتصال متاحة على أجهزة الهاتف المحمول فقط',
          snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100,
          colorText: Colors.amber.shade900,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline, color: Colors.amber),
        );
      }
      return false;
    }

    try {
      // Request permission using flutter_contacts
      bool permissionGranted = await FlutterContacts.requestPermission(readonly: false);

      if (!permissionGranted) {
        // Fallback check with permission_handler
        final status = await Permission.contacts.request();
        permissionGranted = status.isGranted;
      }

      if (!permissionGranted) {
        if (showFeedback) {
          Get.snackbar(
            'الإذن مطلوب',
            'يرجى منح إذن الوصول لجهات الاتصال لحفظ بيانات المربي في هاتفك',
            snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange.shade100,
            colorText: Colors.orange.shade900,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.contact_phone_outlined, color: Colors.orange),
            mainButton: TextButton(
              onPressed: () => openAppSettings(),
              child: const Text('الإعدادات', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ),
          );
        }
        return false;
      }

      // Check if contact already exists with this phone number to avoid duplicates
      try {
        final existingContacts = await FlutterContacts.getContacts(
          withProperties: true,
          sorted: false,
        );
        final cleanPhone = phone.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9+]'), '');
        final alreadyExists = existingContacts.any((c) =>
            c.phones.any((p) => p.number.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9+]'), '') == cleanPhone));

        if (alreadyExists) {
          if (showFeedback) {
            Get.snackbar(
              'جهة الاتصال موجودة بالفعل',
              'الرقم $phone مسجل مسبقاً في جهات اتصال هاتفك',
              snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
              backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade100,
              colorText: Colors.blue.shade900,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline, color: Colors.blue),
            );
          }
          return true;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // If checking existing contacts fails, proceed with insertion
      }

      // Create new contact
      final newContact = Contact()
        ..name.first = name.trim()
        ..phones = [Phone(phone.trim(), label: PhoneLabel.mobile)];

      await newContact.insert();

      if (showFeedback) {
        Get.snackbar(
          'تم الحفظ في الهاتف',
          'تم حفظ "$name" بنجاح في جهات اتصال هاتفك 📱',
          snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
          backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
          colorText: Colors.green.shade900,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error saving contact: $e');
      if (showFeedback) {
        Get.snackbar(
          'خطأ في الحفظ',
          'تعذر حفظ جهة الاتصال: ${e.toString()}',
          snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
          backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100,
          colorText: Colors.red.shade900,
        );
      }
      return false;
    }
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/utils/arabic_date_helper.dart">
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

enum ExpiryStatus {
  expired,
  nearExpiry, // < 30 days
  valid,
}

class ArabicDateHelper {
  ArabicDateHelper._();

  static final DateFormat _isoDateFormat = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
  static final DateFormat _arabicReadableFormat = DateFormat('yyyy/MM/dd', 'ar');
  static final DateFormat _timeFormat = DateFormat('hh:mm a', 'ar');

  static String formatIso(DateTime date) => _isoDateFormat.format(date);

  static String formatReadable(DateTime date) {
    try {
      return _arabicReadableFormat.format(date);
    } catch (_) {
      return '${date.year}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    }
  }

  static String formatTime(DateTime dateTime) {
    try {
      return _timeFormat.format(dateTime);
    } catch (_) {
      return '${dateTime.hour}:${dateTime.minute}';
    }
  }

  static DateTime? parseDate(String? dateStr) {
    if (dateStr == null || dateStr.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    try {
      return DateTime.parse(dateStr);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Calculates expiration status of a medicine or batch
  static ExpiryStatus checkExpiryStatus(DateTime expiryDate) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final target = DateTime(expiryDate.year, expiryDate.month, expiryDate.day);

    if (target.isBefore(today)) {
      return ExpiryStatus.expired;
    }

    final diffDays = target.difference(today).inDays;
    if (diffDays <= 30) {
      return ExpiryStatus.nearExpiry;
    }

    return ExpiryStatus.valid;
  }

  /// Returns remaining days or passed days
  static int daysDifference(DateTime targetDate) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final target = DateTime(targetDate.year, targetDate.month, targetDate.day);
    return target.difference(today).inDays;
  }

  /// Formats appointment / follow-up timing relative label
  static String getRelativeDayLabel(DateTime targetDate) {
    final diff = daysDifference(targetDate);
    if (diff < 0) {
      return 'متأخرة منذ ${diff.abs()} يوم';
    } else if (diff == 0) {
      return 'اليوم';
    } else if (diff == 1) {
      return 'غداً';
    } else if (diff == 2) {
      return 'بعد يومين';
    } else {
      return 'بعد $diff أيام';
    }
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/utils/dosage_calculator.dart">
/// Veterinary Dosage Calculator
/// Formula: Calculated Dose (ml or tablets) = (Pet Weight in kg × Dose Rate in mg/kg) / Concentration (mg/ml or mg/tablet)
class DosageCalculator {
  DosageCalculator._();

  /// Calculates required dose volume or units
  /// Returns null if inputs are invalid or zero/negative
  static double? calculateDose({
    required double weightKg,
    required double doseRateMgPerKg,
    required double concentrationMgPerUnit,
  }) {
    if (weightKg <= 0 || doseRateMgPerKg <= 0 || concentrationMgPerUnit <= 0) {
      return null;
    }
    final totalMgRequired = weightKg * doseRateMgPerKg;
    final doseUnits = totalMgRequired / concentrationMgPerUnit;
    return double.parse(doseUnits.toStringAsFixed(2));
  }

  /// Format friendly description for medical notes or prescription
  static String formatCalculationSummary({
    required double weightKg,
    required double doseRateMgPerKg,
    required double concentrationMgPerUnit,
    required String unitName, // e.g. "مل" or "قرص"
  }) {
    final result = calculateDose(
      weightKg: weightKg,
      doseRateMgPerKg: doseRateMgPerKg,
      concentrationMgPerUnit: concentrationMgPerUnit,
    );
    if (result == null) return '';
    final totalMg = (weightKg * doseRateMgPerKg).toStringAsFixed(1);
    return '$result $unitName (الجرعة الإجمالية: $totalMg مجم بوزن $weightKg كجم)';
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/utils/yemeni_phone_validator.dart">
/// Shared validator and formatter for Yemeni Mobile Phone Numbers (+967).
class YemeniPhoneValidator {
  YemeniPhoneValidator._();

  /// Supported Yemeni Mobile Network Operators:
  /// - 77: Yemen Mobile (CDMA / VoLTE)
  /// - 78: Yemen Mobile (4G LTE)
  /// - 73: YOU (formerly MTN Yemen)
  /// - 71: SabaFon
  /// - 70: Y Telecom
  static const List<String> validPrefixes = ['77', '78', '73', '71', '70'];

  /// Fixed Country Code
  static const String countryCode = '+967';

  /// Extracts the 9 local subscriber digits from any input variation
  /// (e.g. "+967771234567", "00967771234567", "0771234567", "771234567").
  static String cleanDigits(String? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return '';
    var cleaned = raw.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');

    if (cleaned.startsWith('00967')) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(5);
    } else if (cleaned.startsWith('967')) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(3);
    }

    if (cleaned.startsWith('0') && cleaned.length > 9) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(1);
    }

    return cleaned;
  }

  /// Form field validator for Yemeni phone numbers.
  static String? validate(String? value, {bool isRequired = true}) {
    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
      return isRequired ? 'رقم الهاتف مطلوب' : null;
    }

    final digits = cleanDigits(value);

    if (digits.isEmpty) {
      return isRequired ? 'رقم الهاتف مطلوب' : null;
    }

    if (digits.length != 9) {
      return 'رقم الهاتف اليمني يجب أن يتكون من 9 أرقام بالضبط';
    }

    final prefix = digits.substring(0, 2);
    if (!validPrefixes.contains(prefix)) {
      return 'يجب أن يبدأ الرقم برمز شبكة يمنية معتمد (77، 78، 73، 71، 70)';
    }

    return null;
  }

  /// Checks if the input is a valid Yemeni phone number.
  static bool isValid(String? value, {bool isRequired = true}) {
    return validate(value, isRequired: isRequired) == null;
  }

  /// Standardizes the number to international format: +967XXXXXXXXX
  static String formatWithCountryCode(String raw) {
    final digits = cleanDigits(raw);
    if (digits.length == 9) {
      return '$countryCode$digits';
    }
    final trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith(countryCode)) return trimmed;
    return '$countryCode$trimmed';
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/widgets/primary_button.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';

class PrimaryButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final String text;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final bool isLoading;
  final IconData? icon;
  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final Color? textColor;
  final double? width;
  final double height;
  final bool isOutlined;

  const PrimaryButton({
    super.key,
    required this.text,
    this.onPressed,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.icon,
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.textColor,
    this.width,
    this.height = 48,
    this.isOutlined = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final effectiveBg = backgroundColor ?? AppColors.primary;
    final effectiveText = textColor ?? (isOutlined ? AppColors.primary : Colors.white);

    return SizedBox(
      width: width ?? double.infinity,
      height: height,
      child: isOutlined
          ? OutlinedButton(
              onPressed: isLoading ? null : onPressed,
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                side: BorderSide(color: effectiveBg, width: 1.5),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              ),
              child: _buildChild(effectiveText),
            )
          : ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: isLoading ? null : onPressed,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: effectiveBg,
                foregroundColor: effectiveText,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              ),
              child: _buildChild(effectiveText),
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildChild(Color color) {
    if (isLoading) {
      return SizedBox(
        height: 20,
        width: 20,
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
          strokeWidth: 2,
          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (icon != null) {
      return Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Text(
            text,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: color,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    return Text(
      text,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        color: color,
      ),
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/widgets/status_chip.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';

enum ChipStatusType {
  critical,
  warning,
  success,
  info,
  neutral,
}

class StatusChip extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final ChipStatusType type;
  final IconData? icon;
  final double fontSize;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  const StatusChip({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    this.type = ChipStatusType.neutral,
    this.icon,
    this.fontSize = 11,
    this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Color bg;
    Color fg;

    switch (type) {
      case ChipStatusType.critical:
        bg = AppColors.criticalBackground;
        fg = AppColors.critical;
        break;
      case ChipStatusType.warning:
        bg = AppColors.warningBackground;
        fg = AppColors.warning;
        break;
      case ChipStatusType.success:
        bg = AppColors.successBackground;
        fg = AppColors.success;
        break;
      case ChipStatusType.info:
        bg = AppColors.infoBackground;
        fg = AppColors.info;
        break;
      case ChipStatusType.neutral:
        bg = AppColors.border.withValues(alpha: 0.5);
        fg = AppColors.textSecondary;
        break;
    }

    final content = Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
        border: Border.all(color: fg.withValues(alpha: 0.2), width: 1),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            Icon(icon, size: fontSize + 2, color: fg),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
          ],
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: fontSize,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: fg,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (onTap != null) {
      return InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
        child: content,
      );
    }
    return content;
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/models/backup_log_model.dart">
class BackupLogModel {
  final int? id;
  final String backupName;
  final String filePath;
  final int sizeBytes;
  final String backupType; // 'internal', 'external', 'manual', 'scheduled'
  final String? destination;
  final String status; // 'success', 'failed'
  final String? errorMessage;
  final String createdAt;

  BackupLogModel({
    this.id,
    required this.backupName,
    required this.filePath,
    this.sizeBytes = 0,
    this.backupType = 'internal',
    this.destination,
    this.status = 'success',
    this.errorMessage,
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  factory BackupLogModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return BackupLogModel(
      id: map['id'] as int?,
      backupName: map['backup_name'] as String? ?? '',
      filePath: map['file_path'] as String? ?? '',
      sizeBytes: map['size_bytes'] as int? ?? 0,
      backupType: map['backup_type'] as String? ?? 'internal',
      destination: map['destination'] as String?,
      status: map['status'] as String? ?? 'success',
      errorMessage: map['error_message'] as String?,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] as String? ?? '',
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    final map = <String, dynamic>{
      'backup_name': backupName,
      'file_path': filePath,
      'size_bytes': sizeBytes,
      'backup_type': backupType,
      'destination': destination,
      'status': status,
      'error_message': errorMessage,
      'created_at': createdAt,
    };
    if (id != null) map['id'] = id;
    return map;
  }

  String get formattedSize {
    if (sizeBytes < 1024) return '$sizeBytes B';
    if (sizeBytes < 1024 * 1024) return '${(sizeBytes / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB';
    return '${(sizeBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(2)} MB';
  }

  String get typeDisplayArabic {
    switch (backupType) {
      case 'internal':
        return 'نسخ داخلي';
      case 'external':
        return 'نسخ خارجي (فلاش / مجلد)';
      case 'cloud':
        return 'نسخ سحابي';
      case 'scheduled':
        return 'نسخ دوري مجدول';
      default:
        return 'نسخ احتياطي';
    }
  }

  bool get isSuccess => status == 'success';
}

class ExpenseModel {

    this.id,

    required this.category,
    required this.amount,
    required this.expenseDate,
    this.notes,
    this.createdAt,
  });

  factory ExpenseModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return ExpenseModel(
      id: map['id'] as int?,
      title: map['title'] as String? ?? '',
      category: map['category'] as String? ?? 'operating',
      amount: (map['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      expenseDate: map['expense_date'] as String? ?? '',
      notes: map['notes'] as String?,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] as String?,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    final map = <String, dynamic>{
      'title': title,
      'category': category,
      'amount': amount,
      'expense_date': expenseDate,
      'notes': notes,
    };
    if (id != null) {
      map['id'] = id;
    }
    if (createdAt != null) {
      map['created_at'] = createdAt;
    }
    return map;
  }

  String get categoryDisplayArabic {
    switch (category) {
      case 'operating':
        return 'مصاريف تشغيلية (كهرباء/طاقة)';
      case 'medical_supplies':
        return 'مستلزمات طبية وتخدير';
      case 'medicines':
        return 'مشتريات أدوية ومخزون';
      case 'rent':
        return 'إيجار مقر العيادة';
      case 'salaries':
        return 'رواتب ومكافآت';
      case 'maintenance':
        return 'صيانة أجهزة ومعدات';
      default:
        return 'مصاريف متنوعة';
    }
  }

class MedicineModel {
  final int? id;
  final String tradeName;
  final String? scientificName;
  final String form;
  final String? concentration;
  final int clinicStock;
  final int warehouseStock;
  final int minStockAlert;
  final double unitCostPrice;
  final double unitSalePrice;
  final String expiryDate;
  final String? batchNumber;
  final String? createdAt;

  MedicineModel({
    this.id,
    required this.tradeName,
    this.scientificName,
    required this.form,
    this.concentration,
    this.clinicStock = 0,
    this.warehouseStock = 0,
    this.minStockAlert = 5,
    this.unitCostPrice = 0.0,
    this.unitSalePrice = 0.0,
    required this.expiryDate,
    this.batchNumber,
    this.createdAt,
  });

  factory MedicineModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return MedicineModel(
      id: map['id'] as int?,
      tradeName: map['trade_name'] as String? ?? '',
      scientificName: map['scientific_name'] as String?,
      form: map['form'] as String? ?? 'أقراص (Tablets)',
      concentration: map['concentration'] as String?,
      clinicStock: map['clinic_stock'] as int? ?? 0,
      warehouseStock: map['warehouse_stock'] as int? ?? 0,
      minStockAlert: map['min_stock_alert'] as int? ?? 5,
      unitCostPrice: (map['unit_cost_price'] as num? ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
      unitSalePrice: (map['unit_sale_price'] as num? ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
      expiryDate: map['expiry_date'] as String? ?? '',
      batchNumber: map['batch_number'] as String?,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] as String?,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      if (id != null) 'id': id,
      'trade_name': tradeName,
      'scientific_name': scientificName,
      'form': form,
      'concentration': concentration,
      'clinic_stock': clinicStock,
      'warehouse_stock': warehouseStock,
      'min_stock_alert': minStockAlert,
      'unit_cost_price': unitCostPrice,
      'unit_sale_price': unitSalePrice,
      'expiry_date': expiryDate,
      'batch_number': batchNumber,
    };
  }

  int get totalStock => clinicStock + warehouseStock;

  bool get isLowStock => clinicStock <= minStockAlert;

  ExpiryStatus get expiryStatus {
    final parsed = ArabicDateHelper.parseDate(expiryDate);
    if (parsed == null) return ExpiryStatus.valid;
    return ArabicDateHelper.checkExpiryStatus(parsed);
  }

  bool get isExpired => expiryStatus == ExpiryStatus.expired;
  bool get isNearExpiry => expiryStatus == ExpiryStatus.nearExpiry;

  MedicineModel copyWith({
    int? id,
    String? tradeName,
    String? scientificName,
    String? form,
    String? concentration,
    int? clinicStock,
    int? warehouseStock,
    int? minStockAlert,
    double? unitCostPrice,
    double? unitSalePrice,
    String? expiryDate,
    String? batchNumber,
    String? createdAt,
  }) {
    return MedicineModel(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      tradeName: tradeName ?? this.tradeName,
      scientificName: scientificName ?? this.scientificName,
      form: form ?? this.form,
      concentration: concentration ?? this.concentration,
      clinicStock: clinicStock ?? this.clinicStock,
      warehouseStock: warehouseStock ?? this.warehouseStock,
      minStockAlert: minStockAlert ?? this.minStockAlert,
      unitCostPrice: unitCostPrice ?? this.unitCostPrice,
      unitSalePrice: unitSalePrice ?? this.unitSalePrice,
      expiryDate: expiryDate ?? this.expiryDate,
      batchNumber: batchNumber ?? this.batchNumber,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/repositories/backup_repository.dart">
import '../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../database/database_tables.dart';
import '../models/backup_log_model.dart';

class BackupRepository {
  final DatabaseHelper _dbHelper = DatabaseHelper.instance;

  /// Inserts a new backup/restore audit log
  Future<int> insertBackupLog(BackupLogModel log) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.insert(DatabaseTables.tableBackupLogs, log.toMap());
    DataSyncService.notifyAllChanged();
    return res;
  }

  /// Retrieves audit logs ordered by newest first
  Future<List<BackupLogModel>> getBackupLogs({int limit = 100}) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final rows = await db.query(
      DatabaseTables.tableBackupLogs,
      orderBy: 'created_at DESC, id DESC',
      limit: limit,
    );
    return rows.map((r) => BackupLogModel.fromMap(r)).toList();
  }

  /// Retrieves the latest backup log record
  Future<BackupLogModel?> getLatestBackupLog() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final rows = await db.query(
      DatabaseTables.tableBackupLogs,
      orderBy: 'created_at DESC, id DESC',
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.isNotEmpty) {
      return BackupLogModel.fromMap(rows.first);
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Deletes a specific backup log by id
  Future<int> deleteBackupLog(int id) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.delete(
      DatabaseTables.tableBackupLogs,
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyAllChanged();
    return res;
  }

  /// Clears all audit logs
  Future<int> clearAllLogs() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.delete(DatabaseTables.tableBackupLogs);
    DataSyncService.notifyAllChanged();
    return res;
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/repositories/reports_repository.dart">
import '../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../database/database_tables.dart';

class ReportsRepository {
  final DatabaseHelper _dbHelper = DatabaseHelper.instance;

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getConsultationsSummary(String startStr, String endStr) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(visit_cost), 0) as revenue
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations}
      WHERE substr(visit_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(visit_date, 1, 10) <= ?
    ''', [startStr, endStr]);
    return res.isNotEmpty ? res.first : {'count': 0, 'revenue': 0.0};
  }

  Future<int> getNewPatientsCount(String startStr, String endStr) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT COUNT(*) as count
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tablePets}
      WHERE substr(created_at, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(created_at, 1, 10) <= ?
    ''', [startStr, endStr]);
    return res.isNotEmpty ? (res.first['count'] as int? ?? 0) : 0;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getSurgeriesSummary(String startStr, String endStr) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_cost), 0) as surgery_rev
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableSurgeries}
      WHERE substr(scheduled_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(scheduled_date, 1, 10) <= ?
    ''', [startStr, endStr]);
    return res.isNotEmpty ? res.first : {'count': 0, 'surgery_rev': 0.0};
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getTopDiagnoses(String startStr, String endStr, {int limit = 5}) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    return await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT diagnosis, COUNT(*) as count
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations}
      WHERE substr(visit_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(visit_date, 1, 10) <= ?
      GROUP BY diagnosis
      ORDER BY count DESC
      LIMIT ?
    ''', [startStr, endStr, limit]);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getTopClinicMedicines(String startStr, String endStr, {int limit = 5}) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    return await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT 
        COALESCE(m.trade_name, pr.custom_name, 'إبرة/علاج') as med_name,
        SUM(pr.quantity_dispensed) as total_qty
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tablePrescriptions} pr
      LEFT JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableMedicines} m ON pr.medicine_id = m.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} c ON pr.consultation_id = c.id
      WHERE pr.is_clinic_administered = 1
        AND substr(c.visit_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(c.visit_date, 1, 10) <= ?
      GROUP BY med_name
      ORDER BY total_qty DESC
      LIMIT ?
    ''', [startStr, endStr, limit]);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getSpeciesBreakdown(String startStr, String endStr) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    return await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT p.species, COUNT(*) as count
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} c
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON c.pet_id = p.id
      WHERE substr(c.visit_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(c.visit_date, 1, 10) <= ?
      GROUP BY p.species
      ORDER BY count DESC
    ''', [startStr, endStr]);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getDailyActivity(String startStr, String endStr) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    return await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT 
        substr(visit_date, 1, 10) as day_date, 
        COUNT(*) as visits_count,
        SUM(visit_cost) as day_revenue
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations}
      WHERE substr(visit_date, 1, 10) >= ? AND substr(visit_date, 1, 10) <= ?
      GROUP BY day_date
      ORDER BY day_date ASC
    ''', [startStr, endStr]);
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/consultations/controllers/prescription_preview_controller.dart">
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show debugPrint;
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';
import '../utils/prescription_pdf_helper.dart';
import 'consultation_controller.dart';
import 'new_consultation_controller.dart';

class PrescriptionPreviewController extends GetxController {
  final SurgeryRepository surgeryRepo;
  final AppointmentRepository appointmentRepo;
  final ConsultationRepository consultationRepo;
  final PetRepository petRepo;

  PrescriptionPreviewController({
    SurgeryRepository? surgeryRepo,
    AppointmentRepository? appointmentRepo,
    ConsultationRepository? consultationRepo,
    PetRepository? petRepo,
  })  : surgeryRepo = surgeryRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryRepository>()
                ? Get.find<SurgeryRepository>()
                : Get.put(SurgeryRepository(), permanent: true)),
        appointmentRepo = appointmentRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<AppointmentRepository>()
                ? Get.find<AppointmentRepository>()
                : Get.put(AppointmentRepository(), permanent: true)),
        consultationRepo = consultationRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationRepository>()
                ? Get.find<ConsultationRepository>()
                : Get.put(ConsultationRepository(), permanent: true)),
        petRepo = petRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<PetRepository>()
                ? Get.find<PetRepository>()
                : Get.put(PetRepository(), permanent: true));

  final Rxn<ConsultationModel> consultation = Rxn<ConsultationModel>();
  final RxBool showCost = true.obs;
  final Rxn<SurgeryModel> scheduledSurgery = Rxn<SurgeryModel>();
  final RxList<FollowUpModel> followUpSessions = <FollowUpModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoading = true.obs;
  final RxInt selectedTabIndex = 0.obs;

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadReportData();
  }

  Future<void> loadReportData() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final args = Get.arguments;

      bool initialShowCost = true;
      if (Get.isRegistered<NewConsultationController>()) {
        initialShowCost = Get.find<NewConsultationController>().showCostInPrescription.value;
      } else if (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationController>()) {
        initialShowCost = Get.find<ConsultationController>().showCostInPrescription.value;
      }

      if (args is Map) {
        if (args['consultation'] is ConsultationModel) {
          consultation.value = args['consultation'] as ConsultationModel;
        }
        if (args['showCost'] is bool) {
          initialShowCost = args['showCost'] as bool;
        }
        if (args['scheduledSurgery'] is SurgeryModel) {
          scheduledSurgery.value = args['scheduledSurgery'] as SurgeryModel;
        }
        if (args['followUpSessions'] is List<FollowUpModel>) {
          followUpSessions.assignAll(args['followUpSessions'] as List<FollowUpModel>);
        }
      } else if (args is ConsultationModel) {
        consultation.value = args;
      } else if (Get.isRegistered<NewConsultationController>() &&
          Get.find<NewConsultationController>().lastCreatedConsultation.value != null) {
        consultation.value = Get.find<NewConsultationController>().lastCreatedConsultation.value;
      } else if (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationController>() &&
          Get.find<ConsultationController>().lastCreatedConsultation.value != null) {
        consultation.value = Get.find<ConsultationController>().lastCreatedConsultation.value;
      }

      showCost.value = initialShowCost;

      final c = consultation.value;
      if (c != null && c.petId > 0) {
        // Query linked surgery if not passed in arguments
        if (scheduledSurgery.value == null) {
          final surgeries = await surgeryRepo.getSurgeriesForPet(c.petId);
          final datePrefix = c.visitDate.length >= 10 ? c.visitDate.substring(0, 10) : c.visitDate;
          final matched = surgeries.where((s) => s.scheduledDate.contains(datePrefix)).toList();
          if (matched.isNotEmpty) {
            scheduledSurgery.value = matched.first;
          } else {
            scheduledSurgery.value = surgeries.firstWhereOrNull((s) => s.status == 'scheduled');
          }
        }

        // Query linked follow-ups if not passed in arguments
        if (followUpSessions.isEmpty && c.id != null) {
          final followUps = await appointmentRepo.getFollowUpsForPet(c.petId);
          final matchedFollowUps = followUps.where((f) => f.consultationId != null && f.consultationId == c.id).toList();
          if (matchedFollowUps.isNotEmpty) {
            followUpSessions.assignAll(matchedFollowUps);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading prescription report data: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void toggleShowCost(bool val) {
    showCost.value = val;
    if (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationController>()) {
      Get.find<ConsultationController>().showCostInPrescription.value = val;
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<NewConsultationController>()) {
      Get.find<NewConsultationController>().showCostInPrescription.value = val;
    }
  }

  void setTabIndex(int idx) {
    selectedTabIndex.value = idx;
  }

  Future<Uint8List> getPdfBytes(ClinicModel? clinic) {
    final c = consultation.value;
    if (c == null) return Future.value(Uint8List(0));
    return PrescriptionPdfHelper.generatePrescriptionPdf(
      consultation: c,
      clinic: clinic,
      showCost: showCost.value,
      scheduledSurgery: scheduledSurgery.value,
      followUpSessions: followUpSessions.toList(),
    );
  }

  Future<void> sharePdf(ClinicModel? clinic) async {
    final c = consultation.value;
    if (c == null) return;
    await PrescriptionPdfHelper.sharePdfFile(
      consultation: c,
      clinic: clinic,
      showCost: showCost.value,
      scheduledSurgery: scheduledSurgery.value,
      followUpSessions: followUpSessions.toList(),
    );
  }

  Future<void> shareWhatsApp(ClinicModel? clinic) async {
    final c = consultation.value;
    if (c == null) return;
    await PrescriptionPdfHelper.shareOnWhatsApp(
      consultation: c,
      clinic: clinic,
      showCost: showCost.value,
      scheduledSurgery: scheduledSurgery.value,
      followUpSessions: followUpSessions.toList(),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show debugPrint;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';

class PrescriptionPdfHelper {
  PrescriptionPdfHelper._();

  static Future<Uint8List> generatePrescriptionPdf({
    required ConsultationModel consultation,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    bool showCost = true,
    SurgeryModel? scheduledSurgery,
    List<FollowUpModel> followUpSessions = const [],
  }) async {
    final pdf = pw.Document();

    pw.Font arabicFont;
    pw.Font arabicBold;

    try {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    } catch (_) {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    }

    final clinicRx = consultation.prescriptions.where((p) => p.isClinicAdministered).toList();
    final homeRx = consultation.prescriptions.where((p) => !p.isClinicAdministered).toList();

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
        theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(base: arabicFont, bold: arabicBold),
        build: (pw.Context context) {
          return [
            pw.Directionality(
              textDirection: pw.TextDirection.rtl,
              child: pw.Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // 1. Clinic Letterhead Header
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                      border: pw.Border(bottom: pw.BorderSide(color: PdfColors.teal700, width: 2)),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text(
                              clinic?.clinicName ?? 'عيادة بيطرية متقدمة',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 15, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text(
                              clinic?.doctorName ?? consultation.doctorName ?? 'د. بيطري',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey800),
                            ),
                            if (clinic?.licenseNumber != null && clinic!.licenseNumber!.isNotEmpty)
                              pw.Text(
                                'ترخيص: ${clinic.licenseNumber}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text(
                              'تقرير الفحص السريري والروشتة الطبية',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 13, color: PdfColors.teal700),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text(
                              'التاريخ: ${consultation.visitDate.length >= 10 ? consultation.visitDate.substring(0, 10) : consultation.visitDate}',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5),
                            ),
                            if (clinic?.phone != null && clinic!.phone!.isNotEmpty)
                              pw.Text(
                                'هاتف: ${clinic.phone}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 10),

                  // 2. Patient & Owner Info Bar
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.grey100,
                      borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Text(
                          'المريض: ${consultation.petName ?? ""} (${consultation.petSpecies ?? ""})',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 9.5),
                        ),
                        pw.Text(
                          'المالك: ${consultation.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5),
                        ),
                        if (consultation.temperature != null)
                          pw.Text(
                            'الحرارة: ${consultation.temperature}°C',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5),
                          ),
                        if (consultation.heartRate != null)
                          pw.Text(
                            'النبض: ${consultation.heartRate} bpm',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 10),

                  // 3. SOAP Clinical Assessment & Diagnosis
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.teal50,
                      borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.teal700, width: 1),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        if (consultation.symptoms != null && consultation.symptoms!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                          pw.Text(
                            'الشكوى والأعراض (S): ${consultation.symptoms}',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey800),
                          ),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                        ],
                        pw.Text(
                          'التشخيص الطبي السريري (Assessment): ${consultation.diagnosis}',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // SECTION 1: In-Clinic Procedures
                  _buildSectionHeader('1. الإجراءات والعلاجات داخل العيادة (In-Clinic Procedures)', arabicBold),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                  if (clinicRx.isEmpty)
                    _buildEmptyNotice('لا توجد علاجات أو حقن تم إعطاؤها داخل العيادة في هذه الزيارة.', arabicFont)
                  else
                    pw.Table(
                      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      // Physical columns left-to-right: Notes (0) -> Quantity (1) -> Route (2) -> Dosage (3) -> Medication (4)
                      columnWidths: {
                        0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.2),
                        1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.1),
                        2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.4),
                        3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3),
                        4: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.6),
                      },
                      children: [
                        pw.TableRow(
                          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal100),
                          children: [
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الملاحظات والإرشادات', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الكمية', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('طريقة الإعطاء', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الجرعة', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الدواء / الإجراء', arabicBold),
                          ],
                        ),
                        ...clinicRx.map((rx) {
                          return pw.TableRow(
                            children: [
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.instructions ?? '-', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell('${rx.quantityDispensed}', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.route ?? 'حقن / موضعي', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.dosage, arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(
                                '${rx.displayName} ${rx.medicineForm != null ? "(${rx.medicineForm})" : ""}',
                                arabicBold,
                              ),
                            ],
                          );
                        }),
                      ],
                    ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // SECTION 2: Home Treatment Prescription
                  _buildSectionHeader('2. روشتة العلاج المنزلي للمريض (Home Treatment Prescription)', arabicBold),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                  if (homeRx.isEmpty)
                    _buildEmptyNotice('لم يتم وصف علاجات منزلية في هذه الزيارة.', arabicFont)
                  else
                    pw.Table(
                      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      // Physical columns left-to-right: Notes (0) -> Duration (1) -> Frequency (2) -> Dosage (3) -> Medication (4)
                      columnWidths: {
                        0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.2),
                        1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.1),
                        2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.4),
                        3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3),
                        4: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.6),
                      },
                      children: [
                        pw.TableRow(
                          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal100),
                          children: [
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('تعليمات الاستخدام', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('المدة', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('التكرار', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الجرعة', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الدواء الموصوف', arabicBold),
                          ],
                        ),
                        ...homeRx.map((rx) {
                          return pw.TableRow(
                            children: [
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.instructions ?? '-', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell('لمدة ${rx.durationDays} يوم', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.frequency, arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(rx.dosage, arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(
                                '${rx.displayName} ${rx.medicineForm != null ? "(${rx.medicineForm})" : ""}',
                                arabicBold,
                              ),
                            ],
                          );
                        }),
                      ],
                    ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // SECTION 3: Surgery Appointments (if scheduled)
                  if (scheduledSurgery != null) ...[
                    _buildSectionHeader('3. مواعيد العمليات الجراحية المجدولة (Surgery Appointments)', arabicBold),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.orange50,
                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.orange200),
                      ),

                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                            mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [

                                'العملية: ${scheduledSurgery.surgeryName} (${scheduledSurgery.surgeryCategory ?? "جراحة عامة"})',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 9.5, color: PdfColors.brown900),
                              ),
                              pw.Text(
                                'الموعد: ${scheduledSurgery.scheduledDate}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.orange900),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                          pw.Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              pw.Text(
                                'الجراح المسؤول: ${scheduledSurgery.surgeonName ?? "الطبيب المعالج"}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5),

                                  'التكلفة التقديرية: ${scheduledSurgery.estimatedCost!.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}',
                                  style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (scheduledSurgery.postOpNotes != null && scheduledSurgery.postOpNotes!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                            pw.Text(
                              'تعليمات وتجهيزات ما قبل الجراحة: ${scheduledSurgery.postOpNotes}',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.grey800),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  // SECTION 4: Follow-Up Sessions (if scheduled)
                  if (followUpSessions.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    _buildSectionHeader('4. جلسات المتابعة والمراجعات القادمة (Follow-Up Sessions)', arabicBold),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Table(
                      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      // Physical columns left-to-right: Notes (0) -> Time (1) -> Date (2) -> Session/Reason (3)
                      columnWidths: {
                        0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.5),
                        1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.2),
                        2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.5),
                        3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.5),
                      },
                      children: [
                        pw.TableRow(
                          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blue50),
                          children: [
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الملاحظات والإرشادات', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الوقت المجدول', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('تاريخ المراجعة', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الجلسة / سبب المراجعة', arabicBold),
                          ],
                        ),
                        ...followUpSessions.map((f) {
                          return pw.TableRow(
                            children: [
                              _buildPdfDataCell(f.notes?.isNotEmpty == true ? f.notes! : '-', arabicFont),
                              _buildPdfDataCell(f.scheduledTime?.isNotEmpty == true ? f.scheduledTime! : 'خلال ساعات الدوام', arabicFont),

                          );
                        }),
                      ],
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  // Consultation Fees (if applicable & requested)
                  if (showCost && consultation.visitCost > 0) ...[
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(

                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.teal200),

                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 9.5, color: PdfColors.teal900),

                      ),
                      pw.Column(
                        children: [

                          pw.SizedBox(height: 18),
                          pw.Text('................................', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ];
        },
      ),
    );

    return pdf.save();
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildSectionHeader(String title, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Container(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 3),
      decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
        border: pw.Border(right: pw.BorderSide(color: PdfColors.teal700, width: 3)),
      ),
      child: pw.Text(
        title,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.teal900),
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildEmptyNotice(String text, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Container(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(6),
      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
        color: PdfColors.grey50,
        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(4),
      ),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.grey600),
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildPdfHeaderCell(String text, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.teal900),
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildPdfDataCell(String text, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 8),
      ),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> sharePdfFile({
    required ConsultationModel consultation,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    required bool showCost,
    SurgeryModel? scheduledSurgery,
    List<FollowUpModel> followUpSessions = const [],
  }) async {
    try {
      final bytes = await generatePrescriptionPdf(
        consultation: consultation,
        clinic: clinic,
        showCost: showCost,
        scheduledSurgery: scheduledSurgery,
        followUpSessions: followUpSessions,
      );
      await Printing.sharePdf(
        bytes: bytes,
        filename: 'medical_report_${consultation.petName ?? "pet"}_${consultation.id ?? 1}.pdf',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error sharing prescription PDF: $e');
    }
  }

  static Future<void> shareOnWhatsApp({
    required ConsultationModel consultation,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    required bool showCost,
    SurgeryModel? scheduledSurgery,
    List<FollowUpModel> followUpSessions = const [],
  }) async {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('🐾 *${clinic?.clinicName ?? "عيادة بيطرية"}*');
    buffer.writeln('📋 *تقرير الفحص السريري والروشتة الطبية*');
    buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('المريض: ${consultation.petName} (${consultation.petSpecies ?? "حيوان أليف"})');
    buffer.writeln('المالك: ${consultation.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}');
    buffer.writeln('التشخيص: ${consultation.diagnosis}');
    buffer.writeln('التاريخ: ${consultation.visitDate.length >= 10 ? consultation.visitDate.substring(0, 10) : consultation.visitDate}');

    final clinicRx = consultation.prescriptions.where((p) => p.isClinicAdministered).toList();
    final homeRx = consultation.prescriptions.where((p) => !p.isClinicAdministered).toList();

    if (clinicRx.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('💉 *1. الإجراءات والعلاجات داخل العيادة:*');
      for (final rx in clinicRx) {
        buffer.writeln('• *${rx.displayName}*: الجرعة: ${rx.dosage} | طريق الإعطاء: ${rx.route ?? "حقن"} | كمية: ${rx.quantityDispensed}');
        if (rx.instructions?.isNotEmpty == true) {
          buffer.writeln('  ملاحظات: ${rx.instructions}');
        }
      }
    }

    if (homeRx.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('💊 *2. روشتة العلاج المنزلي:*');
      for (final rx in homeRx) {
        buffer.writeln('• *${rx.displayName}*: ${rx.dosage} (${rx.frequency} لمدة ${rx.durationDays} يوم)');
        if (rx.instructions?.isNotEmpty == true) {
          buffer.writeln('  إرشادات: ${rx.instructions}');
        }
      }
    }

    if (scheduledSurgery != null) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('🏥 *3. العملية الجراحية المجدولة:*');
      buffer.writeln('• *${scheduledSurgery.surgeryName}* (${scheduledSurgery.surgeryCategory ?? "عام"})');
      buffer.writeln('  الموعد: ${scheduledSurgery.scheduledDate}');
      if (scheduledSurgery.postOpNotes?.isNotEmpty == true) {
        buffer.writeln('  تعليمات التحضير: ${scheduledSurgery.postOpNotes}');
      }
    }

    if (followUpSessions.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('🗓️ *4. جلسات المتابعة والمراجعة:*');
      for (final f in followUpSessions) {
        buffer.writeln('• *${f.reason}* بتاريخ: ${f.scheduledDate} ${f.scheduledTime ?? ""}');
        if (f.notes?.isNotEmpty == true) {
          buffer.writeln('  ملاحظة: ${f.notes}');
        }
      }
    }

    if (showCost && consultation.visitCost > 0) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('أتعاب الكشف والخدمات: ${consultation.visitCost.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}');
    }

    buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('مع تمنياتنا لحيوانكم الأليف بدوام الصحة والعافية.');

    final encoded = Uri.encodeComponent(buffer.toString());
    final url = Uri.parse('whatsapp://send?text=$encoded');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(url)) {
      await launchUrl(url);
    }
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/modules/consultations/widgets/patient_info_section.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../controllers/new_consultation_controller.dart';

class PatientInfoSection extends GetView<NewConsultationController> {
  const PatientInfoSection({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              'بيانات المريض البيطري',
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .titleMedium
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Obx(() {
              return DropdownButtonFormField<int?>(
                isExpanded: true,
                initialValue: controller.selectedPet.value?.id,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'اختر المريض من السجل'),
                items: controller.allPets.map((p) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem<int?>(
                    value: p.id,
                    child: Text(
                      '${p.name} (${p.species}) - المالك: ${p.ownerName ?? ""}',
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      maxLines: 1,
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
                onChanged: (id) {
                  if (id != null) {
                    final pet = controller.allPets.firstWhere((p) => p.id == id);
                    controller.selectedPet.value = pet;
                    if (pet.latestWeight != null) {
                      controller.prescriptionController.calcWeightController.text =
                          pet.latestWeight.toString();
                    }
                  }
                },
              );
            }),
            Obx(() {
              final pet = controller.selectedPet.value;
              if (pet != null && pet.hasAllergies) {
                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: AppColors.criticalBackground,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    border: Border.all(color: AppColors.critical),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.warning, color: AppColors.critical, size: 20),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'تنبيه حساسية دوائية: ${pet.allergies!}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: AppColors.critical,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize: 12,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              }
              return const SizedBox.shrink();
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/consultations/widgets/surgery_scheduling_section.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/custom_text_field.dart';
import '../controllers/new_consultation_controller.dart';

class SurgerySchedulingSection extends GetView<NewConsultationController> {
  const SurgerySchedulingSection({super.key});

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context, TextEditingController textCtrl) async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1)),
      firstDate: DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 180)),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      textCtrl.text = picked.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectTime(BuildContext context, TextEditingController textCtrl) async {
    final picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: const TimeOfDay(hour: 10, minute: 0),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      final hour = picked.hourOfPeriod == 0 ? 12 : picked.hourOfPeriod;
      final minute = picked.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
      final period = picked.period == DayPeriod.am ? 'ص' : 'م';
      textCtrl.text = '$hour:$minute $period';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Obx(
              () => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                secondary: const CircleAvatar(
                  backgroundColor: Color(0xFFFFEFEA),
                  child: Icon(Icons.healing, color: Color(0xFFE76F51)),
                ),
                title: const Text(
                  '3- حجز موعد عملية جراحية للحالة',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                subtitle: const Text(
                  'تفعيل خيار جدولة عملية جراحية بناءً على نتائج هذا الفحص',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                ),
                value: controller.needSurgery.value,
                onChanged: (v) => controller.needSurgery.value = v,
              ),
            ),
            Obx(() {
              if (!controller.needSurgery.value) return const SizedBox.shrink();

              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Divider(height: 20),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'اسم العملية الجراحية',
                    hint: 'مثال: تعقيم قطة، استئصال ورم، تنظيف جير الأسنان',
                    controller: controller.surgeryNameController,
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.healing),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'تاريخ العملية',
                          hint: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
                          controller: controller.surgeryDateController,
                          readOnly: true,
                          onTap: () => _selectDate(context, controller.surgeryDateController),
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'ساعة الحضور للجناح',
                          hint: '09:00 ص',
                          controller: controller.surgeryTimeController,
                          readOnly: true,
                          onTap: () => _selectTime(context, controller.surgeryTimeController),
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.person_pin_outlined, color: AppColors.primary, size: 20),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              'الجراح المسؤول عن العملية *',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                color: AppColors.primaryDark,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        DropdownButtonFormField<int?>(
                          isExpanded: true,
                          initialValue: controller.selectedSurgeon.value?.id,
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            hintText: 'اختر الطبيب الجراح المسؤول',
                            filled: true,
                            fillColor: Colors.white,
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
                          ),
                          items: controller.availableSurgeons.map((d) {
                            return DropdownMenuItem<int?>(
                              value: d.id,
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  const Icon(Icons.medical_services, size: 16, color: AppColors.primary),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      'د. ${d.fullName} (${d.role})',
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      maxLines: 1,
                                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            );
                          }).toList(),
                          onChanged: (id) {
                            if (id != null) {
                              controller.selectedSurgeon.value =
                                  controller.availableSurgeons.firstWhere((u) => u.id == id);
                            }
                          },
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'التكلفة التقديرية للعملية (${AppStringsAr.currencyShort})',
                    hint: '25000',
                    controller: controller.surgeryCostController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.payments_outlined),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'ملاحظات التحضير للجراحة',
                    hint: 'الصيام عن الطعام 12 ساعة، إيقاف أدوية معينة...',
                    controller: controller.surgeryNotesController,
                  ),
                ],
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/consultations/widgets/treatment_plan_section.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/custom_text_field.dart';
import '../controllers/new_consultation_controller.dart';

class TreatmentPlanSection extends GetView<NewConsultationController> {
  const TreatmentPlanSection({super.key});

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context, TextEditingController textCtrl) async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1)),
      firstDate: DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 180)),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      textCtrl.text = picked.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectTime(BuildContext context, TextEditingController textCtrl) async {
    final picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: const TimeOfDay(hour: 10, minute: 0),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        );
      },
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      final hour = picked.hourOfPeriod == 0 ? 12 : picked.hourOfPeriod;
      final minute = picked.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
      final period = picked.period == DayPeriod.am ? 'ص' : 'م';
      textCtrl.text = '$hour:$minute $period';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Obx(
              () => SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                secondary: const CircleAvatar(
                  backgroundColor: Color(0xFFEAF8F6),
                  child: Icon(Icons.event_repeat, color: Color(0xFF2A9D8F)),
                ),
                title: const Text(
                  '4- خطة علاجية وجلسات متابعة متتالية',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                subtitle: const Text(
                  'مثل: إبر مضاد حيوي بالعيادة تتطلب عودة المريض لمدة 3 أيام متتالية',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                ),
                value: controller.needTreatmentPlan.value,
                onChanged: (v) => controller.needTreatmentPlan.value = v,
              ),
            ),
            Obx(() {
              if (!controller.needTreatmentPlan.value) return const SizedBox.shrink();

              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Divider(height: 20),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'سبب المراجعات والجلسات',
                    hint: 'مثال: إبر مضاد حيوي بالعيادة، غيار جروح يومي',
                    controller: controller.planReasonController,
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.medical_services),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'عدد الأيام المتتالية',
                          hint: '3',
                          controller: controller.planDaysController,
                          keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.repeat),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'وقت الحضور اليومي',
                          hint: '10:00 ص',
                          controller: controller.planTimeController,
                          readOnly: true,
                          onTap: () => _selectTime(context, controller.planTimeController),
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'تاريخ بدء الجلسات',
                    hint: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
                    controller: controller.planStartDateController,
                    readOnly: true,
                    onTap: () => _selectDate(context, controller.planStartDateController),
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'ملاحظات وتوصيات للمربي قبل كل جلسة',
                    hint: 'مثال: إحضار الحيوان بدون إجهاد، إبلاغ الطبيب بأي مضاعفات',
                    controller: controller.planNotesController,
                  ),
                ],
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
