<file path="lib/modules/follow_ups/controllers/follow_up_detail_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_payment_methods.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';
import '../../consultations/controllers/prescription_item_controller.dart';
import '../utils/follow_up_pdf_helper.dart';

class FollowUpDetailController extends GetxController {
  final AppointmentRepository _appointmentRepo;
  final ConsultationRepository _consultationRepo;
  final InventoryRepository _inventoryRepo;
  final AuthRepository _authRepo;

  FollowUpDetailController({
    AppointmentRepository? appointmentRepo,
    ConsultationRepository? consultationRepo,
    InventoryRepository? inventoryRepo,
    AuthRepository? authRepo,
  })  : _appointmentRepo = appointmentRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<AppointmentRepository>()
                ? Get.find<AppointmentRepository>()
                : Get.put(AppointmentRepository(), permanent: true)),
        _consultationRepo = consultationRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationRepository>()
                ? Get.find<ConsultationRepository>()
                : Get.put(ConsultationRepository(), permanent: true)),
        _inventoryRepo = inventoryRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<InventoryRepository>()
                ? Get.find<InventoryRepository>()
                : Get.put(InventoryRepository(), permanent: true)),
        _authRepo = authRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<AuthRepository>()
                ? Get.find<AuthRepository>()
                : Get.put(AuthRepository(), permanent: true));

  // Prescription Item Controller for selecting clinic treatments/injections
  late final PrescriptionItemController prescriptionItemController;

  final Rxn<FollowUpModel> followUp = Rxn<FollowUpModel>();
  final Rxn<ConsultationModel> consultation = Rxn<ConsultationModel>();
  final RxList<FollowUpModel> petFollowUps = <FollowUpModel>[].obs;
  final Rxn<Map<String, dynamic>> financialSummary = Rxn<Map<String, dynamic>>();
  final Rxn<ClinicModel> clinicInfo = Rxn<ClinicModel>();

  final RxBool isLoading = true.obs;
  final RxBool isSubmitting = false.obs;

  // Follow-up Examination & Notes
  final clinicalNotesController = TextEditingController();

  // Financial Billing
  final costController = TextEditingController();
  final paidAmountController = TextEditingController();
  final RxString selectedPaymentMethod = AppPaymentMethods.cash.obs;
  final RxDouble remainingAmount = 0.0.obs;

  bool get isDeferred => selectedPaymentMethod.value == AppPaymentMethods.deferred;

  // Next Follow-Up Option
  final RxBool scheduleNextFollowUp = false.obs;
  final nextDateController = TextEditingController();
  final nextTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '10:00 ص');
  final nextReasonController = TextEditingController(text: 'متابعة الحالة السريرية');
  final nextNotesController = TextEditingController();

  // Missed Follow-Up / Reschedule Series
  final RxBool showRescheduleCard = false.obs;
  final newStartDateController = TextEditingController();
  final newTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '10:00 ص');
  final newDaysCountController = TextEditingController(text: '3');

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    prescriptionItemController = Get.isRegistered<PrescriptionItemController>()
        ? Get.find<PrescriptionItemController>()
        : Get.put(PrescriptionItemController(inventoryRepo: _inventoryRepo));

    costController.addListener(calculateRemaining);
    paidAmountController.addListener(calculateRemaining);

    // Default next follow-up date to 3 days from today
    nextDateController.text = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 3)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    newStartDateController.text = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);

    loadData();
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      clinicInfo.value = await _authRepo.getClinicInfo();

      final args = Get.arguments;
      if (args is FollowUpModel) {
        followUp.value = args;
      } else if (args is int) {
        followUp.value = await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpById(args);
      } else if (Get.parameters['id'] != null) {
        final id = int.tryParse(Get.parameters['id']!);
        if (id != null) {
          followUp.value = await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpById(id);
        }
      }

      final current = followUp.value;
      if (current != null) {
        // Load original consultation
        if (current.consultationId != null) {
          consultation.value = await _consultationRepo.getConsultationById(current.consultationId!);
        } else {
          final consults = await _consultationRepo.getConsultationsForPet(current.petId);
          if (consults.isNotEmpty) {
            consultation.value = consults.first;
          }
        }

        // Load all follow-up history for timeline
        petFollowUps.assignAll(await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpsForPet(current.petId));

        // Load financial summary if completed
        if (current.id != null) {
          financialSummary.value = await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpFinancialSummary(current.id!);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[FollowUpDetailController] loadData error: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void calculateRemaining() {
    final cost = double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
    if (isDeferred) {
      paidAmountController.text = '0';
      remainingAmount.value = cost;
      return;
    }
    final paid = double.tryParse(paidAmountController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
    remainingAmount.value = (cost - paid).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
  }

  void setPaymentMethod(String method) {
    selectedPaymentMethod.value = method;
    calculateRemaining();
  }

  Future<void> completeFollowUp() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null) return;

    final cost = double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
    final paid = isDeferred ? 0.0 : (double.tryParse(paidAmountController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0);
    final remaining = isDeferred ? cost : remainingAmount.value;

    FollowUpModel? next;
    if (scheduleNextFollowUp.value && nextDateController.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      next = FollowUpModel(
        petId: current.petId,
        consultationId: current.consultationId,
        scheduledDate: nextDateController.text.trim(),
        scheduledTime: nextTimeController.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? nextTimeController.text.trim() : null,
        reason: nextReasonController.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? nextReasonController.text.trim() : 'متابعة لاحقة',
        notes: nextNotesController.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? nextNotesController.text.trim() : null,
        status: 'pending',
      );
    }

    isSubmitting.value = true;
    try {
      await _appointmentRepo.completeFollowUpWithTreatment(
        followUp: current,
        clinicalNotes: clinicalNotesController.text.trim(),
        administeredTreatments: prescriptionItemController.clinicTreatments.toList(),
        followUpCost: cost,
        paidAmount: paid,
        remainingAmount: remaining,
        paymentMethod: selectedPaymentMethod.value,
        nextFollowUp: next,
      );

      Get.snackbar(
        'تم بنجاح',
        'تم تسجيل إتمام المراجعة وخصم العلاجات من المخزن وتسجيل المعاملة المالية',
        backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
        colorText: Colors.green.shade900,
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
      );

      await loadData();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[FollowUpDetailController] completeFollowUp error: $e');
      Get.snackbar('خطأ', 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ المراجعة: $e', backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100);
    } finally {
      isSubmitting.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> markAsMissed() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null || current.id == null) return;

    final todayStr = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    final confirmed = await Get.dialog<bool>(
      AlertDialog(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, color: Colors.orange),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('تسجيل عدم حضور المريض'),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text('هل ترغب في تسجيل عدم حضور المريض لموعد المراجعة بتاريخ (${current.scheduledDate}) كفائتة؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Get.back(result: false), child: const Text('إلغاء')),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.orange, foregroundColor: Colors.white),
            onPressed: () => Get.back(result: true),
            child: const Text('تأكيد عدم الحضور'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed == true) {
      isSubmitting.value = true;
      try {
        await _appointmentRepo.markFollowUpMissed(
          current.id!,
          missedNote: 'تغيب عن الحضور في $todayStr',
        );
        Get.snackbar(
          'تم التسجيل',
          'تم تسجيل الموعد كفائت مع الاحتفاظ بالسجل في التاريخ الطبي للمريض',
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange.shade100,
        );
        showRescheduleCard.value = true;
        await loadData();
      } finally {
        isSubmitting.value = false;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitReschedule() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null) return;

    final startDate = newStartDateController.text.trim();
    if (startDate.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى تحديد تاريخ البدء الجديد', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final days = int.tryParse(newDaysCountController.text.trim()) ?? 1;
    if (days < 1) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى إدخال عدد أيام صالح', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    isSubmitting.value = true;
    try {
      await _appointmentRepo.resumeFollowUpSchedule(
        missedFollowUp: current,
        newStartDate: startDate,
        scheduledTime: newTimeController.text.trim(),
        newDaysCount: days,
      );

      Get.snackbar(
        'تم الاستئناف بنجاح',
        'تمت إعادة جدولة خطة المتابعة ($days جلسات) بدءاً من $startDate',
        backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
      );
      showRescheduleCard.value = false;
      await loadData();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[FollowUpDetailController] submitReschedule error: $e');
      Get.snackbar('خطأ', 'تعذر استئناف الجدولة: $e', backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100);
    } finally {
      isSubmitting.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> printFollowUpReport() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null) return;
    await FollowUpPdfHelper.printFollowUpReport(
      followUp: current,
      clinic: clinicInfo.value,
      clinicalNotes: clinicalNotesController.text.trim(),
      administeredTreatments: prescriptionItemController.clinicTreatments.toList(),
      financialSummary: financialSummary.value,
    );
  }

  Future<void> sharePdf() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null) return;
    await FollowUpPdfHelper.sharePdf(
      followUp: current,
      clinic: clinicInfo.value,
      clinicalNotes: clinicalNotesController.text.trim(),
      administeredTreatments: prescriptionItemController.clinicTreatments.toList(),
      financialSummary: financialSummary.value,
    );
  }

  Future<void> shareWhatsApp() async {
    final current = followUp.value;
    if (current == null) return;
    await FollowUpPdfHelper.shareViaWhatsApp(
      followUp: current,
      clinic: clinicInfo.value,
      clinicalNotes: clinicalNotesController.text.trim(),
      administeredTreatments: prescriptionItemController.clinicTreatments.toList(),
    );
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    costController.removeListener(calculateRemaining);
    paidAmountController.removeListener(calculateRemaining);
    clinicalNotesController.dispose();
    costController.dispose();
    paidAmountController.dispose();
    nextDateController.dispose();
    nextTimeController.dispose();
    nextReasonController.dispose();
    nextNotesController.dispose();
    newStartDateController.dispose();
    newTimeController.dispose();
    newDaysCountController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/modules/follow_ups/utils/follow_up_pdf_helper.dart">
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/prescription_model.dart';

class FollowUpPdfHelper {
  FollowUpPdfHelper._();

  static Future<Uint8List> generateFollowUpPdf({
    required FollowUpModel followUp,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    String? clinicalNotes,
    List<PrescriptionModel> administeredTreatments = const [],
    FollowUpModel? nextFollowUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final pdf = pw.Document();

    pw.Font arabicFont;
    pw.Font arabicBold;

    try {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    } catch (_) {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    }

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
        theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(base: arabicFont, bold: arabicBold),
        build: (pw.Context context) {
          return [
            pw.Directionality(
              textDirection: pw.TextDirection.rtl,
              child: pw.Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // 1. Clinic Letterhead Header
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                      border: pw.Border(bottom: pw.BorderSide(color: PdfColors.teal700, width: 2)),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text(
                              clinic?.clinicName ?? 'عيادة بيطرية متقدمة',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 15, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                            if (clinic?.phone != null)
                              pw.Text('هاتف العيادة: ${clinic!.phone}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey700)),
                            if (clinic?.address != null)
                              pw.Text('العنوان: ${clinic!.address}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey700)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                          children: [
                            pw.Container(
                              padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                              decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                                color: PdfColors.teal50,
                                borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.teal700),
                              ),
                              child: pw.Text(
                                'تقرير مراجعة سريرية',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 12, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                              ),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                            pw.Text('تاريخ الجلسة: ${followUp.scheduledDate}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey800)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // 2. Patient & Owner Details Box
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.grey100,
                      borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('اسم المريض: ${followUp.petName ?? "المريض"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text('النوع / الفصيلة: ${followUp.petSpecies ?? "غير محدد"}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('المالك: ${followUp.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text('الهاتف: ${followUp.ownerPhone ?? "-"}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('سبب المراجعة:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text(followUp.reason, style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.teal900)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // 3. Clinical Examination Findings & Observations
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.teal50,
                      borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.teal200),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        pw.Text(
                          'ملاحظات الفحص السريري ونتائج المتابعة:',
                          style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                        ),
                        pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                        pw.Text(
                          (clinicalNotes != null && clinicalNotes.isNotEmpty)
                              ? clinicalNotes
                              : (followUp.notes?.isNotEmpty == true ? followUp.notes! : 'تم فحص المريض وحالته مستقرة وفق الخطة العلاجية.'),
                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey900),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 14),

                  // 4. In-Clinic Administered Treatments & Injections Table
                  pw.Text(
                    'العلاجات والحقن التي تم إعطاؤها داخل العيادة أثناء الجلسة:',
                    style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
                  if (administeredTreatments.isEmpty)
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.grey50,
                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Text(
                        'فحص سريري ومتابعة دون إعطاء حقن أو أدوية من مخزن العيادة في هذه الجلسة.',
                        style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                      ),
                    )
                  else
                    pw.Table(
                      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      columnWidths: const {
                        0: pw.FlexColumnWidth(3.0), // Medicine
                        1: pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.5), // Dosage
                        2: pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.5), // Route
                        3: pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.0), // Quantity
                        4: pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.5), // Notes
                      },
                      children: [
                        pw.TableRow(
                          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal100),
                          children: [
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الدواء / الإجراء', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الجرعة', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('طريقة الإعطاء', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الكمية', arabicBold),
                            _buildPdfHeaderCell('الملاحظات', arabicBold),
                          ],
                        ),
                        ...administeredTreatments.map((t) => pw.TableRow(
                              children: [
                                _buildPdfDataCell('${t.displayName} ${t.medicineForm != null ? "(${t.medicineForm})" : ""}', isBold: true, boldFont: arabicBold),
                                _buildPdfDataCell(t.dosage),
                                _buildPdfDataCell(t.route ?? 'حقن / موضعي'),
                                _buildPdfDataCell('${t.quantityDispensed}'),
                                _buildPdfDataCell(t.instructions ?? '-'),
                              ],
                            )),
                      ],
                    ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 14),

                  // 5. Next Follow-Up Session (if scheduled)
                  if (nextFollowUp != null) ...[
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.indigo50,
                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.indigo200),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          pw.Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              pw.Text('موعد المراجعة القادمة المجدول:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.indigo900)),
                              pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                              pw.Text('السبب: ${nextFollowUp.reason}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5)),
                            ],
                          ),
                          pw.Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                            children: [
                              pw.Text('التاريخ: ${nextFollowUp.scheduledDate}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.indigo900)),
                              if (nextFollowUp.scheduledTime != null)
                                pw.Text('الوقت: ${nextFollowUp.scheduledTime}', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5)),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 14),
                  ],

                  // 6. Financial Summary Box (if present)
                  if (financialSummary != null && (financialSummary['totalCost'] ?? 0) > 0) ...[
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.grey100,
                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey400),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text(
                            'إجمالي أتعاب وعلاجات المراجعة: ${(financialSummary["totalCost"] as num).toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10),
                          ),
                          pw.Text(
                            'المدفوع: ${(financialSummary["paidAmount"] as num).toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort} (${financialSummary["paymentMethod"] ?? "نقدا"})',
                            style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10),
                          ),
                          pw.Text(
                            'المتبقي: ${(financialSummary["remainingAmount"] as num).toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: (financialSummary['remainingAmount'] ?? 0) > 0 ? PdfColors.red900 : PdfColors.teal900),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 14),
                  ],

                  // 7. Footer & Signature
                  pw.Spacer(),
                  pw.Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      pw.Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text('ختم وتوقيع الطبيب المعالج:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10)),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 25),
                          pw.Text('..................................................', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey600)),
                        ],
                      ),
                      pw.Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text('مع تمنياتنا لحيوانكم الأليف بدوام الصحة والعافية', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: PdfColors.grey700)),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                          pw.Text('VetPulse Clinic Management System', style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8, color: PdfColors.grey500)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ];
        },
      ),
    );

    return pdf.save();
  }

  static Future<void> printFollowUpReport({
    required FollowUpModel followUp,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    String? clinicalNotes,
    List<PrescriptionModel> administeredTreatments = const [],
    FollowUpModel? nextFollowUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final pdfBytes = await generateFollowUpPdf(
      followUp: followUp,
      clinic: clinic,
      clinicalNotes: clinicalNotes,
      administeredTreatments: administeredTreatments,
      nextFollowUp: nextFollowUp,
      financialSummary: financialSummary,
    );
    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      onLayout: (format) async => pdfBytes,
      name: 'followup_report_${followUp.petName ?? "pet"}_${followUp.id ?? 1}.pdf',
    );
  }

  static Future<void> sharePdf({
    required FollowUpModel followUp,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    String? clinicalNotes,
    List<PrescriptionModel> administeredTreatments = const [],
    FollowUpModel? nextFollowUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final pdfBytes = await generateFollowUpPdf(
      followUp: followUp,
      clinic: clinic,
      clinicalNotes: clinicalNotes,
      administeredTreatments: administeredTreatments,
      nextFollowUp: nextFollowUp,
      financialSummary: financialSummary,
    );
    await Printing.sharePdf(
      bytes: pdfBytes,
      filename: 'followup_report_${followUp.petName ?? "pet"}_${followUp.id ?? 1}.pdf',
    );
  }

  static Future<void> shareViaWhatsApp({
    required FollowUpModel followUp,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    String? clinicalNotes,
    List<PrescriptionModel> administeredTreatments = const [],
    FollowUpModel? nextFollowUp,
  }) async {
    if (followUp.ownerPhone == null || followUp.ownerPhone!.isEmpty) return;
    final phone = followUp.ownerPhone!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');

    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('📋 *تقرير جلسة المراجعة السريرية*');
    buffer.writeln('من: *${clinic?.clinicName ?? "عيادة بيطرية"}*');
    buffer.writeln('--------------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('المريض: *${followUp.petName ?? "المريض"}* (${followUp.petSpecies ?? ""})');
    buffer.writeln('التاريخ: ${followUp.scheduledDate}');
    buffer.writeln('السبب: ${followUp.reason}');
    if (clinicalNotes != null && clinicalNotes.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('ملاحظات الفحص: $clinicalNotes');
    }
    if (administeredTreatments.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('\n💉 *العلاجات والحقن التي أُعطيت بالعيادة:*');
      for (final t in administeredTreatments) {
        buffer.writeln('• ${t.displayName} (${t.dosage} - ${t.route ?? "حقن"})');
      }
    }
    if (nextFollowUp != null) {
      buffer.writeln('\n📅 *موعد المراجعة القادمة:* ${nextFollowUp.scheduledDate} ${nextFollowUp.scheduledTime ?? ""}');
      buffer.writeln('السبب: ${nextFollowUp.reason}');
    }
    buffer.writeln('\nنتمنى لحيوانكم الأليف دوام الصحة والعافية 🐾');

    final uri = Uri.parse('whatsapp://send?phone=$phone&text=${Uri.encodeComponent(buffer.toString())}');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri);
    }
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildPdfHeaderCell(String text, pw.Font boldFont) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: boldFont, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.teal900),
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildPdfDataCell(String text, {bool isBold = false, pw.Font? boldFont}) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
        style: pw.TextStyle(
          font: isBold ? boldFont : null,
          fontSize: 8.5,
          color: PdfColors.grey900,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class FollowUpDetailView extends GetView<FollowUpDetailController> {

              if (consult != null) ...[
                _buildOriginalContextCard(consult),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ],

              // 4. Follow-Up Journey Timeline Card
              _buildJourneyTimelineCard(),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // 5. In-Clinic Treatment & Injections for current session
              if (item.isPending) ...[

                // Clinical Examination Notes for Today's Visit
                Card(
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.edit_note, color: AppColors.primary, size: 20),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              'ملاحظات الفحص السريري لجلسة اليوم',
                              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        CustomTextField(
                          label: 'نتائج الفحص وملاحظات التعافي',
                          hint: 'اكتب ملاحظات فحص المريض وحالته السريرية أثناء جلسة اليوم...',
                          controller: controller.clinicalNotesController,
                          maxLines: 3,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),

                // 6. Financial Billing Card
                _buildBillingCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),

                // 7. Schedule Additional Follow-Up Session
                _buildNextFollowUpCard(context),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ] else if (item.isCompleted) ...[
                _buildCompletedSummaryCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ],

              // 8. Rescheduling / Missed Follow-Up Section
              if (item.isMissed || controller.showRescheduleCard.value) ...[
                _buildRescheduleCard(context, item),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ],

              // 9. Bottom Actions
              _buildActionButtons(item),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
            ],
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

<file path="lib/modules/patients/controllers/patient_detail_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/pet_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/pet_weight_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';

class PatientDetailController extends GetxController {
  final PetRepository _petRepo;
  final ConsultationRepository _consultationRepo;
  final SurgeryRepository _surgeryRepo;
  final AppointmentRepository _appointmentRepo;

  PatientDetailController(
    this._petRepo,
    this._consultationRepo,
    this._surgeryRepo,
    this._appointmentRepo,
  );

  final Rx<PetModel?> selectedPet = Rx<PetModel?>(null);
  int? get petId => selectedPet.value?.id;

  final RxList<PetWeightModel> petWeights = <PetWeightModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<ConsultationModel> petConsultations = <ConsultationModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<SurgeryModel> petSurgeries = <SurgeryModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<FollowUpModel> petFollowUps = <FollowUpModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoadingProfile = false.obs;

  final newWeightController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    final arg = Get.arguments;
    if (arg != null) {
      loadPetFullProfile(arg);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadPetFullProfile(dynamic arg) async {
    isLoadingProfile.value = true;
    try {
      PetModel? targetPet;
      if (arg is PetModel) {
        targetPet = arg;
      } else if (arg is int) {
        targetPet = await _petRepo.getPetById(arg);
      } else if (selectedPet.value != null) {
        targetPet = await _petRepo.getPetById(selectedPet.value!.id!);
      }

      if (targetPet != null) {
        selectedPet.value = targetPet;
        final petId = targetPet.id;
        if (petId != null) {
          final weightsFuture = _petRepo.getWeightsForPet(petId);
          final consultationsFuture = _consultationRepo.getConsultationsForPet(petId);
          final surgeriesFuture = _surgeryRepo.getSurgeriesForPet(petId);
          final followUpsFuture = _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpsForPet(petId);

          final results = await Future.wait([
            weightsFuture,
            consultationsFuture,
            surgeriesFuture,
            followUpsFuture,
          ]);

          petWeights.value = results[0] as List<PetWeightModel>;
          petConsultations.value = results[1] as List<ConsultationModel>;
          petSurgeries.value = results[2] as List<SurgeryModel>;
          petFollowUps.value = results[3] as List<FollowUpModel>;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[PatientDetailController] Error loading pet profile: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoadingProfile.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> recordNewWeight() async {
    if (selectedPet.value == null || selectedPet.value!.id == null) return;
    final w = double.tryParse(newWeightController.text.trim());
    if (w == null || w <= 0) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى إدخال وزن صالح', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final petId = selectedPet.value!.id!;
    await _petRepo.addWeight(PetWeightModel(
      petId: petId,
      weight: w,
      recordedDate: DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10),
    ));

    newWeightController.clear();
    petWeights.value = await _petRepo.getWeightsForPet(petId);
    DataSyncService.notifyPatientChanged(petId: petId);
    Get.back();
    Get.snackbar('تم', 'تم تسجيل الوزن في الملف السريري', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
  }

  Future<void> deletePet(int petId) async {
    await _petRepo.deletePet(petId);
    selectedPet.value = null;
    DataSyncService.notifyPatientChanged(petId: petId);
    Get.back(); // close dialog if open
    Get.back(); // close detail view
    Get.snackbar('تم الحذف', 'تم حذف ملف المريض وكافة بياناته المرتبطة', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    newWeightController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/pharmacy/controllers/add_medicine_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/config/demo_config.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/medicine_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';

class AddMedicineController extends GetxController {
  final InventoryRepository _inventoryRepo;

  AddMedicineController(this._inventoryRepo);

  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;

  final tradeNameController = TextEditingController();
  final scientificNameController = TextEditingController();
  final formController = TextEditingController(text: AppStringsAr.formTablet);
  final concentrationController = TextEditingController();
  final clinicStockController = TextEditingController(text: '0');
  final warehouseStockController = TextEditingController(text: '0');
  final minStockController = TextEditingController(text: '5');
  final costPriceController = TextEditingController(text: '0.0');
  final salePriceController = TextEditingController(text: '0.0');
  final expiryDateController = TextEditingController();
  final batchNumberController = TextEditingController();

  Future<void> saveMedicine() async {
    if (!await DemoConfig.canAddMedicine()) {
      return;
    }

    final trade = tradeNameController.text.trim();
    final expiry = expiryDateController.text.trim();

    if (trade.isEmpty || expiry.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'الاسم التجاري وتاريخ الانتهاء مطلوبان',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final model = MedicineModel(
        tradeName: trade,
        scientificName: scientificNameController.text.trim(),
        form: formController.text.trim(),
        concentration: concentrationController.text.trim(),
        clinicStock: int.tryParse(clinicStockController.text.trim()) ?? 0,
        warehouseStock: int.tryParse(warehouseStockController.text.trim()) ?? 0,
        minStockAlert: int.tryParse(minStockController.text.trim()) ?? 5,
        unitCostPrice: double.tryParse(costPriceController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
        unitSalePrice: double.tryParse(salePriceController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
        expiryDate: expiry,
        batchNumber: batchNumberController.text.trim(),
      );

      await _inventoryRepo.insertMedicine(model);
      clearAddForm();
      DataSyncService.notifyInventoryChanged();
      Get.back();
      Get.snackbar('نجاح', 'تمت إضافة المستحضر الطبي إلى المخزون',
          backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void clearAddForm() {
    tradeNameController.clear();
    scientificNameController.clear();
    formController.text = AppStringsAr.formTablet;
    concentrationController.clear();
    clinicStockController.text = '0';
    warehouseStockController.text = '0';
    minStockController.text = '5';
    costPriceController.text = '0.0';
    salePriceController.text = '0.0';
    expiryDateController.clear();
    batchNumberController.clear();
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    tradeNameController.dispose();
    scientificNameController.dispose();
    formController.dispose();
    concentrationController.dispose();
    clinicStockController.dispose();
    warehouseStockController.dispose();
    minStockController.dispose();
    costPriceController.dispose();
    salePriceController.dispose();
    expiryDateController.dispose();
    batchNumberController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/pharmacy/controllers/inventory_list_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../data/models/medicine_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';

class InventoryListController extends GetxController {
  final InventoryRepository _inventoryRepo;

  InventoryListController(this._inventoryRepo);

  final RxList<MedicineModel> medicines = <MedicineModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;
  final RxString selectedFilter = 'الكل'.obs;

  final searchController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadMedicines();
  }

  Future<void> loadMedicines() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final list = await _inventoryRepo.getAllMedicines();
      medicines.assignAll(list);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> search(String query) async {
    if (query.trim().isEmpty) {
      loadMedicines();
      return;
    }
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final results = await _inventoryRepo.searchMedicines(query);
      medicines.assignAll(results);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void filterMedicines(String filter) async {
    selectedFilter.value = filter;
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      if (filter == 'منخفض') {
        final low = await _inventoryRepo.getLowStockMedicines();
        medicines.assignAll(low);
      } else if (filter == 'منتهي / قريب') {
        final exp = await _inventoryRepo.getExpiringOrExpiredMedicines();
        medicines.assignAll(exp);
      } else {
        await loadMedicines();
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    searchController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/pharmacy/controllers/stock_transfer_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/medicine_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';

class StockTransferController extends GetxController {
  final InventoryRepository _inventoryRepo;

  StockTransferController(this._inventoryRepo);

  final RxList<MedicineModel> medicines = <MedicineModel>[].obs;
  final Rx<MedicineModel?> selectedMedForTransfer = Rx<MedicineModel?>(null);
  final transferQuantityController = TextEditingController();
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadMedicines();
  }

  Future<void> loadMedicines() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final list = await _inventoryRepo.getAllMedicines();
      medicines.assignAll(list);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> transferStock() async {
    final med = selectedMedForTransfer.value;
    final qty = int.tryParse(transferQuantityController.text.trim()) ?? 0;

    if (med == null || med.id == null) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى اختيار الصنف لنقل رصيده',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    if (qty <= 0) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'الكمية المنقولة يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    if (qty > med.warehouseStock) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'خطأ',
        'الكمية المطلوبة أكبر من رصيد المستودع الحالي (${med.warehouseStock})',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100,
      );
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final success = await _inventoryRepo.transferStock(
        medicineId: med.id!,
        quantity: qty,
      );
      if (success) {
        transferQuantityController.clear();
        selectedMedForTransfer.value = null;
        DataSyncService.notifyInventoryChanged();
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar(
          'نجاح',
          'تم تحويل $qty وحدة من المستودع إلى رف العيادة بنجاح',
          backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
        );
      } else {
        Get.snackbar(
          'خطأ',
          'فشلت عملية التحويل، تحقق من الرصيد المتوفر',
          backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    transferQuantityController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/modules/surgeries/controllers/surgery_detail_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';
import '../../../routes/app_routes.dart';
import '../../auth/controllers/auth_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/surgery_form_controller.dart';
import '../utils/surgery_pdf_helper.dart';

class SurgeryDetailController extends GetxController {
  final SurgeryRepository _surgeryRepo;
  final AppointmentRepository _appointmentRepo;

  SurgeryDetailController({
    SurgeryRepository? surgeryRepo,
    AppointmentRepository? appointmentRepo,
  })  : _surgeryRepo = surgeryRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryRepository>()
                ? Get.find<SurgeryRepository>()
                : Get.put(SurgeryRepository(), permanent: true)),
        _appointmentRepo = appointmentRepo ??
            (Get.isRegistered<AppointmentRepository>()
                ? Get.find<AppointmentRepository>()
                : Get.put(AppointmentRepository(), permanent: true));

  final Rxn<SurgeryModel> surgery = Rxn<SurgeryModel>();
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;
  final Rxn<Map<String, dynamic>> financialSummary = Rxn<Map<String, dynamic>>();
  final RxList<FollowUpModel> followUps = <FollowUpModel>[].obs;

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    final args = Get.arguments;
    if (args is SurgeryModel) {
      surgery.value = args;
      loadAdditionalData(args.id);
    } else if (args is int) {
      loadSurgeryById(args);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadSurgeryById(int id) async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final s = await _surgeryRepo.getSurgeryById(id);
      surgery.value = s;
      await loadAdditionalData(id);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadAdditionalData(int? surgeryId) async {
    if (surgeryId == null) return;
    try {
      final s = surgery.value;
      if (s != null && s.petId > 0) {
        final allFollowUps = await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpsForPet(s.petId);
        followUps.assignAll(allFollowUps);
      }
      final fin = await _surgeryRepo.getSurgeryFinancialSummary(surgeryId);
      financialSummary.value = fin;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[SurgeryDetailController] Error loading additional data: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> reload() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s?.id != null) {
      final updated = await _surgeryRepo.getSurgeryById(s!.id!);
      if (updated != null) {
        surgery.value = updated;
      }
      await loadAdditionalData(s.id);
    }
  }

  Future<void> togglePreOpChecklist() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s?.id == null) return;
    final nextState = !s!.preOpChecklistPassed;
    await _surgeryRepo.togglePreOpChecklist(s.id!, nextState);
    surgery.value = s.copyWith(preOpChecklistPassed: nextState);
    DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: s.petId);
    if (Get.context != null) {
      Get.snackbar(
        nextState ? 'تم اعتماد المعايير' : 'تم إلغاء الاعتماد',
        nextState ? 'تم استيفاء معايير الأمان قبل الجراحة' : 'معايير ما قبل الجراحة معلقة',
        backgroundColor: nextState ? Colors.green.shade100 : Colors.amber.shade100,
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> startSurgery() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s?.id == null) return;
    await _surgeryRepo.updateSurgeryStatus(s!.id!, 'in_progress');
    surgery.value = s.copyWith(status: 'in_progress');
    DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: s.petId);
    if (Get.context != null) {
      Get.snackbar('بدء العملية', 'تم تغيير حالة العملية إلى: جارية الآن', backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade100);
    }
  }

  Future<void> markNoShow() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s?.id == null) return;
    const note = '[لم يحضر الموعد] لم يحضر المريض للجراحة في الموعد المحدد';
    await _surgeryRepo.cancelSurgery(s!.id!, cancelReason: note);
    surgery.value = s.copyWith(
      status: 'cancelled',
      postOpNotes: s.postOpNotes != null && s.postOpNotes!.isNotEmpty
          ? '$note\n${s.postOpNotes}'
          : note,
    );
    DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: s.petId);
    if (Get.context != null) {
      Get.snackbar('تم التسجيل', 'تم تسجيل عدم حضور المريض بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
    }
  }

  Future<void> cancelSurgery(String reason) async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s?.id == null) return;
    await _surgeryRepo.cancelSurgery(s!.id!, cancelReason: reason);
    surgery.value = s.copyWith(
      status: 'cancelled',
      postOpNotes: s.postOpNotes != null && s.postOpNotes!.isNotEmpty
          ? '$reason\n${s.postOpNotes}'
          : reason,
    );
    DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: s.petId);
    if (Get.context != null) {
      Get.snackbar('تم الإلغاء', 'تم إلغاء العملية الجراحية مع حفظ السجل', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
    }
  }

  void navigateToEdit() {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s == null) return;
    if (Get.isRegistered<AuthController>() &&
        !Get.find<AuthController>().checkPermission((u) => u.canPerformSurgeries, 'تعديل العملية متاح للأطباء فقط')) {
      return;
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryFormController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryFormController>().initEditSurgery(s);
    }
    Get.toNamed(AppRoutes.newSurgery)?.then((_) => reload());
  }

  void navigateToComplete() {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s == null) return;
    if (Get.isRegistered<AuthController>() &&
        !Get.find<AuthController>().checkPermission((u) => u.canPerformSurgeries, 'إتمام العملية متاح للأطباء فقط')) {
      return;
    }
    Get.toNamed(AppRoutes.completeSurgery, arguments: s)?.then((res) {
      if (res == true) reload();
    });
  }

  ClinicModel? get _clinic =>
      Get.isRegistered<AuthController>() ? Get.find<AuthController>().clinicInfo.value : null;

  Future<void> printReport() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s == null) return;
    await SurgeryPdfHelper.printSurgeryPdf(
      surgery: s,
      clinic: _clinic,
      followUp: followUps.isNotEmpty ? followUps.first : null,
      financialSummary: financialSummary.value,
    );
  }

  Future<void> shareReportPdf() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s == null) return;
    await SurgeryPdfHelper.shareSurgeryPdfFile(
      surgery: s,
      clinic: _clinic,
      followUp: followUps.isNotEmpty ? followUps.first : null,
      financialSummary: financialSummary.value,
    );
  }

  Future<void> shareOnWhatsApp() async {
    final s = surgery.value;
    if (s == null) return;
    await SurgeryPdfHelper.shareSurgeryOnWhatsApp(
      surgery: s,
      clinic: _clinic,
      followUp: followUps.isNotEmpty ? followUps.first : null,
      financialSummary: financialSummary.value,
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/surgeries/controllers/surgery_follow_up_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';

class SurgeryFollowUpController extends GetxController {
  final RxBool needFollowUp = true.obs;
  final followUpDateController = TextEditingController();
  final followUpTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '10:00 ص');
  final followUpReasonController = TextEditingController(text: 'معاينة التئام الجرح الجراحي وفك الغرز');
  final followUpNotesController = TextEditingController(text: 'إحضار الحيوان لفحص الشفاء وإزالة خيوط الجراحة');

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    final defaultFollowUp = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7));
    followUpDateController.text = defaultFollowUp.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
  }

  FollowUpModel? buildFollowUp(int petId) {
    if (!needFollowUp.value || followUpDateController.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    return FollowUpModel(
      petId: petId,
      scheduledDate: followUpDateController.text.trim(),
      scheduledTime: followUpTimeController.text.trim(),
      reason: followUpReasonController.text.trim(),
      notes: followUpNotesController.text.trim(),
    );
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    followUpDateController.dispose();
    followUpTimeController.dispose();
    followUpReasonController.dispose();
    followUpNotesController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/surgeries/controllers/surgery_form_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/config/demo_config.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/pet_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/user_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';

class SurgeryFormController extends GetxController {
  final SurgeryRepository _surgeryRepo;
  final PetRepository _petRepo;
  final AuthRepository _authRepo;

  SurgeryFormController(
    this._surgeryRepo,
    this._petRepo,
    this._authRepo,
  );

  final RxList<PetModel> pets = <PetModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<UserModel> doctors = <UserModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;

  // Form Observables & Controllers (Total: 7 TextEditingControllers)
  final Rx<PetModel?> selectedPet = Rx<PetModel?>(null);
  final Rx<UserModel?> selectedSurgeon = Rx<UserModel?>(null);
  final surgeryNameController = TextEditingController();
  final categoryController = TextEditingController(text: AppStringsAr.categoryElective);
  final scheduledDateController = TextEditingController();
  final scheduledTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '09:00 ص');
  final anesthesiaController = TextEditingController(text: 'إيزوفلوران / كيتامين');
  final postOpNotesController = TextEditingController();
  final costController = TextEditingController(text: '15000');

  // Pre-op Checklist observables
  final RxBool checkFasting = false.obs;
  final RxBool checkBloodWork = false.obs;
  final RxBool checkConsent = false.obs;

  // Edit Mode
  final RxBool isEditing = false.obs;
  final Rx<int?> editingId = Rx<int?>(null);

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadPetsAndDoctors();
    final args = Get.arguments;
    if (args is SurgeryModel) {
      initEditSurgery(args);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadPetsAndDoctors() async {
    pets.assignAll(await _petRepo.getAllPets());
    final allUsers = await _authRepo.getAllUsers();
    doctors.assignAll(allUsers.where((u) => u.canPerformSurgeries));
    if (doctors.isNotEmpty && selectedSurgeon.value == null) {
      selectedSurgeon.value = doctors.first;
    }
  }

  void initEditSurgery(SurgeryModel surgery) {
    isEditing.value = true;
    editingId.value = surgery.id;
    if (pets.isNotEmpty) {
      selectedPet.value = pets.firstWhereOrNull((p) => p.id == surgery.petId);
    }
    if (doctors.isNotEmpty) {
      selectedSurgeon.value = doctors.firstWhereOrNull((d) => d.id == surgery.leadSurgeonId);
    }
    surgeryNameController.text = surgery.surgeryName;
    categoryController.text = surgery.surgeryCategory ?? AppStringsAr.categoryElective;

    final parts = surgery.scheduledDate.split(' ');
    if (parts.isNotEmpty) {
      scheduledDateController.text = parts[0];
    }
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      scheduledTimeController.text = parts.sublist(1).join(' ');
    } else {
      scheduledTimeController.text = '09:00 ص';
    }

    anesthesiaController.text = surgery.anesthesiaProtocol ?? '';
    postOpNotesController.text = surgery.postOpNotes ?? '';
    costController.text = (surgery.estimatedCost?.toInt() ?? 15000).toString();

    checkFasting.value = surgery.preOpChecklistPassed;
    checkBloodWork.value = surgery.preOpChecklistPassed;
    checkConsent.value = surgery.preOpChecklistPassed;
  }

  Future<void> saveSurgery() async {
    if (!await DemoConfig.canAddSurgery()) {
      return;
    }

    if (selectedPet.value == null || selectedPet.value!.id == null) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى اختيار المريض أولاً', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final name = surgeryNameController.text.trim();
    final date = scheduledDateController.text.trim();

    if (name.isEmpty || date.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'اسم العملية وتاريخ الموعد مطلوبان', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final fullDateTime = '$date ${scheduledTimeController.text.trim()}';
      final allChecked = checkFasting.value && checkBloodWork.value && checkConsent.value;

      if (isEditing.value && editingId.value != null) {
        final model = SurgeryModel(
          id: editingId.value,
          petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
          leadSurgeonId: selectedSurgeon.value?.id ?? 1,
          scheduledDate: fullDateTime,
          surgeryName: name,
          surgeryCategory: categoryController.text.trim(),
          preOpChecklistPassed: allChecked,
          anesthesiaProtocol: anesthesiaController.text.trim(),
          postOpNotes: postOpNotesController.text.trim(),
          estimatedCost: double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
        );
        await _surgeryRepo.updateSurgery(model);
        DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: model.petId);
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar('نجاح', 'تم تعديل بيانات العملية الجراحية بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
      } else {
        final model = SurgeryModel(
          petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
          leadSurgeonId: selectedSurgeon.value?.id ?? 1,
          scheduledDate: fullDateTime,
          surgeryName: name,
          surgeryCategory: categoryController.text.trim(),
          preOpChecklistPassed: allChecked,
          anesthesiaProtocol: anesthesiaController.text.trim(),
          postOpNotes: postOpNotesController.text.trim(),
          estimatedCost: double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
        );

        await _surgeryRepo.insertSurgery(model);
        DataSyncService.notifySurgeryChanged(petId: model.petId);
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar('نجاح', 'تم حجز موعد العملية الجراحية بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
      }

      clearForm();
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void clearForm() {
    isEditing.value = false;
    editingId.value = null;
    selectedPet.value = null;
    surgeryNameController.clear();
    scheduledDateController.clear();
    scheduledTimeController.text = '09:00 ص';
    postOpNotesController.clear();
    costController.text = '15000';
    checkFasting.value = false;
    checkBloodWork.value = false;
    checkConsent.value = false;
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    surgeryNameController.dispose();
    categoryController.dispose();
    scheduledDateController.dispose();
    scheduledTimeController.dispose();
    anesthesiaController.dispose();
    postOpNotesController.dispose();
    costController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}
