<file path="lib/modules/surgeries/utils/surgery_pdf_helper.dart">
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/prescription_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';

class SurgeryPdfHelper {
  SurgeryPdfHelper._();

  static Future<Uint8List> generateSurgeryPdf({
    required SurgeryModel surgery,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    List<PrescriptionModel> medications = const [],
    FollowUpModel? followUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final pdf = pw.Document();

    pw.Font arabicFont;
    pw.Font arabicBold;

    try {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    } catch (_) {
      final regularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Regular.ttf');
      final boldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Amiri-Bold.ttf');
      arabicFont = pw.Font.ttf(regularData);
      arabicBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldData);
    }

    final double totalCost = (financialSummary?['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? surgery.estimatedCost ?? 0.0;
    final double paidAmount = (financialSummary?['paid_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? totalCost;
    final double remainingAmount = (financialSummary?['remaining_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    final String paymentMethod = (financialSummary?['payment_method'] as String?) ?? 'نقدا';

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
        theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(base: arabicFont, bold: arabicBold),
        build: (pw.Context context) {
          return [
            pw.Directionality(
              textDirection: pw.TextDirection.rtl,
              child: pw.Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // 1. Clinic Letterhead Header
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                      border: pw.Border(bottom: pw.BorderSide(color: PdfColors.teal700, width: 2)),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text(
                              clinic?.clinicName ?? 'عيادة بيطرية متقدمة',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 15, color: PdfColors.teal900),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text(
                              clinic?.doctorName ?? surgery.surgeonName ?? 'د. بيطري',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey800),
                            ),
                            if (clinic?.licenseNumber != null && clinic!.licenseNumber!.isNotEmpty)
                              pw.Text(
                                'ترخيص: ${clinic.licenseNumber}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text(
                              'تقرير الجراحة والتخريج الطبي',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 13, color: PdfColors.teal700),
                            ),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                            pw.Text(
                              'التاريخ: ${surgery.scheduledDate.length >= 10 ? surgery.scheduledDate.substring(0, 10) : surgery.scheduledDate}',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5),
                            ),
                            if (clinic?.phone != null && clinic!.phone!.isNotEmpty)
                              pw.Text(
                                'هاتف: ${clinic.phone}',
                                style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8.5),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // 2. Patient & Owner Info Box
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.grey100,
                      borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(6)),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('اسم المريض: ${surgery.petName ?? "غير محدد"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                            pw.Text('النوع والبيانات: ${surgery.petSpecies ?? "حيوان أليف"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('المالك: ${surgery.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                            pw.Text('رقم الهاتف: ${surgery.ownerPhone ?? "غير متوفر"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        pw.Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('الجراح المسؤول: ${surgery.surgeonName ?? "طبيب بيطري"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11)),
                            pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                            pw.Text('حالة العملية: ${surgery.statusDisplayArabic}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.teal800)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // 3. Surgery Procedure & Anesthesia Info
                  pw.Container(
                    padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                      color: PdfColors.teal50,
                      borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(6)),
                      border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.teal200),
                    ),
                    child: pw.Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        pw.Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            pw.Text('العملية الجراحية: ${surgery.surgeryName}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 12, color: PdfColors.teal900)),
                            pw.Text('التصنيف: ${surgery.surgeryCategory ?? "عام"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.teal800)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        if (surgery.anesthesiaProtocol != null && surgery.anesthesiaProtocol!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                          pw.Text('بروتوكول التخدير المتبع: ${surgery.anesthesiaProtocol}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5)),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // 4. Clinical Outcome & Post-op Notes
                  if (surgery.postOpNotes != null && surgery.postOpNotes!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    pw.Text('📋 تقرير ونتائج الجراحة وإرشادات الرعاية:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.teal800)),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Container(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.white,
                        borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(6)),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Text(
                        surgery.postOpNotes!,
                        style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5, lineSpacing: 2),
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  // 5. Prescribed Medications
                  if (medications.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    pw.Text('💊 الروشتة الطبية والعلاجات المقررة:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.teal800)),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Table(
                      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300, width: 0.5),
                      columnWidths: {
                        0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(3),
                        1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2),
                        2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2),
                        3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(3),
                      },
                      children: [
                        pw.TableRow(
                          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.teal100),
                          children: [
                            _buildTableHeader('الدواء / العلاج', arabicBold),
                            _buildTableHeader('الجرعة', arabicBold),
                            _buildTableHeader('التكرار والمدة', arabicBold),
                            _buildTableHeader('ملاحظات وإرشادات', arabicBold),
                          ],
                        ),
                        ...medications.map((m) => pw.TableRow(
                              children: [
                                _buildTableCell(m.displayName, arabicFont),
                                _buildTableCell(m.dosage, arabicFont),
                                _buildTableCell('${m.frequency} (${m.durationDays} يوم)', arabicFont),
                                _buildTableCell(m.instructions ?? '-', arabicFont),
                              ],
                            )),
                      ],
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  // 6. Follow-up Session
                  if (followUp != null) ...[
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.blue50,
                        borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(6)),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.blue200),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Row(
                        children: [
                          pw.Text('🗓️ موعد المراجعة القادمة: ', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.blue900)),
                          pw.Text('${followUp.scheduledDate} ${followUp.scheduledTime ?? ""} - ${followUp.reason}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9.5)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],

                  // 7. Financial Summary
                  if (totalCost > 0) ...[
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.grey100,
                        borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(6)),
                        border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text(
                            'إجمالي التكلفة: ${totalCost.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10.5),
                          ),
                          pw.Text(
                            'المسدد: ${paidAmount.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort} ($paymentMethod)',
                            style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 10),
                          ),
                          if (remainingAmount > 0)
                            pw.Text(
                              'المتبقي آجل: ${remainingAmount.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10.5, color: PdfColors.red800),
                            )
                          else
                            pw.Text(
                              'خالص ومسدد بالكامل',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.green800),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],

                  pw.Spacer(),

                  // 8. Footer & Doctor Signature
                  pw.Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      pw.Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          pw.Text('توقيع وختم الجراح المسؤول:', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicBold, fontSize: 9)),
                          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),
                          pw.Text('د. ${surgery.surgeonName ?? clinic?.doctorName ?? "البيطري"}', style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 9)),
                        ],
                      ),
                      pw.Text(
                        'صادر من نظام إدارة العيادات البيطرية (VetPulse)',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(font: arabicFont, fontSize: 8, color: PdfColors.grey600),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ];
        },
      ),
    );

    return pdf.save();
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildTableHeader(String text, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 9.5, color: PdfColors.teal900),
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildTableCell(String text, pw.Font font) {
    return pw.Padding(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
      child: pw.Text(
        text,
        style: pw.TextStyle(font: font, fontSize: 8.5),
        textAlign: pw.TextAlign.center,
      ),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> printSurgeryPdf({
    required SurgeryModel surgery,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    List<PrescriptionModel> medications = const [],
    FollowUpModel? followUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final bytes = await generateSurgeryPdf(
      surgery: surgery,
      clinic: clinic,
      medications: medications,
      followUp: followUp,
      financialSummary: financialSummary,
    );
    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      onLayout: (_) => bytes,
      name: 'surgery_report_${surgery.id ?? "new"}.pdf',
    );
  }

  static Future<void> shareSurgeryPdfFile({
    required SurgeryModel surgery,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    List<PrescriptionModel> medications = const [],
    FollowUpModel? followUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final bytes = await generateSurgeryPdf(
      surgery: surgery,
      clinic: clinic,
      medications: medications,
      followUp: followUp,
      financialSummary: financialSummary,
    );
    await Printing.sharePdf(
      bytes: bytes,
      filename: 'surgery_report_${surgery.surgeryName.replaceAll(' ', '_')}.pdf',
    );
  }

  static Future<void> shareSurgeryOnWhatsApp({
    required SurgeryModel surgery,
    ClinicModel? clinic,
    List<PrescriptionModel> medications = const [],
    FollowUpModel? followUp,
    Map<String, dynamic>? financialSummary,
  }) async {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('🐾 *${clinic?.clinicName ?? "عيادة بيطرية"}*');
    buffer.writeln('🏥 *تقرير الجراحة والتخريج الطبي*');
    buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('المريض: ${surgery.petName ?? "المريض"} (${surgery.petSpecies ?? "حيوان أليف"})');
    buffer.writeln('المالك: ${surgery.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}');
    buffer.writeln('العملية الجراحية: ${surgery.surgeryName} (${surgery.surgeryCategory ?? "عام"})');
    buffer.writeln('الجراح: ${surgery.surgeonName ?? "طبيب بيطري"}');
    buffer.writeln('تاريخ الإجراء: ${surgery.scheduledDate}');
    buffer.writeln('حالة العملية: ${surgery.statusDisplayArabic}');

    if (surgery.postOpNotes != null && surgery.postOpNotes!.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('📋 *تقرير الجراحة وإرشادات الرعاية:*');
      buffer.writeln(surgery.postOpNotes!);
    }

    if (medications.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('💊 *الأدوية والعلاجات المقررة:*');
      for (final m in medications) {
        buffer.writeln('• *${m.displayName}*: ${m.dosage} (${m.frequency} لمدة ${m.durationDays} يوم)');
        if (m.instructions != null && m.instructions!.isNotEmpty) {
          buffer.writeln('  تعليمات: ${m.instructions}');
        }
      }
    }

    if (followUp != null) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('🗓️ *موعد المراجعة القادمة:*');
      buffer.writeln('• التاريخ: ${followUp.scheduledDate} ${followUp.scheduledTime ?? ""}');
      buffer.writeln('  الغرض: ${followUp.reason}');
    }

    final double totalCost = (financialSummary?['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? surgery.estimatedCost ?? 0.0;
    final double remaining = (financialSummary?['remaining_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    if (totalCost > 0) {
      buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
      buffer.writeln('تكلفة العملية: ${totalCost.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}');
      if (remaining > 0) {
        buffer.writeln('المتبقي آجل: ${remaining.toStringAsFixed(0)} ${AppStringsAr.currencyShort}');
      } else {
        buffer.writeln('الحالة المالية: خالص ومسدد بالكامل');
      }
    }

    buffer.writeln('---------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('مع تمنياتنا لحيوانكم الأليف بالشفاء العاجل والسلامة التامة.');

    final encoded = Uri.encodeComponent(buffer.toString());
    final url = Uri.parse('whatsapp://send?text=$encoded');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(url)) {
      await launchUrl(url);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SurgeryDetailView extends GetView<SurgeryDetailController> {
  const SurgeryDetailView({super.key});

  void _showCancelDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final reasonController = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.cancel_outlined, color: AppColors.critical),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('إلغاء العملية الجراحية'),
          ],
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text('يرجى ذكر سبب إلغاء موعد العملية:'),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            TextField(
              controller: reasonController,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'مثال: طلب المالك تأجيل العملية، عدم استقرار الحالة...',
              ),
              maxLines: 2,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
            child: const Text(AppStringsAr.cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.critical,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
            onPressed: () {
              final reason = reasonController.text.trim();
              Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
              controller.cancelSurgery(reason.isNotEmpty ? reason : 'تم إلغاء الموعد بناءً على طلب الطبيب');
            },
            child: const Text('تأكيد الإلغاء'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showNoShowDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.person_off_outlined, color: Colors.orange),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('تأكيد عدم حضور المريض'),
          ],
        ),
        content: const Text('هل ترغب بتسجيل عدم حضور المريض للعملية الجراحية؟ سيتم الاحتفاظ بالسجل في التاريخ الطبي للحيوان.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
            child: const Text(AppStringsAr.cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
              controller.markNoShow();
            },
            child: const Text('تسجيل عدم الحضور'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  ChipStatusType _getChipType(SurgeryModel s) {
    if (s.status == 'completed') return ChipStatusType.success;
    if (s.status == 'in_progress') return ChipStatusType.warning;
    if (s.isOverdue || s.isNoShow) return ChipStatusType.critical;
    if (s.status == 'cancelled') return ChipStatusType.neutral;
    return ChipStatusType.info;
  }

                                surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.pending_actions,

                                size: 22,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Text(
                                surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? 'تم استيفاء معايير الأمان قبل الجراحة' : 'معايير ما قبل الجراحة معلقة',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  color: surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? AppColors.success : Colors.brown,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (surgery.status != 'completed' && surgery.status != 'cancelled')
                            ElevatedButton(
                              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                backgroundColor: surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? Colors.grey.shade300 : AppColors.success,
                                foregroundColor: surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? Colors.black87 : Colors.white,
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                              ),
                              onPressed: controller.togglePreOpChecklist,
                              child: Text(surgery.preOpChecklistPassed ? 'إلغاء الاعتماد' : 'اعتماد المعايير'),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.grey.shade50,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          '• صيام الحيوان عن الأكل والشرب لمدة 12 ساعة قبل التخدير.\n• مراجعة نتائج تحاليل الدم الشاملة ووظائف الأعضاء.\n• توقيع المالك على استمارة الموافقة الخطية للجراحة والتخدير.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, height: 1.5, color: AppColors.textSecondary),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // 4. Anesthesia Protocol Card
              if (surgery.anesthesiaProtocol != null && surgery.anesthesiaProtocol!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),

                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

  Widget? _buildBottomActions(BuildContext context, SurgeryModel s) {
    if (s.status == 'scheduled') {
      return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, -4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceEvenly,
          children: [
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow, size: 18),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.primary, foregroundColor: Colors.white),
              label: const Text('بدء العملية (جارية الآن)'),
              onPressed: controller.startSurgery,
            ),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.person_off_outlined, size: 18),
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.orange, side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.orange)),
              label: const Text('لم يحضر المريض'),
              onPressed: () => _showNoShowDialog(context),
            ),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel_outlined, size: 18),
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: AppColors.critical, side: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.critical)),
              label: const Text('إلغاء العملية'),
              onPressed: () => _showCancelDialog(context),
            ),
            TextButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 18),
              label: const Text(AppStringsAr.edit),
              onPressed: controller.navigateToEdit,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (s.status == 'in_progress') {
      return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, -4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.task_alt, size: 20),
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: AppColors.success,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          ),
          label: const Text(
            'إدخال تفاصيل الجراحة وإتمام العملية والتخريج',
            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),
          ),
          onPressed: controller.navigateToComplete,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (s.status == 'completed') {
      return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, -4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf, size: 18),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                ),
                label: const Text('طباعة ومشاركة التقرير الجراحي والروشتة'),
                onPressed: controller.printReport,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.chat, color: Color(0xFF25D366), size: 26),
              tooltip: 'واتساب',
              onPressed: controller.shareOnWhatsApp,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return null;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/custom_text_field.dart';
import '../controllers/surgery_follow_up_controller.dart';

class SurgeryFollowUpCard extends GetView<SurgeryFollowUpController> {
  const SurgeryFollowUpCard({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                const Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.event_repeat, color: AppColors.primary, size: 20),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      'حجز موعد مراجعة بعد العملية',
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Obx(() => Switch(
                      value: controller.needFollowUp.value,
                      activeThumbColor: AppColors.primary,
                      onChanged: (val) => controller.needFollowUp.value = val,
                    )),
              ],
            ),
            Obx(() {
              if (!controller.needFollowUp.value) return const SizedBox.shrink();
              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Divider(height: 20),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'تاريخ المراجعة *',
                          hint: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
                          controller: controller.followUpDateController,
                          readOnly: true,
                          onTap: () async {
                            final picked = await showDatePicker(
                              context: context,
                              initialDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7)),
                              firstDate: DateTime.now(),
                              lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 90)),
                            );
                            if (picked != null) {
                              controller.followUpDateController.text =
                                  picked.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
                            }
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: CustomTextField(
                          label: 'الوقت المحدد',
                          hint: '10:00 ص',
                          controller: controller.followUpTimeController,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'سبب المراجعة',
                    hint: 'معاينة التئام الجرح وفك الغرز',
                    controller: controller.followUpReasonController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  CustomTextField(
                    label: 'ملاحظات الموعد',
                    hint: 'تعليمات الحضور للمراجعة',
                    controller: controller.followUpNotesController,
                  ),
                ],
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'app_colors.dart';

class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();

  static ThemeData get lightTheme {
    final baseTextTheme = GoogleFonts.cairoTextTheme();

    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: Brightness.light,
      primaryColor: AppColors.primary,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
        primary: AppColors.primary,
        onPrimary: Colors.white,
        secondary: AppColors.secondary,
        onSecondary: AppColors.darkNeutral,
        surface: AppColors.surface,
        onSurface: AppColors.textPrimary,
        error: AppColors.critical,
        onError: Colors.white,
      ),
      textTheme: baseTextTheme.copyWith(
        displayLarge: baseTextTheme.displayLarge?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        ),
        headlineLarge: baseTextTheme.headlineLarge?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        ),
        headlineMedium: baseTextTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        ),
        titleLarge: baseTextTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          fontSize: 18,
        ),
        titleMedium: baseTextTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize: 16,
        ),
        bodyLarge: baseTextTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
          fontSize: 14,
        ),
        bodyMedium: baseTextTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textSecondary,
          fontSize: 13,
        ),
        bodySmall: baseTextTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
          color: AppColors.textMuted,
          fontSize: 12,
        ),
      ),
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 2,
        centerTitle: true,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        titleTextStyle: GoogleFonts.cairo(
          color: Colors.white,
          fontSize: 17,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        ),
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Colors.white),
        actionsIconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Colors.white),
      ),
      cardTheme: CardThemeData(
        color: AppColors.surface,
        elevation: 0,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          side: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.border, width: 1),
        ),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6, horizontal: 0),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.white,
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.border, width: 1),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.border, width: 1),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.primary, width: 2),
        ),
        errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.critical, width: 1),
        ),
        focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.critical, width: 2),
        ),
        labelStyle: GoogleFonts.cairo(color: AppColors.textSecondary, fontSize: 14),
        hintStyle: GoogleFonts.cairo(color: AppColors.textMuted, fontSize: 13),
      ),
      elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          elevation: 0,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 14),

            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          ),
          textStyle: GoogleFonts.cairo(
            fontSize: 15,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(

            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          ),
        ),

import 'dart:convert';

enum LicenseStatus {
  unactivated,
  active,
  expired,
  clockTampered,
}

class LicenseService extends GetxService {
  static LicenseService get to =>
      Get.isRegistered<LicenseService>() ? Get.find<LicenseService>() : Get.put(LicenseService(), permanent: true);

  // XOR-Masked Cryptographic Secret Salt & HMAC Signing Key
  static const List<int> _kXorMask = [0x56, 0x7E, 0x54, 0x50, 0x32, 0x30, 0x32, 0x36];
  static const List<int> _kMaskedKey = [
    0x00, 0x3B, 0x00, 0x00, 0x67, 0x7C, 0x61, 0x73, 0x09, 0x36, 0x19, 0x11, 0x71, 0x6F, 0x61, 0x73,
    0x15, 0x2C, 0x11, 0x04, 0x6D, 0x7B, 0x77, 0x6F, 0x09, 0x4C, 0x64, 0x62, 0x04, 0x6F, 0x61, 0x77,
    0x09, 0x27, 0x11, 0x0F, 0x61, 0x75, 0x71, 0x63, 0x04, 0x3B, 0x0B, 0x11, 0x67, 0x64, 0x7A,
  ];
  static const List<int> _kMaskedSalt = [
    0x00, 0x3B, 0x00, 0x00, 0x67, 0x7C, 0x61, 0x73, 0x09, 0x3A, 0x11, 0x06, 0x7B, 0x73, 0x77, 0x69,
    0x05, 0x3F, 0x18, 0x04, 0x6D, 0x09, 0x0B, 0x02, 0x64, 0x21, 0x07, 0x15, 0x71, 0x65, 0x60, 0x73,
    0x09, 0x36, 0x15, 0x03, 0x7A,
  ];

  static List<int> _reconstructSecretBytes(List<int> masked, List<int> mask) {
    return List<int>.generate(masked.length, (i) => masked[i] ^ mask[i % mask.length]);
  }

  static List<int> get _secretKeyBytes => _reconstructSecretBytes(_kMaskedKey, _kXorMask);
  static List<int> get _secretSaltBytes => _reconstructSecretBytes(_kMaskedSalt, _kXorMask);

  static bool _constantTimeEquals(String a, String b) {
    if (a.length != b.length) return false;
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      result |= a.codeUnitAt(i) ^ b.codeUnitAt(i);
    }
    return result == 0;
  }

  final Rx<LicenseStatus> licenseStatus = LicenseStatus.unactivated.obs;
  final RxBool onboardingCompleted = false.obs;
  final RxBool clinicSetupCompleted = false.obs;
  final RxBool isLicenseActive = false.obs;
  final RxBool isExpired = false.obs;
  final RxBool isClockTampered = false.obs;
  final RxString deviceFingerprint = ''.obs;
  final RxString deviceRequestCode = ''.obs;
  final RxnString expiryDate = RxnString();
  final RxInt remainingDays = 0.obs;
  final RxBool isLifetime = false.obs;

  /// Clean 12-char uppercase hex fingerprint without dashes
  String get cleanFingerprint => deviceFingerprint.value.replaceAll('-', '').toUpperCase();

  Future<LicenseService> init() async {
    await _initializeLicense();
    return this;
  }

  Future<void> _initializeLicense() async {
    try {
      final fp = await getDeviceFingerprint();
      deviceFingerprint.value = fp;
      deviceRequestCode.value = getDeviceRequestCode(fp);

      await checkLicenseValidity();

      if (kDebugMode) {
        final testCode = generateActivationCode(
          cleanFingerprint: cleanFingerprint,
          expiryDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30)),
        );
        debugPrint('====================================================');
        debugPrint('🔑 [VetPulse Licensing] Device Fingerprint: $deviceFingerprint');
        debugPrint('🔑 [VetPulse Licensing] Device Request Code: ${deviceRequestCode.value}');
        debugPrint('🔑 [VetPulse Licensing] Test 30-Day Activation Code: $testCode');
        debugPrint('🔑 [VetPulse Licensing] Status: ${licenseStatus.value.name}');
        debugPrint('====================================================');
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      debugPrint('Error initializing LicenseService: $e\n$stack');
    }
  }

  /// Collects unique hardware identifiers and computes a 12-char fingerprint formatted as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
  Future<String> getDeviceFingerprint() async {
    final deviceInfo = DeviceInfoPlugin();
    String rawHardware = '';

    try {
      if (kIsWeb) {
        final webInfo = await deviceInfo.webBrowserInfo;
        rawHardware = '${webInfo.userAgent}|${webInfo.vendor}|${webInfo.platform}';
      } else if (Platform.isAndroid) {
        final androidInfo = await deviceInfo.androidInfo;
        rawHardware = [
          androidInfo.id,
          androidInfo.brand,
          androidInfo.model,
          androidInfo.device,
          androidInfo.board,
          androidInfo.hardware,
        ].join('|');
      } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
        final iosInfo = await deviceInfo.iosInfo;
        rawHardware = '${iosInfo.identifierForVendor}|${iosInfo.model}|${iosInfo.systemName}';
      } else if (Platform.isWindows) {
        final winInfo = await deviceInfo.windowsInfo;
        rawHardware = '${winInfo.deviceId}|${winInfo.computerName}|${winInfo.numberOfCores}';
      } else if (Platform.isLinux) {
        final linuxInfo = await deviceInfo.linuxInfo;
        rawHardware = '${linuxInfo.machineId}|${linuxInfo.name}|${linuxInfo.id}';
      } else if (Platform.isMacOS) {
        final macInfo = await deviceInfo.macOsInfo;
        rawHardware = '${macInfo.systemGUID}|${macInfo.computerName}|${macInfo.model}';
      } else {
        rawHardware = Platform.operatingSystem;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error collecting device info: $e');
      rawHardware = 'VETPULSE_GENERIC_FALLBACK_DEVICE';
    }

    if (rawHardware.trim().isEmpty) {
      rawHardware = 'VETPULSE_DEFAULT_HW_STRING';
    }

    final hashBytes = sha256.convert([...utf8.encode('$rawHardware|'), ..._secretSaltBytes]).bytes;
    final hexStr = hashBytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join().toUpperCase();
    final fp12 = hexStr.substring(0, 12);

    return '${fp12.substring(0, 4)}-${fp12.substring(4, 8)}-${fp12.substring(8, 12)}';
  }

  /// Generates the copyable user request string: `VP1-<FP12>-<YYYYMMDD>-<CHK4>`
  String getDeviceRequestCode(String formattedFingerprint) {
    final cleanFp = formattedFingerprint.replaceAll('-', '').toUpperCase();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final ymd = '${now.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}'
        '${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}'
        '${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    final hmac = Hmac(sha256, _secretKeyBytes);
    final chkBytes = hmac.convert(utf8.encode('$cleanFp|$ymd')).bytes;
    final chk4 = chkBytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join().toUpperCase().substring(0, 4);

    return 'VP1-$cleanFp-$ymd-$chk4';
  }

  /// Verifies an activation code and stores the license state upon success
  Future<bool> verifyAndActivateCode(String rawCode) async {
    final code = rawCode.trim().toUpperCase();

    // Code Format: VPACT-<EXPIRY_YYYYMMDD>-<NONCE4>-<SIG12>
    final parts = code.split('-');
    if (parts.length != 4 || parts[0] != 'VPACT') {
      _showFeedback(
        'كود غير صالح',
        'صيغة كود التفعيل غير صحيحة، يجب أن تبدأ بـ VPACT-',
      );
      return false;
    }

    final expiryYmd = parts[1];
    final nonce4 = parts[2];
    final sig12 = parts[3];

    final validHex12 = RegExp(r'^[0-9A-F]{12}$');
    final validYmd = RegExp(r'^\d{8}$');
    if (!validYmd.hasMatch(expiryYmd) || nonce4.length != 4 || !validHex12.hasMatch(sig12)) {
      _showFeedback(
        'كود غير صالح',
        'أجزاء كود التفعيل غير مكتملة أو غير صالحة',
      );
      return false;
    }

    // 1. Verify Signature matches current device's fingerprint (constant-time)
    final hmac = Hmac(sha256, _secretKeyBytes);
    final expectedSigBytes = hmac.convert(utf8.encode('$cleanFingerprint|$expiryYmd|$nonce4')).bytes;
    final expectedSig12 = expectedSigBytes
        .map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'))
        .join()
        .toUpperCase()
        .substring(0, 12);

    if (!_constantTimeEquals(sig12, expectedSig12)) {
      _showFeedback(
        'فشل التفعيل',
        'كود التفعيل غير مخصص لهذا الجهاز ومقفل على بصمة جهاز آخر',
      );
      return false;
    }

    // 2. Verify SHA-256 hash is NOT in used_codes_json
    final db = await DatabaseHelper.instance.database;
    final rowList = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState, limit: 1);
    List<dynamic> usedCodes = [];
    if (rowList.isNotEmpty && rowList.first['used_codes_json'] != null) {
      try {
        usedCodes = jsonDecode(rowList.first['used_codes_json'] as String) as List<dynamic>;
      } catch (_) {
        usedCodes = [];
      }
    }

    final codeHash = sha256.convert(utf8.encode(code)).toString().toUpperCase();
    if (usedCodes.contains(codeHash)) {
      _showFeedback(
        'كود مستخدم مسبقاً',
        'تم استخدام كود التفعيل هذا مسبقاً ولا يمكن تكرار استخدامه بعد انتهاء مدته',
      );
      return false;
    }

    // 3. Verify expiry date
    String formattedExpiryIso;
    bool lifetime = false;
    if (expiryYmd == '99991231') {
      formattedExpiryIso = '9999-12-31';
      lifetime = true;
    } else {
      final year = int.tryParse(expiryYmd.substring(0, 4));
      final month = int.tryParse(expiryYmd.substring(4, 6));
      final day = int.tryParse(expiryYmd.substring(6, 8));

      if (year == null || month == null || day == null) {
        _showFeedback('فشل التفعيل', 'تاريخ انتهاء الترخيص في الكود غير صالح');
        return false;
      }

      final expiryDt = DateTime(year, month, day, 23, 59, 59);
      if (expiryDt.isBefore(DateTime.now())) {
        _showFeedback(
          'كود منتهي',
          'كود التفعيل المدخل منتهي الصلاحية بالفعل',
        );
        return false;
      }

      formattedExpiryIso =
          '${year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    }

    // Update persistent state
    usedCodes.add(codeHash);
    final nowIso = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

    await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState,
      {
        'activation_code': code,
        'activated_at': nowIso,
        'expiry_date': formattedExpiryIso,
        'last_seen_timestamp': nowIso,
        'used_codes_json': jsonEncode(usedCodes),
      },
      where: 'id = 1',
    );

    // Update in-memory reactive state
    licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.active;
    isLicenseActive.value = true;
    isExpired.value = false;
    isClockTampered.value = false;
    isLifetime.value = lifetime;
    expiryDate.value = formattedExpiryIso;
    _computeRemainingDays(formattedExpiryIso, lifetime);

    _showFeedback(
      'تم التفعيل بنجاح! 🎉',
      lifetime
          ? 'تم توثيق ترخيص النظام الدائم للعيادة'
          : 'تم تفعيل النسخة حتى $formattedExpiryIso (متبقي ${remainingDays.value} يوم)',
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
    );

    return true;
  }

  void _showFeedback(String title, String message, {Duration? duration}) {
    if (Get.context != null) {
      try {
        Get.snackbar(
          title,
          message,
          snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
          duration: duration ?? const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /// Checks persistent database state, clock-rollback tampering, and expiration date
  Future<LicenseStatus> checkLicenseValidity() async {
    final db = await DatabaseHelper.instance.database;
    final res = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState, limit: 1);

    if (res.isEmpty) {
      final fp = deviceFingerprint.value.isNotEmpty ? deviceFingerprint.value : await getDeviceFingerprint();
      deviceFingerprint.value = fp;
      deviceRequestCode.value = getDeviceRequestCode(fp);

      final nowIso = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();
      await db.insert(DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState, {
        'id': 1,
        'onboarding_completed': 0,
        'clinic_setup_completed': 0,
        'device_fingerprint': fp,
        'activation_code': null,
        'activated_at': null,
        'expiry_date': null,
        'last_seen_timestamp': nowIso,
        'used_codes_json': '[]',
      });

      onboardingCompleted.value = false;
      clinicSetupCompleted.value = false;
      isLicenseActive.value = false;
      isExpired.value = false;
      isClockTampered.value = false;
      licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.unactivated;
      return LicenseStatus.unactivated;
    }

    final row = res.first;
    onboardingCompleted.value = (row['onboarding_completed'] as int? ?? 0) == 1;
    clinicSetupCompleted.value = (row['clinic_setup_completed'] as int? ?? 0) == 1;

    final actCode = row['activation_code'] as String?;
    final expiry = row['expiry_date'] as String?;
    final lastSeen = row['last_seen_timestamp'] as String?;

    if (actCode == null || actCode.isEmpty || expiry == null || expiry.isEmpty) {
      isLicenseActive.value = false;
      isExpired.value = false;
      isClockTampered.value = false;
      licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.unactivated;
      return LicenseStatus.unactivated;
    }

    // Clock Tamper Detection (check if clock was turned back > 6 hours)
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (lastSeen != null && lastSeen.isNotEmpty) {
      final lastSeenDt = DateTime.tryParse(lastSeen);
      if (lastSeenDt != null) {
        final diff = now.difference(lastSeenDt);
        if (diff.inMinutes < -360) {
          isClockTampered.value = true;
          isLicenseActive.value = false;
          licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.clockTampered;
          return LicenseStatus.clockTampered;
        }
      }
    }

    // Update last seen timestamp
    await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState,
      {'last_seen_timestamp': now.toIso8601String()},
      where: 'id = 1',
    );

    // Expiration check
    final lifetime = expiry == '9999-12-31';
    isLifetime.value = lifetime;
    expiryDate.value = expiry;

    final todayStr = now.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    if (!lifetime && todayStr.compareTo(expiry) > 0) {
      isExpired.value = true;
      isLicenseActive.value = false;
      licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.expired;
      remainingDays.value = 0;
      return LicenseStatus.expired;
    }

    // Active
    isLicenseActive.value = true;
    isExpired.value = false;
    isClockTampered.value = false;
    licenseStatus.value = LicenseStatus.active;
    _computeRemainingDays(expiry, lifetime);
    return LicenseStatus.active;
  }

  void _computeRemainingDays(String expiryIso, bool lifetime) {
    if (lifetime) {
      remainingDays.value = 9999;
      return;
    }
    try {
      final parts = expiryIso.split('-');
      final expDt = DateTime(int.parse(parts[0]), int.parse(parts[1]), int.parse(parts[2]), 23, 59, 59);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final diffDays = expDt.difference(now).inDays + 1;
      remainingDays.value = diffDays > 0 ? diffDays : 0;
    } catch (_) {
      remainingDays.value = 0;
    }
  }

  Future<void> completeOnboarding() async {
    final db = await DatabaseHelper.instance.database;
    await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState,
      {'onboarding_completed': 1},
      where: 'id = 1',
    );
    onboardingCompleted.value = true;
  }

  Future<void> completeClinicSetup() async {
    final db = await DatabaseHelper.instance.database;
    await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableAppLicenseState,
      {'clinic_setup_completed': 1},
      where: 'id = 1',
    );
    clinicSetupCompleted.value = true;
  }

  /// Helper used by developer keygen tool and test generator
  static String generateActivationCode({
    required String cleanFingerprint,
    required DateTime expiryDate,
    String? nonce,
  }) {
    final cleanFp = cleanFingerprint.replaceAll('-', '').toUpperCase();
    final ymd = expiryDate.year >= 9999
        ? '99991231'
        : '${expiryDate.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}'
            '${expiryDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}'
            '${expiryDate.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    final nonce4 = (nonce ?? '9A7F').toUpperCase().padLeft(4, '0').substring(0, 4);

    final hmac = Hmac(sha256, _secretKeyBytes);
    final sigBytes = hmac.convert(utf8.encode('$cleanFp|$ymd|$nonce4')).bytes;
    final sig12 = sigBytes
        .map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'))
        .join()
        .toUpperCase()
        .substring(0, 12);

    return 'VPACT-$ymd-$nonce4-$sig12';
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';
import 'package:timezone/data/latest_all.dart' as tz;
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;
import '../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';

class NotificationService extends GetxService {
  static NotificationService get to => Get.find<NotificationService>();

  static const String channelId = 'vet_pulse_clinical_alerts';
  static const String channelName = 'تنبيهات العمليات والمواعيد البيطرية';
  static const String channelDescription =
      'إشعارات وتنبيهات العمليات الجراحية ومواعيد المراجعات السريرية';

  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin =
      FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

  final RxBool hasNotificationPermission = false.obs;
  final Set<String> _recordedKeys = <String>{};
  File? _dedupFile;

  static const AndroidNotificationDetails _androidNotificationDetails =
      AndroidNotificationDetails(
    channelId,
    channelName,
    channelDescription: channelDescription,
    importance: Importance.max,
    priority: Priority.high,
    playSound: true,
    enableVibration: true,
  );

  static const NotificationDetails _notificationDetails = NotificationDetails(
    android: _androidNotificationDetails,
  );

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    _initLocalNotifications();
    checkPermissionStatus();
  }

  Future<void> _initLocalNotifications() async {
    try {
      tz.initializeTimeZones();
      try {
        tz.setLocalLocation(tz.getLocation('Asia/Aden'));
      } catch (_) {
        try {
          tz.setLocalLocation(tz.getLocation('Asia/Riyadh'));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: timezone init error: $e');
    }

    try {
      await _initDeduplicationTracker();

      const AndroidInitializationSettings initializationSettingsAndroid =
          AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher');
      const DarwinInitializationSettings initializationSettingsDarwin =
          DarwinInitializationSettings();
      const InitializationSettings initializationSettings =
          InitializationSettings(
        android: initializationSettingsAndroid,
        iOS: initializationSettingsDarwin,
      );

      await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.initialize(
        initializationSettings,
        onDidReceiveNotificationResponse: (NotificationResponse response) {
          debugPrint('Notification tapped with payload: ${response.payload}');
        },
      );

      // Create high-priority Android Notification Channel
      const AndroidNotificationChannel channel = AndroidNotificationChannel(
        channelId,
        channelName,
        description: channelDescription,
        importance: Importance.max,
        playSound: true,
        enableVibration: true,
      );

      final androidPlugin = flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin
          .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
              AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>();
      if (androidPlugin != null) {
        await androidPlugin.createNotificationChannel(channel);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: local notifications init error: $e');
    }
  }

  // --- Deduplication Tracker ---

  Future<void> _initDeduplicationTracker() async {
    try {
      final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
      _dedupFile = File('${dir.path}/notification_dedup_keys.json');
      if (await _dedupFile!.exists()) {
        final content = await _dedupFile!.readAsString();
        final List<dynamic> list = jsonDecode(content) as List<dynamic>;
        _recordedKeys.addAll(list.map((e) => e.toString()));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: error loading deduplication file: $e');
    }
  }

  bool isNotificationRecorded(String key) => _recordedKeys.contains(key);

  Future<void> markNotificationRecorded(String key) async {
    if (_recordedKeys.contains(key)) return;
    _recordedKeys.add(key);
    await _persistRecordedKeys();
  }

  Future<void> removeNotificationKey(String key) async {
    if (_recordedKeys.remove(key)) {
      await _persistRecordedKeys();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _persistRecordedKeys() async {
    try {
      if (_dedupFile != null) {
        await _dedupFile!.writeAsString(jsonEncode(_recordedKeys.toList()));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: error persisting deduplication keys: $e');
    }
  }

  // --- Core Notification Methods ---

  Future<void> showInstantNotification({
    required int id,
    required String title,
    required String body,
    String? payload,
  }) async {
    try {
      await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.show(
        id,
        title,
        body,
        _notificationDetails,
        payload: payload,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: showInstantNotification error: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> scheduleNotification({
    required int id,
    required String title,
    required String body,
    required DateTime scheduledTime,
    String? payload,
  }) async {
    if (scheduledTime.isBefore(DateTime.now())) return;

    final tz.TZDateTime tzScheduledTime =
        tz.TZDateTime.from(scheduledTime, tz.local);

    try {
      await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.zonedSchedule(
        id,
        title,
        body,
        tzScheduledTime,
        _notificationDetails,
        androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.exactAllowWhileIdle,
        uiLocalNotificationDateInterpretation:
            UILocalNotificationDateInterpretation.absoluteTime,
        payload: payload,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint(
          'NotificationService: exact alarm failed, falling back to inexact: $e');
      try {
        await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.zonedSchedule(
          id,
          title,
          body,
          tzScheduledTime,
          _notificationDetails,
          androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
          uiLocalNotificationDateInterpretation:
              UILocalNotificationDateInterpretation.absoluteTime,
          payload: payload,
        );
      } catch (e2) {
        debugPrint('NotificationService: scheduleNotification fallback error: $e2');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> cancelNotification(int id) async {
    try {
      await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.cancel(id);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: cancelNotification error: $e');
    }
  }

  // --- Surgery Reminders (12h, 6h, 1h) ---

  Future<void> scheduleSurgeryReminders(SurgeryModel surgery) async {
    if (surgery.id == null) return;
    if (surgery.status != 'scheduled') {
      await cancelSurgeryReminders(surgery.id!);
      return;
    }

    final parsedDate = parseDateTime(surgery.scheduledDate, null);
    if (parsedDate == null) return;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final remaining = parsedDate.difference(now);

    // If surgery date has passed by more than 2 hours, skip
    if (remaining < -const Duration(hours: 2)) return;

    final petName = surgery.petName?.isNotEmpty == true ? surgery.petName! : 'المريض';
    final surgeryName = surgery.surgeryName;

    final windows = [
      (
        duration: const Duration(hours: 12),
        idOffset: 1,
        keySuffix: '12h',
        title: 'تذكير موعد عملية جراحية (خلال 12 ساعة)',
        body: 'العملية: $surgeryName للمريض $petName - الموعد: ${surgery.scheduledDate}',
      ),
      (
        duration: const Duration(hours: 6),
        idOffset: 2,
        keySuffix: '6h',
        title: 'تنبيه موعد عملية جراحية (خلال 6 ساعات)',
        body: 'العملية: $surgeryName للمريض $petName - يرجى التأكد من صيام الحيوان وتجهيز المعدات',
      ),
      (
        duration: const Duration(hours: 1),
        idOffset: 3,
        keySuffix: '1h',
        title: 'عاجل: موعد عملية جراحية (خلال ساعة واحدة)',
        body: 'العملية: $surgeryName للمريض $petName ستبدأ قريباً!',
      ),
    ];

    for (final w in windows) {
      final reminderTime = parsedDate.subtract(w.duration);
      final notifId = surgery.id! * 10 + w.idOffset;
      final key = 'surgery_${surgery.id}_${w.keySuffix}';

      if (reminderTime.isAfter(now)) {
        // Future reminder: schedule OS notification
        await scheduleNotification(
          id: notifId,
          title: w.title,
          body: w.body,
          scheduledTime: reminderTime,
          payload: 'surgery_${surgery.id}',
        );
        await markNotificationRecorded(key);
      } else {
        // Window reminder time already reached.
        // Check if currently within active window and not sent yet.
        if (remaining <= w.duration && remaining > -const Duration(minutes: 30)) {
          if (!isNotificationRecorded(key)) {
            // Determine if a more urgent window also passed to prevent spamming multiple alerts at once
            final isSuperSeded = (w.keySuffix == '12h' && remaining <= const Duration(hours: 6)) ||
                (w.keySuffix == '6h' && remaining <= const Duration(hours: 1));

            if (!isSuperSeded) {
              await showInstantNotification(
                id: notifId,
                title: w.title,
                body: w.body,
                payload: 'surgery_${surgery.id}',
              );
            }
            await markNotificationRecorded(key);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> cancelSurgeryReminders(int surgeryId) async {
    await cancelNotification(surgeryId * 10 + 1);
    await cancelNotification(surgeryId * 10 + 2);
    await cancelNotification(surgeryId * 10 + 3);
    await removeNotificationKey('surgery_${surgeryId}_12h');
    await removeNotificationKey('surgery_${surgeryId}_6h');
    await removeNotificationKey('surgery_${surgeryId}_1h');
  }

  // --- Follow-Up Reminders ---

  Future<void> scheduleFollowUpReminder(FollowUpModel followUp) async {
    if (followUp.id == null) return;
    if (followUp.status != 'pending') {
      await cancelFollowUpReminder(followUp.id!);
      return;
    }

    final parsedDate = parseDateTime(followUp.scheduledDate, followUp.scheduledTime);
    if (parsedDate == null) return;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final remaining = parsedDate.difference(now);
    final petName = followUp.petName?.isNotEmpty == true ? followUp.petName! : 'المريض';
    final reason = followUp.reason.isNotEmpty ? followUp.reason : 'متابعة سريرية';

    final notifId = followUp.id! * 10 + 4;
    final key = 'followup_${followUp.id}_due';

    if (parsedDate.isAfter(now)) {
      // Future follow-up: schedule OS notification
      await scheduleNotification(
        id: notifId,
        title: 'تذكير بموعد مراجعة سريرية',
        body: 'موعد مراجعة للمريض $petName - الموضوع: $reason',
        scheduledTime: parsedDate,
        payload: 'followup_${followUp.id}',
      );
      await markNotificationRecorded(key);
    } else {
      // Due today or overdue
      final isToday = parsedDate.year == now.year &&
          parsedDate.month == now.month &&
          parsedDate.day == now.day;

      if ((isToday || remaining.isNegative) && remaining > -const Duration(days: 3)) {
        if (!isNotificationRecorded(key)) {
          await showInstantNotification(
            id: notifId,
            title: isToday
                ? 'موعد مراجعة مستحق اليوم'
                : 'تنبيه: موعد مراجعة متأخر ومستحق',
            body: 'مراجعة للمريض $petName ($reason) - يرجى التواصل مع المالك',
            payload: 'followup_${followUp.id}',
          );
          await markNotificationRecorded(key);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> cancelFollowUpReminder(int followUpId) async {
    await cancelNotification(followUpId * 10 + 4);
    await removeNotificationKey('followup_${followUpId}_due');
  }

  // --- Shared Date & Time Parser ---

  static DateTime? parseDateTime(String dateStr, String? timeStr) {
    try {
      final cleanDate = dateStr.trim().split(' ').first;
      final parts = cleanDate.split('-');
      if (parts.length != 3) return null;
      final year = int.parse(parts[0]);
      final month = int.parse(parts[1]);
      final day = int.parse(parts[2]);

      int hour = 9;
      int minute = 0;

      final checkTime = timeStr ??
          (dateStr.trim().contains(' ')
              ? dateStr.trim().split(' ').sublist(1).join(' ')
              : null);

      if (checkTime != null && checkTime.isNotEmpty) {
        final isPm =
            checkTime.contains('م') || checkTime.toLowerCase().contains('pm');
        final rawNumbers = RegExp(r'(\d+):(\d+)').firstMatch(checkTime);
        if (rawNumbers != null) {
          hour = int.parse(rawNumbers.group(1)!);
          minute = int.parse(rawNumbers.group(2)!);
          if (isPm && hour < 12) hour += 12;
          if (!isPm &&
              hour == 12 &&
              (checkTime.contains('ص') ||
                  checkTime.toLowerCase().contains('am'))) {
            hour = 0;
          }
        }
      }
      return DateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // --- Permissions Management ---

  Future<void> checkPermissionStatus() async {
    try {
      final status = await Permission.notification.status;
      hasNotificationPermission.value = status.isGranted;
    } catch (_) {
      hasNotificationPermission.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> requestNotificationPermission({bool showDialogIfDenied = true}) async {
    try {
      final status = await Permission.notification.request();
      hasNotificationPermission.value = status.isGranted;

      // Request exact alarm permission if available on modern Android
      try {
        final exactStatus = await Permission.scheduleExactAlarm.status;
        if (exactStatus.isDenied) {
          await Permission.scheduleExactAlarm.request();
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      if (status.isGranted) {
        Get.snackbar(
          'تم تفعيل الإشعارات بنجاح',
          'ستصلك تنبيهات العمليات الجراحية ومواعيد المراجعات على هاتفك',
          backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
          colorText: Colors.green.shade900,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.notifications_active, color: Colors.green),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
        return true;
      } else if (status.isPermanentlyDenied && showDialogIfDenied) {
        _showOpenSettingsDialog();
        return false;
      } else {
        if (showDialogIfDenied) {
          Get.snackbar(
            'تنبيه الإشعارات',
            'يرجى السماح بصلاحية الإشعارات لتصلك تنبيهات العمليات والمراجعات البيطرية',
            backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100,
            colorText: Colors.brown.shade900,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.notifications_off, color: Colors.amber),
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          );
        }
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('NotificationService: error requesting permission: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _showOpenSettingsDialog() {
    Get.dialog(
      AlertDialog(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.notifications_paused, color: Colors.orange),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('تفعيل إشعارات التطبيق'),
          ],
        ),
        content: const Text(
          'تم رفض صلاحية الإشعارات مسبقاً. للحصول على تذكيرات العمليات الجراحية ومواعيد المراجعات التلقائية، يرجى تفعيل الإشعارات من إعدادات الهاتف.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Get.back(),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Get.back();
              openAppSettings();
            },
            child: const Text('فتح الإعدادات'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../constants/app_colors.dart';

class CustomTextField extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final String? hint;
  final TextEditingController? controller;
  final String? initialValue;
  final bool obscureText;
  final TextInputType keyboardType;
  final int maxLines;
  final Widget? prefixIcon;
  final Widget? suffixIcon;
  final String? prefixText;
  final Widget? prefix;
  final TextDirection? textDirection;
  final int? maxLength;
  final String? Function(String?)? validator;
  final void Function(String)? onChanged;
  final void Function(String)? onSubmitted;
  final bool readOnly;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;

  const CustomTextField({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    this.hint,
    this.controller,
    this.initialValue,
    this.obscureText = false,
    this.keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    this.maxLines = 1,
    this.prefixIcon,
    this.suffixIcon,
    this.prefixText,
    this.prefix,
    this.textDirection,
    this.maxLength,
    this.validator,
    this.onChanged,
    this.onSubmitted,
    this.readOnly = false,
    this.onTap,
    this.inputFormatters,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: AppColors.textPrimary,
              ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        TextFormField(
          controller: controller,
          initialValue: initialValue,
          obscureText: obscureText,
          keyboardType: keyboardType,
          maxLines: maxLines,
          readOnly: readOnly,
          onTap: onTap,
          validator: validator,
          onChanged: onChanged,
          onFieldSubmitted: onSubmitted,
          inputFormatters: inputFormatters,
          textDirection: textDirection ?? TextDirection.rtl,
          maxLength: maxLength,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: hint,
            prefixIcon: prefixIcon,
            suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
            prefixText: prefixText,
            prefix: prefix,
            counterText: '',
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/models/customer_payment_model.dart">
class CustomerPaymentModel {
  final int? id;
  final int ownerId;
  final int? transactionId;
  final double amount;
  final String paymentMethod;
  final String paymentDate;
  final String? receiptNumber;
  final String? notes;
  final String? createdAt;

  // Joined fields
  final String? ownerName;
  final String? ownerPhone;

  CustomerPaymentModel({
    this.id,
    required this.ownerId,
    this.transactionId,
    required this.amount,
    this.paymentMethod = 'نقدا',
    required this.paymentDate,
    this.receiptNumber,
    this.notes,
    this.createdAt,
    this.ownerName,
    this.ownerPhone,
  });

  factory CustomerPaymentModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return CustomerPaymentModel(
      id: map['id'] as int?,
      ownerId: map['owner_id'] as int? ?? 0,
      transactionId: map['transaction_id'] as int?,
      amount: (map['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      paymentMethod: map['payment_method'] as String? ?? 'نقدا',
      paymentDate: map['payment_date'] as String? ?? '',
      receiptNumber: map['receipt_number'] as String?,
      notes: map['notes'] as String?,
      createdAt: map['created_at'] as String?,
      ownerName: map['owner_name'] as String?,
      ownerPhone: map['owner_phone'] as String?,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    final map = <String, dynamic>{
      'owner_id': ownerId,
      'amount': amount,
      'payment_method': paymentMethod,
      'payment_date': paymentDate,
      'receipt_number': receiptNumber,
      'notes': notes,
    };
    if (id != null) map['id'] = id;
    if (transactionId != null) map['transaction_id'] = transactionId;
    if (createdAt != null) map['created_at'] = createdAt;
    return map;
  }

  String get paymentMethodDisplayArabic {
    switch (paymentMethod) {
      case 'deferred':
      case 'آجل':
        return 'آجل (مديونية)';
      case 'cash':
      case 'نقدا':
        return 'نقدا';
      case 'jawali':
      case 'جوالي':
        return 'جوالي';
      case 'jeeb':
      case 'جيب':
        return 'جيب';
      case 'kuraimi':
      case 'كريمي':
        return 'كريمي';
      case 'floosak':
      case 'فلوسك':
        return 'فلوسك';
      default:
        return paymentMethod.isNotEmpty ? paymentMethod : 'نقدا';
    }
  }

  String get formattedDate {
    if (paymentDate.length >= 10) {
      return paymentDate.substring(0, 10);
    }
    return paymentDate;
  }
}
