  Widget _buildBackupItemCard(DatabaseBackupInfo b) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 1,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.blue.shade50,
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                Icons.folder_zip_rounded,
                color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                size: 20,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    b.fileName,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    '${b.formattedDate} | الحجم: ${b.formattedSize}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      color: AppColors.textSecondary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Obx(() {
              final canRestore = controller.canRestore;
              final loading = controller.isLoading.value;

              return Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: canRestore
                        ? 'استعادة هذه النسخة'
                        : 'تتطلب صلاحية Lead Doctor',
                    icon: Icon(
                      Icons.restore_page_rounded,
                      color: canRestore ? Colors.orange.shade800 : Colors.grey,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    onPressed: canRestore && !loading
                        ? () => controller.confirmAndRestore(b.path)
                        : null,
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'حذف من الجهاز',
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.delete_outline,
                      color: AppColors.critical,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    onPressed: !loading
                        ? () => controller.confirmAndDelete(b.path)
                        : null,
                  ),
                ],
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // --- TAB 3: AUDIT LOGS ---
  Widget _buildLogsTab() {
    return Obx(() {
      final logs = controller.backupLogs;
      if (logs.isEmpty) {
        return const Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.history_outlined, size: 48, color: Colors.grey),
              SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                'لا توجد سجلات نسخ أو استعادة سابقة',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: AppColors.darkNeutral,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                'جميع عمليات النسخ الداخلي والخارجي والاستعادة ستوثق هنا تلقائياً',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textSecondary),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      }

      return ListView.separated(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: logs.length,
        separatorBuilder: (context, index) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final log = logs[index];
          final isSuccess = log.status == 'success';
          final color = isSuccess ? AppColors.success : AppColors.critical;

          return Card(
            elevation: 1,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    ),
                    child: Icon(
                      isSuccess
                          ? Icons.check_circle_outline
                          : Icons.error_outline,
                      color: color,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Flexible(
                              child: Text(
                                log.backupName,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                ),
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8,
                                vertical: 2,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                log.typeDisplayArabic,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: color,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                          '${log.createdAt} | الحجم: ${log.formattedSize}${log.destination != null ? ' | الوجهة: ${log.destination}' : ''}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            color: AppColors.textSecondary,
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (log.errorMessage != null) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            'خطأ: ${log.errorMessage}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: AppColors.critical,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );
    });
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/consultations/controllers/new_consultation_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/config/demo_config.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_payment_methods.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/pet_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/surgery_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/user_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';
import '../../../routes/app_routes.dart';
import '../../auth/controllers/auth_controller.dart';
import 'prescription_item_controller.dart';

class NewConsultationController extends GetxController {
  final ConsultationRepository consultationRepo;
  final PetRepository petRepo;
  final AuthRepository authRepo;
  final SurgeryRepository surgeryRepo;
  final AppointmentRepository appointmentRepo;
  final PrescriptionItemController prescriptionController;

  NewConsultationController({
    ConsultationRepository? consultationRepo,
    PetRepository? petRepo,
    AuthRepository? authRepo,
    SurgeryRepository? surgeryRepo,
    AppointmentRepository? appointmentRepo,
    PrescriptionItemController? prescriptionController,
  })  : consultationRepo = consultationRepo ?? Get.find<ConsultationRepository>(),
        petRepo = petRepo ?? Get.find<PetRepository>(),
        authRepo = authRepo ?? Get.find<AuthRepository>(),
        surgeryRepo = surgeryRepo ?? Get.find<SurgeryRepository>(),
        appointmentRepo = appointmentRepo ?? Get.find<AppointmentRepository>(),
        prescriptionController = prescriptionController ?? Get.find<PrescriptionItemController>();

  final Rx<PetModel?> selectedPet = Rx<PetModel?>(null);
  final RxList<PetModel> allPets = <PetModel>[].obs;
  final Rx<ClinicModel?> clinicInfo = Rx<ClinicModel?>(null);
  final RxList<UserModel> availableSurgeons = <UserModel>[].obs;

  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;

  // SOAP Inputs
  final tempController = TextEditingController();
  final heartRateController = TextEditingController();
  final symptomsController = TextEditingController(); // Subjective
  final findingsController = TextEditingController(); // Objective
  final diagnosisController = TextEditingController(); // Assessment
  final planController = TextEditingController(); // Plan

  // Financial Settlement
  final costController = TextEditingController(text: '5000'); // Yemeni Rial
  final paidAmountController = TextEditingController(text: '5000');
  final RxDouble remainingAmount = 0.0.obs;
  final RxString selectedPaymentMethod = AppPaymentMethods.cash.obs;
  final RxBool showCostInPrescription = true.obs;

  bool get isDeferredPayment => selectedPaymentMethod.value == AppPaymentMethods.deferred;

  void setPaymentMethod(String method) {
    final oldMethod = selectedPaymentMethod.value;
    selectedPaymentMethod.value = method;
    if (method == AppPaymentMethods.deferred) {
      paidAmountController.text = '0';
      updateRemainingAmount();
    } else if (oldMethod == AppPaymentMethods.deferred) {
      if (paidAmountController.text.trim() == '0' || paidAmountController.text.trim() == '0.0') {
        paidAmountController.text = costController.text.trim();
      }
      updateRemainingAmount();
    }
  }

  // Surgery Option
  final RxBool needSurgery = false.obs;
  final surgeryNameController = TextEditingController();
  final surgeryCategoryController = TextEditingController(text: AppStringsAr.categoryElective);
  final surgeryDateController = TextEditingController();
  final surgeryTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '09:00 ص');
  final Rx<UserModel?> selectedSurgeon = Rx<UserModel?>(null);
  final surgeryCostController = TextEditingController(text: '25000');
  final surgeryNotesController = TextEditingController();

  // Consecutive Treatment Plan Option
  final RxBool needTreatmentPlan = false.obs;
  final planReasonController = TextEditingController(text: 'إبر مضادات حيوية ومتابعة بالعيادة');
  final planDaysController = TextEditingController(text: '3');
  final planTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '10:00 ص');
  final planStartDateController = TextEditingController();
  final planNotesController = TextEditingController();

  // Created Consultation for Preview
  final Rx<ConsultationModel?> lastCreatedConsultation = Rx<ConsultationModel?>(null);

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    final args = Get.arguments;
    if (args is PetModel) {
      selectedPet.value = args;
      if (args.latestWeight != null) {
        prescriptionController.calcWeightController.text = args.latestWeight.toString();
      }
    } else if (args is int) {
      _loadPetById(args);
    }

    surgeryDateController.text =
        DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    planStartDateController.text =
        DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);

    costController.addListener(updateRemainingAmount);
    paidAmountController.addListener(updateRemainingAmount);
    updateRemainingAmount();
    loadData();
  }

  Future<void> _loadPetById(int petId) async {
    try {
      final pet = await petRepo.getPetById(petId);
      if (pet != null) {
        selectedPet.value = pet;
        if (pet.latestWeight != null) {
          prescriptionController.calcWeightController.text = pet.latestWeight.toString();
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading pet by id in NewConsultationController: $e');
    }
  }

  void updateRemainingAmount() {
    final cost = double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
    if (isDeferredPayment) {
      remainingAmount.value = cost;
      return;
    }
    final paid = double.tryParse(paidAmountController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
    remainingAmount.value = (cost - paid).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final pets = await petRepo.getAllPets();
      allPets.assignAll(pets);

      // If selectedPet is still null and petId was passed via arguments, match from allPets
      if (selectedPet.value == null && Get.arguments is int) {
        final petId = Get.arguments as int;
        final match = pets.cast<PetModel?>().firstWhere((p) => p?.id == petId, orElse: () => null);
        if (match != null) {
          selectedPet.value = match;
          if (match.latestWeight != null) {
            prescriptionController.calcWeightController.text = match.latestWeight.toString();
          }
        }
      }

      clinicInfo.value = await authRepo.getClinicInfo();

      final allUsers = await authRepo.getAllUsers();
      availableSurgeons.assignAll(allUsers.where((u) => u.canPerformSurgeries));
      if (availableSurgeons.isNotEmpty) {
        selectedSurgeon.value = availableSurgeons.first;
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> saveConsultation() async {
    if (!await DemoConfig.canAddConsultation()) {
      return;
    }

    if (selectedPet.value == null) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى اختيار المريض أولاً', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final diagnosis = diagnosisController.text.trim();
    if (diagnosis.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'التشخيص الطبي (Assessment) مطلوب', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final auth = Get.find<AuthController>();
    final doctorId = auth.currentUser.value?.id ?? 1;

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final allPrescriptions = prescriptionController.buildAllPrescriptions();

      final consultation = ConsultationModel(
        petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
        doctorId: doctorId,
        visitDate: DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        temperature: double.tryParse(tempController.text.trim()),
        heartRate: int.tryParse(heartRateController.text.trim()),
        symptoms: symptomsController.text.trim(),
        examinationFindings: findingsController.text.trim(),
        diagnosis: diagnosis,
        treatmentPlan: planController.text.trim(),
        visitCost: double.tryParse(costController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
        paidAmount: isDeferredPayment ? 0.0 : (double.tryParse(paidAmountController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0),
        paymentMethod: selectedPaymentMethod.value,
        petName: selectedPet.value!.name,
        petSpecies: selectedPet.value!.species,
        ownerName: selectedPet.value!.ownerName,
        ownerId: selectedPet.value!.ownerId,
        doctorName: auth.currentUser.value?.fullName ?? 'د. عبدالله خالد',
        prescriptions: allPrescriptions,
      );

      final id = await consultationRepo.createConsultationWithPrescriptions(
        consultation: consultation,
        prescriptions: allPrescriptions,
      );

      final created = consultation.copyWith(id: id);
      lastCreatedConsultation.value = created;

      SurgeryModel? createdSurgery;
      final List<FollowUpModel> createdFollowUps = [];

      // 1. Create surgery if requested
      if (needSurgery.value && surgeryNameController.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        final sDate = surgeryDateController.text.trim();
        final sTime = surgeryTimeController.text.trim();
        final fullDateTime = sDate.isNotEmpty
            ? '$sDate $sTime'
            : '${DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10)} 09:00 ص';

        final surgery = SurgeryModel(
          petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
          leadSurgeonId: selectedSurgeon.value?.id ?? doctorId,
          scheduledDate: fullDateTime,
          surgeryName: surgeryNameController.text.trim(),
          surgeryCategory: surgeryCategoryController.text.trim(),
          estimatedCost: double.tryParse(surgeryCostController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0,
          anesthesiaProtocol: 'بروتوكول عام وفق حالة الحيوان',
          postOpNotes: surgeryNotesController.text.trim(),
          surgeonName: selectedSurgeon.value?.fullName ?? auth.currentUser.value?.fullName,
          petName: selectedPet.value?.name,
          petSpecies: selectedPet.value?.species,
        );
        final surgeryId = await surgeryRepo.insertSurgery(surgery);
        createdSurgery = surgery.copyWith(id: surgeryId);
      }

      // 2. Create consecutive treatment plan follow-ups if requested
      if (needTreatmentPlan.value) {
        final days = int.tryParse(planDaysController.text.trim()) ?? 3;
        final startDateStr = planStartDateController.text.trim();
        DateTime startDate = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1));
        if (startDateStr.isNotEmpty) {
          final parsed = DateTime.tryParse(startDateStr);
          if (parsed != null) startDate = parsed;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < days; i++) {
          final followUpDate =
              startDate.add(Duration(days: i)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
          final dayLabel = ' (اليوم ${i + 1} من $days)';
          final followUp = FollowUpModel(
            petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
            consultationId: id,
            scheduledDate: followUpDate,
            scheduledTime: planTimeController.text.trim(),
            reason: '${planReasonController.text.trim()}$dayLabel',
            notes: planNotesController.text.trim(),
            petName: selectedPet.value?.name,
            petSpecies: selectedPet.value?.species,
          );
          final followUpId = await appointmentRepo.insertFollowUp(followUp);
          createdFollowUps.add(followUp.copyWith(id: followUpId));
        }
      }

      // Wrap sync in try-catch so listener issues never block navigation
      try {
        DataSyncService.notifyConsultationChanged(petId: selectedPet.value!.id!);
      } catch (syncErr) {
        debugPrint('Sync listener error ignored during consultation save: $syncErr');
      }

      // Execute navigation FIRST
      await Get.offNamed(
        AppRoutes.prescriptionPreview,
        arguments: {
          'consultation': created,
          'showCost': showCostInPrescription.value,
          'scheduledSurgery': createdSurgery,
          'followUpSessions': createdFollowUps,
        },
      );

      // Trigger snackbar AFTER route transition starts
      Get.snackbar(
        'نجاح الكشف السريري',
        'تم حفظ الكشف السريري بنجاح',
        backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
        colorText: Colors.green.shade900,
      );
    } catch (e, stack) {
      debugPrint('Error saving consultation: $e\n$stack');
      Get.snackbar(
        'خطأ في الحفظ',
        'تعذر حفظ الكشف السريري: $e',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100,
        colorText: Colors.red.shade900,
      );
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    costController.removeListener(updateRemainingAmount);
    paidAmountController.removeListener(updateRemainingAmount);

    tempController.dispose();
    heartRateController.dispose();
    symptomsController.dispose();
    findingsController.dispose();
    diagnosisController.dispose();
    planController.dispose();

    costController.dispose();
    paidAmountController.dispose();

    surgeryNameController.dispose();
    surgeryCategoryController.dispose();
    surgeryDateController.dispose();
    surgeryTimeController.dispose();
    surgeryCostController.dispose();
    surgeryNotesController.dispose();

    planReasonController.dispose();
    planDaysController.dispose();
    planTimeController.dispose();
    planStartDateController.dispose();
    planNotesController.dispose();

    super.onClose();
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/dashboard/bindings/dashboard_binding.dart">
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/financial_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/reports_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';
import '../controllers/alerts_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/dashboard_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/weekly_reports_controller.dart';
import '../../auth/controllers/auth_controller.dart';

class DashboardBinding extends Bindings {
  @override
  void dependencies() {
    // Repositories
    Get.lazyPut<PetRepository>(() => PetRepository(), fenix: true);
    Get.lazyPut<FinancialRepository>(() => FinancialRepository(), fenix: true);
    Get.lazyPut<ConsultationRepository>(() => ConsultationRepository());
    Get.lazyPut<AppointmentRepository>(() => AppointmentRepository());
    Get.lazyPut<InventoryRepository>(() => InventoryRepository());
    Get.lazyPut<SurgeryRepository>(() => SurgeryRepository());
    Get.lazyPut<ReportsRepository>(() => ReportsRepository());

    // Controllers
    Get.lazyPut<DashboardController>(
      () => DashboardController(
        consultationRepo: Get.find<ConsultationRepository>(),
        appointmentRepo: Get.find<AppointmentRepository>(),
        inventoryRepo: Get.find<InventoryRepository>(),
        surgeryRepo: Get.find<SurgeryRepository>(),
      ),
    );

    Get.lazyPut<AlertsController>(
      () => AlertsController(
        appointmentRepo: Get.find<AppointmentRepository>(),
        surgeryRepo: Get.find<SurgeryRepository>(),
      ),
    );

    Get.lazyPut<WeeklyReportsController>(
      () => WeeklyReportsController(
        Get.find<ReportsRepository>(),
      ),
    );

    if (!Get.isRegistered<AuthController>()) {
      Get.put<AuthController>(AuthController(), permanent: true);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class WeeklyReportsView extends GetView<WeeklyReportsController> {
  const WeeklyReportsView({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(

                          Text(
                            controller.weekRangeText.value,

                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(
                          Icons.arrow_forward_ios,
                          size: 18,
                          color: controller.weekOffset.value == 0 ? Colors.grey.shade400 : AppColors.darkNeutral,
                        ),
                        tooltip: 'الأسبوع اللاحق',
                        onPressed: controller.weekOffset.value == 0 ? null : controller.nextWeek,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // KPI Summary 2x2 Grid
              GridView.count(
                crossAxisCount: 2,
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),

                mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                childAspectRatio: 1.4,
                children: [

                    color: AppColors.primary,
                    bgColor: AppColors.primaryLight.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  ),
                  _buildKpiCard(
                    title: 'مرضى جدد',
                    value: '${controller.newPatients.value}',
                    subtitle: 'ملف حيوان أليف جديد',
                    icon: Icons.pets,
                    color: const Color(0xFF264653),
                    bgColor: const Color(0xFF264653).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                  ),
                  _buildKpiCard(
                    title: 'العمليات الجراحية',
                    value: '${controller.totalSurgeries.value}',

                    icon: Icons.healing,
                    color: const Color(0xFFE76F51),

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Section: Most Administered Clinic Injections
              Card(
                elevation: 2,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.vaccines, size: 20, color: AppColors.accent),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          const Text(
                            'أكثر الأدوية والإبر صرفاً من العيادة',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      if (controller.topClinicMedicines.isEmpty)
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
                          child: Text('لم يتم صرف إبر أو أدوية من العيادة في هذا الأسبوع', style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
                        )
                      else

  Widget _buildKpiCard({
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required String subtitle,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    required Color bgColor,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: AppColors.border),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(color: bgColor, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 18),
              ),
              Text(
                value,
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: color),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
              Text(subtitle, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: AppColors.textSecondary)),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

    return Obx(() {

      final isDue = key == 'due_followups';
      return InkWell(
        onTap: () => controller.setFilter(key),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Container(

          decoration: BoxDecoration(

                ? (isDue ? const Color(0xFFE76F51) : AppColors.primary)

            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected
                  ? (isDue ? const Color(0xFFE76F51) : AppColors.primary)

            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

                const SizedBox(width: 4),

<file path="lib/modules/follow_ups/controllers/follow_up_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../data/models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/pet_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/pet_repository.dart';
import '../../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../../core/config/demo_config.dart';

class FollowUpController extends GetxController {
  final AppointmentRepository _appointmentRepo = AppointmentRepository();
  final PetRepository _petRepo = PetRepository();
  final AuthRepository _authRepo = AuthRepository();

  final RxList<FollowUpModel> followUps = <FollowUpModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<PetModel> pets = <PetModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;
  final RxString currentFilter = 'today'.obs; // overdue, today, upcoming, all

  // Counts for all appointment categories
  final RxInt todayCount = 0.obs;
  final RxInt overdueCount = 0.obs;
  final RxInt upcomingCount = 0.obs;
  final RxInt allCount = 0.obs;

  // Form Controllers
  final Rx<PetModel?> selectedPet = Rx<PetModel?>(null);
  final scheduledDateController = TextEditingController();
  final scheduledTimeController = TextEditingController(text: '10:00 ص');
  final reasonController = TextEditingController(text: AppStringsAr.reasonRecheck);
  final notesController = TextEditingController();

  // Edit Follow-up state
  final RxBool isEditing = false.obs;
  final Rx<int?> editingId = Rx<int?>(null);

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadFollowUps();
    loadPets();
  }

  Future<void> loadPets() async {
    pets.assignAll(await _petRepo.getAllPets());
  }

  Future<void> loadFollowUps() async {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final all = await _appointmentRepo.getAllFollowUps();
      allCount.value = all.length;
      todayCount.value = all.where((f) => f.isToday && f.isPending).length;
      overdueCount.value = all.where((f) => f.isOverdue).length;
      upcomingCount.value = all.where((f) => !f.isOverdue && f.isPending && !f.isToday).length;

      final list = await _appointmentRepo.getFollowUpsByFilter(currentFilter.value);
      followUps.assignAll(list);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void setFilter(String filter) {
    currentFilter.value = filter;
    loadFollowUps();
  }

  Future<void> markStatus(int id, String status, {int? petId}) async {
    await _appointmentRepo.updateFollowUpStatus(id, status);
    await loadFollowUps();
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    Get.snackbar('تم', 'تم تحديث حالة الموعد', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
  }

  void initEdit(FollowUpModel followUp) {
    isEditing.value = true;
    editingId.value = followUp.id;
    if (pets.isNotEmpty) {
      selectedPet.value = pets.firstWhereOrNull((p) => p.id == followUp.petId);
    }
    scheduledDateController.text = followUp.scheduledDate;
    scheduledTimeController.text = followUp.scheduledTime ?? '10:00 ص';
    reasonController.text = followUp.reason;
    notesController.text = followUp.notes ?? '';
  }

  Future<void> deleteFollowUp(int id, {int? petId}) async {
    await _appointmentRepo.deleteFollowUp(id);
    await loadFollowUps();
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    Get.snackbar('تم الحذف', 'تم حذف موعد المراجعة بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
  }

  Future<void> sendWhatsAppReminder(FollowUpModel followUp) async {
    if (followUp.ownerPhone == null || followUp.ownerPhone!.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'رقم هاتف المالك غير متوفر', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final clinic = await _authRepo.getClinicInfo();
    final cleanPhone = followUp.ownerPhone!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');

    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('🐾 *تذكير بموعد مراجعة بيطرية*');
    buffer.writeln('من: *${clinic?.clinicName ?? "عيادة بيطرية"}*');
    buffer.writeln('--------------------------------');
    buffer.writeln('عزيزي المربي: نود تذكيركم بموعد مراجعة حيوانكم الأليف *(${followUp.petName ?? "المريض"})*.');
    buffer.writeln('📅 *التاريخ:* ${followUp.scheduledDate}');
    if (followUp.scheduledTime != null) {
      buffer.writeln('⏰ *الوقت:* ${followUp.scheduledTime}');
    }
    buffer.writeln('🩺 *السبب:* ${followUp.reason}');
    if (clinic?.phone != null) {
      buffer.writeln('📞 للاستفسار أو التعديل: ${clinic!.phone}');
    }
    buffer.writeln('نتطلع لرؤيتكم بصحة وعافية.');

    final encoded = Uri.encodeComponent(buffer.toString());
    final uri = Uri.parse('whatsapp://send?phone=$cleanPhone&text=$encoded');

    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri);
      if (followUp.id != null) {
        await _appointmentRepo.markReminderSent(followUp.id!);
        loadFollowUps();
      }
    } else {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'تعذر فتح تطبيق واتساب', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
    }
  }

  Future<void> scheduleFollowUp() async {
    if (!isEditing.value) {
      if (!await DemoConfig.canAddFollowUp()) {
        return;
      }
    }

    if (selectedPet.value == null || selectedPet.value!.id == null) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى اختيار المريض أولاً', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    final date = scheduledDateController.text.trim();
    if (date.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى تحديد تاريخ المراجعة', backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      if (isEditing.value && editingId.value != null) {
        final model = FollowUpModel(
          id: editingId.value,
          petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
          scheduledDate: date,
          scheduledTime: scheduledTimeController.text.trim(),
          reason: reasonController.text.trim(),
          notes: notesController.text.trim(),
        );
        await _appointmentRepo.updateFollowUp(model);
        DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: model.petId);
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar('تم', 'تم تعديل موعد المراجعة بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
      } else {
        final model = FollowUpModel(
          petId: selectedPet.value!.id!,
          scheduledDate: date,
          scheduledTime: scheduledTimeController.text.trim(),
          reason: reasonController.text.trim(),
          notes: notesController.text.trim(),
        );
        await _appointmentRepo.insertFollowUp(model);
        DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: model.petId);
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar('تم', 'تمت جدولة موعد المراجعة بنجاح', backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100);
      }
      clearForm();
      await loadFollowUps();
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void clearForm() {
    isEditing.value = false;
    editingId.value = null;
    selectedPet.value = null;
    scheduledDateController.clear();
    scheduledTimeController.text = '10:00 ص';
    reasonController.text = AppStringsAr.reasonRecheck;
    notesController.clear();
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    scheduledDateController.dispose();
    scheduledTimeController.dispose();
    reasonController.dispose();
    notesController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/data/services/database_backup_service.dart">
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:file_picker/file_picker.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import '../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../models/backup_log_model.dart';
import '../repositories/backup_repository.dart';

class DatabaseBackupInfo {
  final String path;
  final String fileName;
  final int sizeBytes;
  final DateTime lastModified;
  final String backupType;

  DatabaseBackupInfo({
    required this.path,
    String? fileName,
    required this.sizeBytes,
    required this.lastModified,
    this.backupType = 'internal',
  }) : fileName = fileName ?? p.basename(path);

  /// Path to the directory containing this backup file
  String get directoryPath => p.dirname(path);

  /// Short display path (last 2 segments, e.g. 'app_flutter/vet_pulse_backups')
  String get shortDirectoryPath {
    final parts = p.split(directoryPath);
    if (parts.length <= 2) return parts.join('/');
    return parts.sublist(parts.length - 2).join('/');
  }

  String get formattedSize {
    if (sizeBytes < 1024) return '$sizeBytes B';
    if (sizeBytes < 1024 * 1024) return '${(sizeBytes / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB';
    return '${(sizeBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(2)} MB';
  }

  String get formattedDate {
    return DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm').format(lastModified);
  }
}

class BackupConfig {
  final String? externalDestinationPath;
  final bool autoBackupEnabled;
  final String autoBackupFrequency; // 'daily', 'weekly'
  final String? lastAutoBackupDate;

  BackupConfig({
    this.externalDestinationPath,
    this.autoBackupEnabled = false,
    this.autoBackupFrequency = 'daily',
    this.lastAutoBackupDate,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
    'externalDestinationPath': externalDestinationPath,
    'autoBackupEnabled': autoBackupEnabled,
    'autoBackupFrequency': autoBackupFrequency,
    'lastAutoBackupDate': lastAutoBackupDate,
  };

  factory BackupConfig.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => BackupConfig(
    externalDestinationPath: map['externalDestinationPath'] as String?,
    autoBackupEnabled: map['autoBackupEnabled'] as bool? ?? false,
    autoBackupFrequency: map['autoBackupFrequency'] as String? ?? 'daily',
    lastAutoBackupDate: map['lastAutoBackupDate'] as String?,
  );
}

class DatabaseBackupService {
  DatabaseBackupService._internal();
  static final DatabaseBackupService instance = DatabaseBackupService._internal();
  final BackupRepository _backupRepo = BackupRepository();

  /// Gets dedicated directory for internal backups
  Future<Directory> getInternalBackupsDirectory() async {
    Directory docsDir;
    try {
      docsDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    } catch (_) {
      final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
      docsDir = Directory(p.dirname(dbPath));
    }

    final backupDir = Directory(p.join(docsDir.path, 'vet_pulse_backups'));
    if (!await backupDir.exists()) {
      await backupDir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return backupDir;
  }

  /// Returns current active database info (size, path, last modified)
  Future<DatabaseBackupInfo?> getDatabaseInfo() async {
    try {
      final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
      final file = File(dbPath);
      if (await file.exists()) {
        final stat = await file.stat();
        return DatabaseBackupInfo(
          path: dbPath,
          sizeBytes: stat.size,
          lastModified: stat.modified,
          backupType: 'active',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error getting database info: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }

  // --- INTERNAL BACKUP (النسخ الاحتياطي الداخلي) ---

  /// Creates a manual or automated internal backup saved locally
  Future<BackupLogModel> createInternalBackup({bool isScheduled = false}) async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final nowStr = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss').format(now);
    final dateSuffix = DateFormat('yyyy_MM_dd_HHmmss').format(now);
    final backupFileName = 'vet_pulse_internal_$dateSuffix.db';

    try {
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.flushWal();
      final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
      final sourceFile = File(dbPath);

      if (!await sourceFile.exists()) {
        throw Exception('ملف قاعدة البيانات النشطة غير موجود على الجهاز');
      }

      final backupDir = await getInternalBackupsDirectory();
      final targetPath = p.join(backupDir.path, backupFileName);

      final copiedFile = await sourceFile.copy(targetPath);
      final fileSize = await copiedFile.length();

      final log = BackupLogModel(
        backupName: backupFileName,
        filePath: targetPath,
        sizeBytes: fileSize,
        backupType: isScheduled ? 'scheduled' : 'internal',
        destination: 'التخزين الداخلي: مجلد vet_pulse_backups',
        status: 'success',
        createdAt: nowStr,
      );

      await logBackupEvent(log);
      return log;
    } catch (e) {
      final failLog = BackupLogModel(
        backupName: backupFileName,
        filePath: '',
        sizeBytes: 0,
        backupType: isScheduled ? 'scheduled' : 'internal',
        destination: 'التخزين الداخلي للتطبيق',
        status: 'failed',
        errorMessage: e.toString(),
        createdAt: nowStr,
      );
      await logBackupEvent(failLog);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Lists all internal backups available in the local backup directory
  Future<List<DatabaseBackupInfo>> listInternalBackups() async {
    try {
      final backupDir = await getInternalBackupsDirectory();
      if (!await backupDir.exists()) return [];

      final files = await backupDir
          .list()
          .where((entity) => entity is File && entity.path.endsWith('.db'))
          .cast<File>()
          .toList();

      final List<DatabaseBackupInfo> list = [];
      for (final file in files) {
        final stat = await file.stat();
        list.add(DatabaseBackupInfo(
          path: file.path,
          fileName: p.basename(file.path),
          sizeBytes: stat.size,
          lastModified: stat.modified,
          backupType: 'internal',
        ));
      }

      // Sort newest first
      list.sort((a, b) => b.lastModified.compareTo(a.lastModified));
      return list;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error listing internal backups: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  /// Deletes an internal backup file safely
  Future<bool> deleteInternalBackup(String filePath) async {
    try {
      final file = File(filePath);
      if (await file.exists()) {
        await file.delete();
        return true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error deleting backup: $e');
    }
    return false;
  }

  // --- EXTERNAL BACKUP (النسخ الاحتياطي الخارجي) ---

  /// Exports backup to an external destination (USB Flash drive, external folder, or file picker)
  Future<BackupLogModel> exportExternalBackup({String? destinationDirectory}) async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final nowStr = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss').format(now);
    final dateSuffix = DateFormat('yyyy_MM_dd_HHmmss').format(now);
    final defaultFileName = 'vet_pulse_external_$dateSuffix.db';

    try {
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.flushWal();
      final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
      final sourceFile = File(dbPath);

      if (!await sourceFile.exists()) {
        throw Exception('ملف قاعدة البيانات غير موجود على الجهاز');
      }

      final bytes = await sourceFile.readAsBytes();
      final fileSize = bytes.length;

      String? targetPath;

      if (destinationDirectory != null &&
          destinationDirectory.isNotEmpty &&
          !destinationDirectory.startsWith('/document/') &&
          !destinationDirectory.startsWith('content://') &&
          await Directory(destinationDirectory).exists()) {
        targetPath = p.join(destinationDirectory, defaultFileName);
        await sourceFile.copy(targetPath);
      } else {
        final savedUri = await FilePicker.saveFile(
          dialogTitle: 'اختر موقع حفظ النسخة الاحتياطية',
          fileName: defaultFileName,
          bytes: bytes,
          type: FileType.any,
        );
        if (savedUri != null) {
          try {
            targetPath = savedUri.toFilePath(windows: Platform.isWindows);
          } catch (_) {
            targetPath = savedUri.path;
          }
        }
      }

      if (targetPath == null) {
        throw Exception('تم إلغاء عملية اختيار الوجهة الخارجية للنسخ الاحتياطي');
      }

      if (!targetPath.startsWith('/document/') && !targetPath.startsWith('content://')) {
        try {
          final file = File(targetPath);
          if (!await file.exists() || (await file.length()) == 0) {
            await file.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          debugPrint('Notice: writing to targetPath directly failed or not needed: $e');
        }
      }

      try {
        if (!targetPath.startsWith('/document/') && !targetPath.startsWith('content://')) {
          await File(targetPath).length();
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // Fallback safely to fileSize
      }

      final log = BackupLogModel(
        backupName: defaultFileName,
        filePath: targetPath,
        sizeBytes: fileSize,
        backupType: 'external',
        destination: targetPath,
        status: 'success',
        createdAt: nowStr,
      );

      await logBackupEvent(log);
      return log;
    } catch (e) {
      final failLog = BackupLogModel(
        backupName: defaultFileName,
        filePath: '',
        sizeBytes: 0,
        backupType: 'external',
        destination: destinationDirectory ?? 'وجهة خارجية',
        status: 'failed',
        errorMessage: e.toString(),
        createdAt: nowStr,
      );
      await logBackupEvent(failLog);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Exports backup via file picker (compatibility method)
  Future<String?> exportBackupToFilePicker() async {
    final log = await exportExternalBackup();
    return log.filePath;
  }

  /// Shares backup file using system share sheet (Google Drive, WhatsApp, Bluetooth, etc.)
  Future<bool> shareBackupViaSystem() async {
    await DatabaseHelper.instance.flushWal();
    final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
    final sourceFile = File(dbPath);

    if (!await sourceFile.exists()) {
      throw Exception('ملف قاعدة البيانات غير موجود على الجهاز');
    }

    final bytes = await sourceFile.readAsBytes();
    final dateSuffix = DateFormat('yyyy_MM_dd_HHmm').format(DateTime.now());
    final defaultFileName = 'vet_pulse_backup_$dateSuffix.db';

    await Printing.sharePdf(
      bytes: bytes,
      filename: defaultFileName,
    );
    return true;
  }

  // --- RESTORE BACKUP (استعادة النسخة الاحتياطية مع التحقق من الصلاحيات) ---

  /// Restores database with mandatory role and safety checks
  Future<String> restoreFromFile(
    String backupFilePath, {
    String userRole = 'lead_doctor',
  }) async {
    // 1. Role Permission Guard: Only lead doctor or authorized admin can restore
    if (userRole != 'lead_doctor' && userRole != 'admin') {
      throw Exception('عذراً، عملية استعادة النسخة الاحتياطية تتطلب صلاحيات الطبيب المسؤول (Lead Doctor) حصرياً لحماية بيانات العيادة.');
    }

    final backupFile = File(backupFilePath);
    if (!await backupFile.exists()) {
      throw Exception('ملف النسخة الاحتياطية غير موجود: $backupFilePath');
    }

    final fileSize = await backupFile.length();
    if (fileSize < 100) {
      throw Exception('الملف فارغ أو تالف وغير صالح كقاعدة بيانات');
    }

    // 2. Validate SQLite Header ("SQLite format 3\0")
    final headerBytes = await backupFile.openRead(0, 16).first;
    const expectedHeader = [
      0x53, 0x51, 0x4c, 0x69, 0x74, 0x65, 0x20, 0x66, 0x6f, 0x72, 0x6d, 0x61, 0x74, 0x20, 0x33, 0x00
    ];
    bool isValidSqlite = headerBytes.length >= 16;
    if (isValidSqlite) {
      for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        if (headerBytes[i] != expectedHeader[i]) {
          isValidSqlite = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!isValidSqlite) {
      throw Exception('الملف المحدد ليس ملف قاعدة بيانات SQLite صالح لتطبيق نبض البيطري');
    }

    final nowStr = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss').format(DateTime.now());

    try {
      // Step 1: Close active database cleanly
      await DatabaseHelper.instance.close();

      // Step 2: Target path
      final activeDbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();

      // Remove any leftover WAL/SHM journal files
      final walFile = File('$activeDbPath-wal');
      if (await walFile.exists()) await walFile.delete();
      final shmFile = File('$activeDbPath-shm');
      if (await shmFile.exists()) await shmFile.delete();

      // Step 3: Overwrite with backup
      await backupFile.copy(activeDbPath);

      // Step 4: Reopen database and verify integrity
      final newDb = await DatabaseHelper.instance.database;
      final integrityRes = await newDb.rawQuery('PRAGMA integrity_check;');
      final status = integrityRes.isNotEmpty ? integrityRes.first.values.first.toString() : '';

      if (status != 'ok') {
        throw Exception('فشل فحص سلامة البيانات المستعادة: $status');
      }

      // Log success in audit table
      await logBackupEvent(BackupLogModel(
        backupName: p.basename(backupFilePath),
        filePath: backupFilePath,
        sizeBytes: fileSize,
        backupType: 'restore',
        destination: 'قاعدة البيانات النشطة (تمت الاستعادة بنجاح)',
        status: 'success',
        createdAt: nowStr,
      ));

      return 'تمت استعادة قاعدة البيانات بنجاح (${(fileSize / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(2)} MB)';
    } catch (e) {
      await logBackupEvent(BackupLogModel(
        backupName: p.basename(backupFilePath),
        filePath: backupFilePath,
        sizeBytes: fileSize,
        backupType: 'restore',
        destination: 'قاعدة البيانات النشطة',
        status: 'failed',
        errorMessage: e.toString(),
        createdAt: nowStr,
      ));
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Restores database from a user-selected backup file (.db)
  Future<String> restoreFromBackupPicker({String userRole = 'lead_doctor'}) async {
    final pickedFiles = await FilePickerPlatform.instance.pickFiles(
      dialogTitle: 'اختر ملف النسخة الاحتياطية (.db)',
      type: FileType.any,
    );

    if (pickedFiles.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('تم إلغاء عملية الاستعادة');
    }

    final pickedPath = pickedFiles.first.path;
    if (pickedPath == null || pickedPath.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('تعذر قراءة مسار الملف المحدد');
    }

    return await restoreFromFile(pickedPath, userRole: userRole);
  }

  // --- LOGGING & AUDIT TRAIL (سجل عمليات النسخ والتدقيق) ---

  /// Records backup or restore event in tableBackupLogs
  Future<void> logBackupEvent(BackupLogModel log) async {
    try {
      await _backupRepo.insertBackupLog(log);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error inserting backup log: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Retrieves all backup and restore logs
  Future<List<BackupLogModel>> getBackupLogs() async {
    try {
      return await _backupRepo.getBackupLogs();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error getting backup logs: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  // --- CONFIGURATION PERSISTENCE ---

  Future<File> _getConfigFile() async {
    Directory dir;
    try {
      dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    } catch (_) {
      final dbPath = await DatabaseHelper.instance.getDatabaseFilePath();
      dir = Directory(p.dirname(dbPath));
    }
    return File(p.join(dir.path, 'vet_pulse_backup_config.json'));
  }

  /// Loads current backup configuration
  Future<BackupConfig> getBackupConfig() async {
    try {
      final file = await _getConfigFile();
      if (await file.exists()) {
        final content = await file.readAsString();
        final map = jsonDecode(content) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return BackupConfig.fromMap(map);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error reading backup config: $e');
    }
    return BackupConfig();
  }

  /// Saves backup configuration
  Future<void> saveBackupConfig(BackupConfig config) async {
    try {
      final file = await _getConfigFile();
      await file.writeAsString(jsonEncode(config.toMap()));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error saving backup config: $e');
    }
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/auth/controllers/auth_controller.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import '../../../core/services/license_service.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/yemeni_phone_validator.dart';
import '../../../data/models/clinic_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/user_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import '../../../routes/app_routes.dart';

class AuthController extends GetxController {
  final AuthRepository _authRepo;

  AuthController([AuthRepository? authRepo]) : _authRepo = authRepo ?? AuthRepository();

  final Rx<UserModel?> currentUser = Rx<UserModel?>(null);
  final Rx<ClinicModel?> clinicInfo = Rx<ClinicModel?>(null);
  final RxBool isLoading = false.obs;
  final RxBool isLocked = false.obs;
  final RxString pinLockInput = ''.obs;

  // Password visibility toggle for LoginView
  final RxBool isPasswordHidden = true.obs;
  void togglePasswordVisibility() => isPasswordHidden.value = !isPasswordHidden.value;

  // Admin Setup Controllers (First-run Lead Doctor account)
  final adminUsernameController = TextEditingController(text: 'admin');
  final adminPasswordController = TextEditingController();
  final adminPinController = TextEditingController(text: '1234');
  final RxBool isAdminPasswordHidden = true.obs;
  void toggleAdminPasswordVisibility() => isAdminPasswordHidden.value = !isAdminPasswordHidden.value;

  /// RBAC Permission checking helper
  bool checkPermission(bool Function(UserModel u) check, String deniedMessage) {
    final user = currentUser.value;
    if (user == null || user.isLeadDoctor) return true;
    if (!check(user)) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'صلاحية غير كافية',
        deniedMessage,
        backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100,
        colorText: Colors.black87,
        snackPosition: SnackPosition.BOTTOM,
        icon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline, color: Colors.orange),
      );
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Clinic Logo observable
  final RxnString clinicLogoPath = RxnString();

  // Controllers for login
  final usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final pinController = TextEditingController();

  // Controllers for clinic setup
  final clinicNameController = TextEditingController();
  final doctorNameController = TextEditingController();
  final licenseController = TextEditingController();
  final phoneController = TextEditingController();
  final addressController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadClinicInfo();
  }

  Future<void> loadClinicInfo() async {
    clinicInfo.value = await _authRepo.getClinicInfo();
    if (clinicInfo.value != null) {
      clinicNameController.text = clinicInfo.value!.clinicName;
      doctorNameController.text = clinicInfo.value!.doctorName;
      licenseController.text = clinicInfo.value!.licenseNumber ?? '';
      phoneController.text = YemeniPhoneValidator.cleanDigits(clinicInfo.value!.phone ?? '');
      addressController.text = clinicInfo.value!.address ?? '';
      clinicLogoPath.value = clinicInfo.value!.logoPath;
    }

    final leadDoctor = await _authRepo.getUserById(1);
    if (leadDoctor != null) {
      adminUsernameController.text = leadDoctor.username;
      adminPinController.text = leadDoctor.pinCode ?? '1234';
    }
  }

  Future<void> pickClinicLogo() async {
    try {
      final picker = ImagePicker();
      final picked = await picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery, imageQuality: 85);
      if (picked != null) {
        clinicLogoPath.value = picked.path;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error picking clinic logo: $e');
    }
  }

  void removeClinicLogo() {
    clinicLogoPath.value = null;
  }

  Future<void> login() async {
    final licenseStatus = await LicenseService.to.checkLicenseValidity();
    if (licenseStatus == LicenseStatus.expired || !LicenseService.to.isLicenseActive.value) {
      Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.activation);
      return;
    }

    final user = usernameController.text.trim();
    final pass = passwordController.text;

    if (user.isEmpty || pass.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'يرجى إدخال اسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final userModel = await _authRepo.login(user, pass);
      if (userModel != null) {
        currentUser.value = userModel;
        usernameController.clear();
        passwordController.clear();
        Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.dashboard);
      } else {
        Get.snackbar('خطأ', 'اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة',
            backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100, colorText: Colors.red.shade900);
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> unlockWithPin(String pin) async {
    if (pin.length < 4) return;

    final licenseStatus = await LicenseService.to.checkLicenseValidity();
    if (licenseStatus == LicenseStatus.expired || !LicenseService.to.isLicenseActive.value) {
      Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.activation);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final userModel = await _authRepo.loginWithPin(pin);
      if (userModel != null) {
        currentUser.value = userModel;
        isLocked.value = false;
        pinController.clear();
        Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.dashboard);
      } else {
        Get.snackbar('خطأ', 'رمز PIN غير صحيح',
            backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade100, colorText: Colors.red.shade900);
        pinController.clear();
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  void onPinKeyPress(String digit) {
    if (pinLockInput.value.length < 4) {
      pinLockInput.value += digit;
      if (pinLockInput.value.length == 4) {
        final entered = pinLockInput.value;
        pinLockInput.value = '';
        unlockWithPin(entered);
      }
    }
  }

  void onPinBackspace() {
    if (pinLockInput.value.isNotEmpty) {
      pinLockInput.value = pinLockInput.value.substring(0, pinLockInput.value.length - 1);
    }
  }

  void clearPinLock() {
    pinLockInput.value = '';
  }

  void lockScreen() {
    clearPinLock();
    isLocked.value = true;
    Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.pinLock);
  }

  void logout() {
    currentUser.value = null;
    Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.login);
  }

  Future<void> saveClinicProfile() async {
    final name = clinicNameController.text.trim();
    final doc = doctorNameController.text.trim();
    final license = licenseController.text.trim();
    final phoneRaw = phoneController.text.trim();
    final address = addressController.text.trim();

    final adminUser = adminUsernameController.text.trim();
    final adminPass = adminPasswordController.text;
    final adminPin = adminPinController.text.trim();

    if (name.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'اسم المنشأة البيطرية مطلوب',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    if (doc.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'اسم الطبيب المسؤول مطلوب',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    if (license.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'رقم ترخيص مزاولة المهنة مطلوب',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    final phoneError = YemeniPhoneValidator.validate(phoneRaw);
    if (phoneError != null) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', phoneError,
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    if (address.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'عنوان المنشأة البيطرية مطلوب',
          backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
      return;
    }

    // Lead Doctor account validation during first-run or when fields are provided
    if (currentUser.value == null) {
      if (adminUser.isEmpty) {
        Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'اسم مستخدم مدير النظام مطلوب',
            backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
        return;
      }
      if (adminPass.isEmpty) {
        Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'كلمة مرور مدير النظام مطلوبة',
            backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
        return;
      }
      if (adminPin.length != 4) {
        Get.snackbar('تنبيه', 'رمز PIN السريع يجب أن يتكون من 4 أرقام',
            backgroundColor: Colors.amber.shade100, colorText: Colors.black87);
        return;
      }
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      final formattedPhone = YemeniPhoneValidator.formatWithCountryCode(phoneRaw);
      final updated = ClinicModel(
        id: clinicInfo.value?.id,
        clinicName: name,
        doctorName: doc,
        licenseNumber: license,
        phone: formattedPhone,
        address: address,
        logoPath: clinicLogoPath.value,
      );
      await _authRepo.saveClinicInfo(updated);
      clinicInfo.value = updated;

      // Update or create Lead Doctor (id = 1) in tableUsers
      if (adminUser.isNotEmpty) {
        final existingAdmin = await _authRepo.getUserById(1);
        final leadDoctor = UserModel(
          id: 1,
          username: adminUser,
          passwordHash: adminPass.isNotEmpty ? adminPass : (existingAdmin?.passwordHash ?? 'admin123'),
          fullName: doc,
          role: 'lead_doctor',
          phone: formattedPhone,
          pinCode: adminPin.isNotEmpty ? adminPin : (existingAdmin?.pinCode ?? '1234'),
          isActive: true,
        );
        if (existingAdmin != null) {
          await _authRepo.updateUser(leadDoctor);
        } else {
          await _authRepo.addUser(leadDoctor);
        }
      }

      await LicenseService.to.completeClinicSetup();

      if (currentUser.value == null) {
        Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.login);
        Get.snackbar(
          'تم إعداد النظام بنجاح 🎉',
          'تم حفظ هوية العيادة وحساب مدير النظام، يرجى تسجيل الدخول للبدء',
          backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
          colorText: Colors.green.shade900,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        );
      } else {
        Get.back();
        Get.snackbar('تم', 'تم حفظ بيانات وهوية العيادة بنجاح',
            backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100, colorText: Colors.green.shade900);
      }
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void onClose() {
    usernameController.dispose();
    passwordController.dispose();
    pinController.dispose();
    clinicNameController.dispose();
    doctorNameController.dispose();
    licenseController.dispose();
    phoneController.dispose();
    addressController.dispose();
    adminUsernameController.dispose();
    adminPasswordController.dispose();
    adminPinController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';

class ConsultationsListView extends GetView<ConsultationsListController> {

                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          _buildFilterChip(controller, 'this_week', 'هذا الأسبوع'),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          _buildFilterChip(controller, 'this_month', 'هذا الشهر'),

            ),
          ),

                  icon: Icons.assignment_outlined,
                  title: 'لا توجد كشوفات مطابقة للبحث',

                                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),

                                          'المالك: ${visit.ownerName ?? "غير محدد"}',
                                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.textSecondary),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ],

                                            onDeleted: controller.loadConsultations,

                                        }
                                      },

                                          value: 'details',
                                          child: Row(

                                            ],
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        if (visit.prescriptions.isNotEmpty)
                                          PopupMenuItem(
                                            value: 'print',
                                            child: Row(
                                              children: [
                                                const Icon(Icons.print, size: 18, color: AppColors.accent),
                                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                                const Text('طباعة الروشتة'),
                                              ],
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        const PopupMenuItem(
                                          value: 'delete',
                                          child: Row(
                                            children: [
                                              Icon(Icons.delete, size: 18, color: AppColors.critical),
                                              SizedBox(width: 8),
                                              Text(AppStringsAr.delete),
                                            ],
                                          ),

                                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.brown.shade800, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    if (homeCount > 0)
                                      Container(
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: AppColors.secondaryLight.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                          border: Border.all(color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
                                        ),
                                        child: Text(
                                          '$homeCount أدوية منزلية',
                                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.primary, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                ),

                                    const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                    Text(

                                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textMuted),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            }),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterChip(ConsultationsListController controller, String key, String label) {
    final isSelected = controller.selectedFilter.value == key;
    return ChoiceChip(
      label: Text(label),
      selected: isSelected,
      onSelected: (_) => controller.setFilter(key),
      selectedColor: AppColors.primary,
      labelStyle: TextStyle(
        color: isSelected ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkNeutral,
        fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
        fontSize: 12,
      ),
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/modules/dashboard/controllers/dashboard_controller.dart">
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/services/license_service.dart';
import '../../../data/models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../../../data/models/medicine_model.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/inventory_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/surgery_repository.dart';
import '../../../routes/app_routes.dart';

class DashboardController extends GetxController {
  final ConsultationRepository _consultationRepo;
  final AppointmentRepository _appointmentRepo;
  final InventoryRepository _inventoryRepo;
  final SurgeryRepository _surgeryRepo;

  DashboardController({
    ConsultationRepository? consultationRepo,
    AppointmentRepository? appointmentRepo,
    InventoryRepository? inventoryRepo,
    SurgeryRepository? surgeryRepo,
  })  : _consultationRepo = consultationRepo ?? ConsultationRepository(),
        _appointmentRepo = appointmentRepo ?? AppointmentRepository(),
        _inventoryRepo = inventoryRepo ?? InventoryRepository(),
        _surgeryRepo = surgeryRepo ?? SurgeryRepository();

  final RxInt todayVisits = 0.obs;
  final RxInt todaySurgeries = 0.obs;
  final RxInt pendingFollowUps = 0.obs;
  final RxInt lowStockCount = 0.obs;
  final RxInt expiringMedsCount = 0.obs;

  final RxList<ConsultationModel> recentConsultations = <ConsultationModel>[].obs;
  final RxList<MedicineModel> alertMedicines = <MedicineModel>[].obs;
  final RxBool isLoading = true.obs;

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    loadDashboardData();
  }

  Future<void> loadDashboardData() async {
    final licenseStatus = await LicenseService.to.checkLicenseValidity();
    if (licenseStatus == LicenseStatus.expired || !LicenseService.to.isLicenseActive.value) {
      Get.offAllNamed(AppRoutes.activation);
      return;
    }

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
      todaySurgeries.value = await _surgeryRepo.getScheduledSurgeriesCount();
      pendingFollowUps.value = await _appointmentRepo.getPendingTodayCount();

      final lowStock = await _inventoryRepo.getLowStockMedicines();
      lowStockCount.value = lowStock.length;

      final expiring = await _inventoryRepo.getExpiringOrExpiredMedicines();
      expiringMedsCount.value = expiring.length;
      alertMedicines.assignAll(expiring.take(5));

      final allVisits = await _consultationRepo.getAllConsultations();
      final todayStr = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
      final todayVisitsList = allVisits.where((c) => c.visitDate.startsWith(todayStr)).toList();
      recentConsultations.assignAll(todayVisitsList);
      todayVisits.value = todayVisitsList.length;
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }
}
