<file path="lib/modules/users_management/views/users_list_view.dart">
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_strings_ar.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/yemeni_phone_validator.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/custom_text_field.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/status_chip.dart';
import '../../auth/controllers/auth_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/users_controller.dart';

class UsersListView extends GetView<UsersController> {
  const UsersListView({super.key});

  void _showUserFormDialog(BuildContext context) {
    Get.dialog(
      AlertDialog(
        title: Obx(
          () => Text(
            controller.isEditing.value ? 'تعديل بيانات الموظف' : AppStringsAr.addUser,
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
        ),
        content: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              CustomTextField(
                label: AppStringsAr.fullName,
                hint: 'مثال: د. سارة الأحمد',
                controller: controller.fullNameController,
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.person),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              CustomTextField(
                label: AppStringsAr.username,
                hint: 'اسم المستخدم للدخول',
                controller: controller.usernameController,
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.account_circle),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Obx(
                () => CustomTextField(
                  label: AppStringsAr.password,
                  hint: controller.isEditing.value
                      ? 'اتركه فارغاً للإبقاء على كلمة المرور الحالية'
                      : 'كلمة المرور',
                  controller: controller.passwordController,
                  obscureText: true,
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              CustomTextField(
                label: AppStringsAr.pinCode,
                hint: '4 أرقام للقفل السريع',
                controller: controller.pinController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                maxLength: 4,
                inputFormatters: [
                  FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
                  LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(4),
                ],
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.pin),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              CustomTextField(
                label: '${AppStringsAr.phone} (رقم يمني +967)',
                hint: '77xxxxxxx أو 78 أو 73 أو 70 أو 71',
                controller: controller.phoneController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                prefixText: '+967 ',
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                maxLength: 9,
                validator: (v) => YemeniPhoneValidator.validate(v, isRequired: false),
                inputFormatters: [
                  FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
                  LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(9),
                ],
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.phone),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Obx(
                () => DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  isExpanded: true,
                  initialValue: controller.selectedRole.value,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: AppStringsAr.role),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'lead_doctor',
                      child: Text('طبيب رئيسي (Lead Doctor)', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'assistant_vet',
                      child: Text('طبيب مساعد (Assistant Vet)', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'receptionist',
                      child: Text('موظف استقبال (Receptionist)', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'pharmacist',
                      child: Text('أمين المستودع (Pharmacist)', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v != null) controller.selectedRole.value = v;
                  },
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Obx(
                () => SwitchListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  title: const Text('حالة الحساب', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14)),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    controller.isFormUserActive.value ? 'نشط ومفعل' : 'معطل وموقوف',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: controller.isFormUserActive.value ? AppColors.success : AppColors.critical,
                    ),
                  ),
                  value: controller.isFormUserActive.value,
                  activeThumbColor: AppColors.primary,
                  onChanged: (v) => controller.isFormUserActive.value = v,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Get.back(),
            child: const Text(AppStringsAr.cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
            onPressed: controller.saveUser,
            child: const Text(AppStringsAr.save),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final authController = Get.isRegistered<AuthController>() ? Get.find<AuthController>() : null;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(AppStringsAr.usersManagement),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
        backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add),
        label: const Text(AppStringsAr.addUser, style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        onPressed: () {
          if (authController != null &&
              !authController.checkPermission((u) => u.canManageUsers, 'إضافة موظف جديد متاح للطبيب الرئيسي فقط')) {
            return;
          }
          controller.clearForm();
          _showUserFormDialog(context);
        },
      ),
      body: Obx(() {
        if (controller.isLoading.value) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }

        final currentUserId = authController?.currentUser.value?.id;

        return ListView.separated(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          itemCount: controller.users.length,
          separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
            final user = controller.users[index];
            final isPrimaryAdmin = user.id == 1;
            final isSelf = currentUserId != null && user.id == currentUserId;
            final isSwitchDisabled = isPrimaryAdmin || isSelf;

            return Card(
              elevation: 2,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      backgroundColor: user.isActive ? AppColors.secondaryLight : Colors.grey.shade200,
                      child: Icon(
                        user.isLeadDoctor
                            ? Icons.medical_services
                            : (user.isAssistantVet
                                ? Icons.healing
                                : (user.isPharmacist ? Icons.medication : Icons.support_agent)),
                        color: user.isActive ? AppColors.primary : Colors.grey,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Flexible(
                                child: Text(
                                  user.fullName,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    fontSize: 14,
                                    color: user.isActive ? AppColors.darkNeutral : AppColors.textMuted,
                                  ),
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              StatusChip(
                                label: user.roleDisplayArabic,
                                type: user.isLeadDoctor ? ChipStatusType.info : ChipStatusType.neutral,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            'اسم المستخدم: ${user.username} • PIN: ${user.pinCode ?? "-"}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.textSecondary),
                          ),
                          if (user.phone != null && user.phone!.isNotEmpty)
                            Text(
                              'الهاتف: ${user.phone}',
                              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textMuted),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              user.isActive ? 'نشط' : 'معطل',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: user.isActive ? AppColors.success : AppColors.critical,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Switch(
                              value: user.isActive,
                              activeThumbColor: AppColors.primary,
                              onChanged: isSwitchDisabled
                                  ? null
                                  : (_) {
                                      if (authController != null &&
                                          !authController.checkPermission((u) => u.canManageUsers, 'تغيير حالة الموظفين متاح للطبيب الرئيسي فقط')) {
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      controller.toggleActive(user);
                                    },
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 20, color: AppColors.primary),
                              tooltip: 'تعديل بيانات الموظف',
                              onPressed: () {
                                if (authController != null &&
                                    !authController.checkPermission((u) => u.canManageUsers, 'تعديل بيانات الموظفين متاح للطبيب الرئيسي فقط')) {
                                  return;
                                }
                                controller.initEditUser(user);
                                _showUserFormDialog(context);
                              },
                            ),
                            if (!isPrimaryAdmin)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 20, color: AppColors.critical),
                                tooltip: 'حذف الموظف',
                                onPressed: isSelf
                                    ? null
                                    : () {
                                        if (authController != null &&
                                            !authController.checkPermission((u) => u.canManageUsers, 'حذف الموظفين متاح للطبيب الرئيسي فقط')) {
                                          return;
                                        }
                                        controller.deleteUser(user);
                                      },
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      }),
    );
  }
}

<file path="lib/core/services/data_sync_service.dart">
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../modules/dashboard/controllers/dashboard_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/dashboard/controllers/weekly_reports_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/dashboard/services/alerts_service.dart';
import '../../modules/patients/controllers/patient_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/consultations/controllers/consultations_list_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/surgeries/controllers/surgery_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/follow_ups/controllers/follow_up_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/pharmacy/controllers/pharmacy_controller.dart';
import '../../modules/financials/controllers/financial_controller.dart';

/// Central reactive data synchronizer that ensures all screens, cards,
/// badges, and lists update immediately across the app without manual refresh.
class DataSyncService {
  static void notifyAllChanged() {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyAllChanged');
    if (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationsListController>()) {
      Get.find<ConsultationsListController>().loadConsultations();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<InventoryListController>()) {
      Get.find<InventoryListController>().loadMedicines();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryListController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryListController>().loadSurgeries();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryFormController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryFormController>().loadPetsAndDoctors();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FollowUpController>()) {
      Get.find<FollowUpController>().loadFollowUps();
      Get.find<FollowUpController>().loadPets();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<AlertsController>()) {
      Get.find<AlertsController>().refreshAlerts();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientListController>()) {
      Get.find<PatientListController>().loadPatients();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientDetailController>()) {
      final pdc = Get.find<PatientDetailController>();
      if (pdc.petId != null) {
        pdc.loadPetFullProfile(pdc.petId!);
      }
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnersListController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnersListController>().loadOwners();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerDetailController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerDetailController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FinancialDashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<FinancialDashboardController>().loadFinancialData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<WeeklyReportsController>()) {
      Get.find<WeeklyReportsController>().loadWeeklyReport();
    }
  }

  static void notifyConsultationChanged({int? petId}) {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyConsultationChanged (petId: $petId)');
    if (Get.isRegistered<ConsultationsListController>()) {
      Get.find<ConsultationsListController>().loadConsultations();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<InventoryListController>()) {
      Get.find<InventoryListController>().loadMedicines();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryListController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryListController>().loadSurgeries();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FollowUpController>()) {
      Get.find<FollowUpController>().loadFollowUps();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<AlertsController>()) {
      Get.find<AlertsController>().refreshAlerts();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientListController>()) {
      Get.find<PatientListController>().loadPatients();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientDetailController>()) {
      final pdc = Get.find<PatientDetailController>();
      if (petId != null && pdc.petId == petId) {
        pdc.loadPetFullProfile(petId);
      }
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FinancialDashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<FinancialDashboardController>().loadFinancialData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerStatementController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerStatementController>().loadStatement();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerDetailController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerDetailController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
  }

  static void notifyPatientChanged({int? petId}) {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyPatientChanged (petId: $petId)');
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientListController>()) {
      Get.find<PatientListController>().loadPatients();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnersListController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnersListController>().loadOwners();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerDetailController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerDetailController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientDetailController>()) {
      final pdc = Get.find<PatientDetailController>();
      if (petId != null && pdc.petId == petId) {
        pdc.loadPetFullProfile(petId);
      }
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryFormController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryFormController>().loadPetsAndDoctors();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FollowUpController>()) {
      Get.find<FollowUpController>().loadPets();
    }
  }

  static void notifySurgeryChanged({int? petId}) {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifySurgeryChanged (petId: $petId)');
    if (Get.isRegistered<SurgeryListController>()) {
      Get.find<SurgeryListController>().loadSurgeries();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<AlertsController>()) {
      Get.find<AlertsController>().refreshAlerts();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientDetailController>()) {
      final pdc = Get.find<PatientDetailController>();
      if (petId != null && pdc.petId == petId) {
        pdc.loadPetFullProfile(petId);
      }
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<FinancialDashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<FinancialDashboardController>().loadFinancialData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerStatementController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerStatementController>().loadStatement();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerDetailController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerDetailController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
  }

  static void notifyFollowUpChanged({int? petId}) {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyFollowUpChanged (petId: $petId)');
    if (Get.isRegistered<FollowUpController>()) {
      Get.find<FollowUpController>().loadFollowUps();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<AlertsController>()) {
      Get.find<AlertsController>().refreshAlerts();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<PatientDetailController>()) {
      final pdc = Get.find<PatientDetailController>();
      if (petId != null && pdc.petId == petId) {
        pdc.loadPetFullProfile(petId);
      }
    }
  }

  static void notifyInventoryChanged() {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyInventoryChanged');
    if (Get.isRegistered<InventoryListController>()) {
      Get.find<InventoryListController>().loadMedicines();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<StockTransferController>()) {
      Get.find<StockTransferController>().loadMedicines();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
  }

  static void notifyFinancialChanged() {
    debugPrint('[DataSyncService] notifyFinancialChanged');
    if (Get.isRegistered<FinancialDashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<FinancialDashboardController>().loadFinancialData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerStatementController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerStatementController>().loadStatement();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerDetailController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerDetailController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<OwnerController>()) {
      Get.find<OwnerController>().loadOwnerData();
    }
    if (Get.isRegistered<DashboardController>()) {
      Get.find<DashboardController>().loadDashboardData();
    }
  }

  static void refreshAll() {
    notifyAllChanged();
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/repositories/appointment_repository.dart">
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../../core/services/notification_service.dart';
import '../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../database/database_tables.dart';
import '../models/follow_up_model.dart';
import '../models/prescription_model.dart';

class AppointmentRepository {
  final DatabaseHelper _dbHelper = DatabaseHelper.instance;

  Future<List<FollowUpModel>> getAllFollowUps() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        f.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        o.full_name AS owner_name,
        o.phone_primary AS owner_phone
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps} f
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON f.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      ORDER BY f.scheduled_date DESC, f.id DESC
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql);
    return res.map((m) => FollowUpModel.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  Future<List<FollowUpModel>> getFollowUpsByFilter(String filter) async {
    final all = await getAllFollowUps();
    switch (filter) {
      case 'overdue':
        return all.where((f) => f.isOverdue).toList();
      case 'today':
        return all.where((f) => f.isToday && f.isPending).toList();
      case 'upcoming':
        return all.where((f) => !f.isOverdue && f.isPending && !f.isToday).toList();
      case 'all':
      default:
        return all;
    }
  }

  Future<List<FollowUpModel>> getFollowUpsForPet(int petId) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        f.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        o.full_name AS owner_name,
        o.phone_primary AS owner_phone
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps} f
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON f.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      WHERE f.pet_id = ?
      ORDER BY f.scheduled_date DESC, f.id DESC
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql, [petId]);
    return res.map((m) => FollowUpModel.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  Future<int> insertFollowUp(FollowUpModel followUp) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.insert(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, followUp.toMap());
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: followUp.petId);
    if (Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      NotificationService.to.scheduleFollowUpReminder(followUp.copyWith(id: res));
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<int> updateFollowUp(FollowUpModel followUp) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
      followUp.toMap(),
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [followUp.id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: followUp.petId);
    if (Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      if (followUp.status == 'pending') {
        NotificationService.to.scheduleFollowUpReminder(followUp);
      } else if (followUp.id != null) {
        NotificationService.to.cancelFollowUpReminder(followUp.id!);
      }
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<int> updateFollowUpStatus(int id, String status) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    int? petId;
    try {
      final rows = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, columns: ['pet_id'], where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
      if (rows.isNotEmpty) petId = rows.first['pet_id'] as int?;
    } catch (_) {}
    final res = await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
      {'status': status},
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    if (status != 'pending' && Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      NotificationService.to.cancelFollowUpReminder(id);
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<int> markReminderSent(int id) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    int? petId;
    try {
      final rows = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, columns: ['pet_id'], where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
      if (rows.isNotEmpty) petId = rows.first['pet_id'] as int?;
    } catch (_) {}
    final res = await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
      {'reminder_sent': 1},
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    return res;
  }

  Future<int> deleteFollowUp(int id) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    int? petId;
    try {
      final rows = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, columns: ['pet_id'], where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
      if (rows.isNotEmpty) petId = rows.first['pet_id'] as int?;
    } catch (_) {}
    final res = await db.delete(
      DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    if (Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      NotificationService.to.cancelFollowUpReminder(id);
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<int> getPendingTodayCount() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final today = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    final res = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps} WHERE scheduled_date = ? AND status = "pending"',
      [today],
    );
    return res.first['cnt'] as int? ?? 0;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getPendingFollowUpsForAlerts() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        f.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        o.full_name AS owner_name, 
        o.phone_primary AS owner_phone
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps} f
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON f.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      WHERE f.status = 'pending'
    ''';
    return await db.rawQuery(sql);
  }

  Future<FollowUpModel?> getFollowUpById(int id) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        f.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        o.full_name AS owner_name,
        o.phone_primary AS owner_phone
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps} f
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON f.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      WHERE f.id = ?
      LIMIT 1
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql, [id]);
    if (res.isNotEmpty) {
      return FollowUpModel.fromMap(res.first);
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> completeFollowUpWithTreatment({
    required FollowUpModel followUp,
    required String clinicalNotes,
    List<PrescriptionModel> administeredTreatments = const [],
    double followUpCost = 0.0,
    double paidAmount = 0.0,
    double remainingAmount = 0.0,
    String paymentMethod = 'نقدا',
    FollowUpModel? nextFollowUp,
  }) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      // 1. Update FollowUpModel status to completed and append clinical notes & treatment summary
      final updatedNotesBuffer = StringBuffer();
      if (followUp.notes != null && followUp.notes!.isNotEmpty) {
        updatedNotesBuffer.writeln(followUp.notes);
      }
      if (clinicalNotes.isNotEmpty) {
        updatedNotesBuffer.writeln('[ملاحظات المراجعة السريرية]: $clinicalNotes');
      }
      if (administeredTreatments.isNotEmpty) {
        final medSummary = administeredTreatments
            .map((t) => '${t.displayName} (${t.dosage} - ${t.route ?? "حقن/موضعي"} - كمية: ${t.quantityDispensed})')
            .join('، ');
        updatedNotesBuffer.writeln('[العلاجات والحقن المصروفة بالعيادة]: $medSummary');
      }

      await txn.update(
        DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
        {
          'status': 'completed',
          'notes': updatedNotesBuffer.toString().trim(),
        },
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [followUp.id],
      );

      // 2. Automatically deduct quantityDispensed from clinic_stock in tableMedicines
      for (final treatment in administeredTreatments) {
        if (treatment.medicineId != null && treatment.medicineId! > 0) {
          await txn.rawUpdate('''
            UPDATE ${DatabaseTables.tableMedicines}
            SET clinic_stock = MAX(0, clinic_stock - ?)
            WHERE id = ?
          ''', [treatment.quantityDispensed, treatment.medicineId]);
        }
      }

      // 3. Financial transaction & payment recording
      if (followUpCost > 0) {
        int? ownerId;
        final petRows = await txn.query(
          DatabaseTables.tablePets,
          columns: ['owner_id'],
          where: 'id = ?',
          whereArgs: [followUp.petId],
        );
        if (petRows.isNotEmpty) {
          ownerId = petRows.first['owner_id'] as int?;
        }

        final txId = await txn.insert(
          DatabaseTables.tableTransactions,
          {
            'transaction_type': 'income',
            'category': 'consultation',
            'owner_id': ownerId,
            'pet_id': followUp.petId,
            'reference_id': followUp.id,
            'reference_type': 'follow_up',
            'amount': followUpCost,
            'paid_amount': paidAmount,
            'remaining_amount': remainingAmount,
            'payment_method': paymentMethod,
            'transaction_date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
            'notes': 'مراجعة سريرية: ${followUp.reason}',
          },
        );

        if (paidAmount > 0) {
          await txn.insert(
            DatabaseTables.tableCustomerPayments,
            {
              'owner_id': ownerId,
              'transaction_id': txId,
              'amount': paidAmount,
              'payment_method': paymentMethod,
              'payment_date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
              'receipt_number': 'REC-FU-${followUp.id}-1',
              'notes': 'سداد مراجعة سريرية: ${followUp.reason}',
            },
          );
        }
      }

      // 4. Insert optional next follow-up appointment
      if (nextFollowUp != null) {
        final nextId = await txn.insert(
          DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
          nextFollowUp.toMap(),
        );
        if (Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
          NotificationService.to.scheduleFollowUpReminder(nextFollowUp.copyWith(id: nextId));
        }
      }
    });

    // 5. Cancel OS notification reminder for completed follow-up
    if (followUp.id != null && Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      NotificationService.to.cancelFollowUpReminder(followUp.id!);
    }

    // 6. Notify DataSyncService
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: followUp.petId);
    if (administeredTreatments.isNotEmpty) {
      DataSyncService.notifyInventoryChanged();
    }
    if (followUpCost > 0) {
      DataSyncService.notifyFinancialChanged();
    }
  }

  Future<int> markFollowUpMissed(int id, {String? missedNote}) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final rows = await db.query(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
    int? petId;
    String existingNotes = '';
    if (rows.isNotEmpty) {
      petId = rows.first['pet_id'] as int?;
      existingNotes = (rows.first['notes'] as String?) ?? '';
    }
    final todayStr = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    final noteToAdd = missedNote ?? 'تغيب عن الحضور في $todayStr';
    final newNotes = existingNotes.isEmpty ? '[لم يحضر الموعد]: $noteToAdd' : '$existingNotes\n[لم يحضر الموعد]: $noteToAdd';

    final res = await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
      {
        'status': 'missed',
        'notes': newNotes,
      },
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: petId);
    if (Get.isRegistered<NotificationService>()) {
      NotificationService.to.cancelFollowUpReminder(id);
    }
    return res;
  }

  Future<List<int>> resumeFollowUpSchedule({
    required FollowUpModel missedFollowUp,
    required String newStartDate,
    required String scheduledTime,
    required int newDaysCount,
  }) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final newIds = await db.transaction((txn) async {
      // 1. Update the missed follow-up notes to record resumption
      final existingNotes = missedFollowUp.notes ?? '';
      final updatedNotes = existingNotes.isEmpty
          ? '[تم استئناف الجدولة بتاريخ $newStartDate]'
          : '$existingNotes\n[تم استئناف الجدولة بتاريخ $newStartDate]';
      await txn.update(
        DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps,
        {'notes': updatedNotes},
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [missedFollowUp.id],
      );

      // 2. Generate new consecutive follow-up records
      final startDate = DateTime.tryParse(newStartDate) ?? DateTime.now();
      final List<int> ids = [];
      for (int i = 0; i < newDaysCount; i++) {
        final date = startDate.add(Duration(days: i)).toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
        final sessionLabel = newDaysCount > 1
            ? ' (استئناف الجلسات - اليوم ${i + 1} من $newDaysCount)'
            : ' (استئناف الموعد)';
        final newFollowUp = FollowUpModel(
          petId: missedFollowUp.petId,
          consultationId: missedFollowUp.consultationId,
          scheduledDate: date,
          scheduledTime: scheduledTime,
          reason: '${missedFollowUp.reason}$sessionLabel',
          status: 'pending',
          notes: 'تمت إعادة الجدولة بعد تغيب موعد سابق',
        );
        final id = await txn.insert(DatabaseTables.tableFollowUps, newFollowUp.toMap());
        ids.add(id);
      }
      return ids;
    });

    DataSyncService.notifyFollowUpChanged(petId: missedFollowUp.petId);
    return newIds;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getFollowUpFinancialSummary(int followUpId) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final rows = await db.query(
      DatabaseTables.tableTransactions,
      where: 'reference_type = ? AND reference_id = ?',
      whereArgs: ['follow_up', followUpId],
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.isNotEmpty) {
      final tx = rows.first;
      return {
        'totalCost': (tx['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
        'paidAmount': (tx['paid_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
        'remainingAmount': (tx['remaining_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
        'paymentMethod': (tx['payment_method'] as String?) ?? 'نقدا',
      };
    }
    return null;
  }
}

<file path="lib/data/repositories/consultation_repository.dart">
import '../../core/services/data_sync_service.dart';
import '../database/database_helper.dart';
import '../database/database_tables.dart';
import '../models/consultation_model.dart';
import '../models/prescription_model.dart';

class ConsultationRepository {
  final DatabaseHelper _dbHelper = DatabaseHelper.instance;

  Future<List<ConsultationModel>> getAllConsultations() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        c.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        p.owner_id AS owner_id,
        u.full_name AS doctor_name,
        o.full_name AS owner_name
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} c
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON c.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableUsers} u ON c.doctor_id = u.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      ORDER BY c.visit_date DESC, c.id DESC
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql);
    
    List<ConsultationModel> list = [];
    for (final row in res) {
      final id = row['id'] as int;
      final prescriptions = await getPrescriptionsForConsultation(id);
      list.add(ConsultationModel.fromMap(row, prescriptions: prescriptions));
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<List<ConsultationModel>> getConsultationsForPet(int petId) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        c.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        p.owner_id AS owner_id,
        u.full_name AS doctor_name,
        o.full_name AS owner_name
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} c
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON c.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableUsers} u ON c.doctor_id = u.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      WHERE c.pet_id = ?
      ORDER BY c.visit_date DESC, c.id DESC
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql, [petId]);

    List<ConsultationModel> list = [];
    for (final row in res) {
      final id = row['id'] as int;
      final prescriptions = await getPrescriptionsForConsultation(id);
      list.add(ConsultationModel.fromMap(row, prescriptions: prescriptions));
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<ConsultationModel?> getConsultationById(int id) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final sql = '''
      SELECT 
        c.*, 
        p.name AS pet_name, 
        p.species AS pet_species,
        p.owner_id AS owner_id,
        u.full_name AS doctor_name,
        o.full_name AS owner_name
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} c
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tablePets} p ON c.pet_id = p.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableUsers} u ON c.doctor_id = u.id
      INNER JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableOwners} o ON p.owner_id = o.id
      WHERE c.id = ?
      LIMIT 1
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql, [id]);
    if (res.isNotEmpty) {
      final prescriptions = await getPrescriptionsForConsultation(id);
      return ConsultationModel.fromMap(res.first, prescriptions: prescriptions);
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<List<PrescriptionModel>> getPrescriptionsForConsultation(int consultationId) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    const sql = '''
      SELECT 
        pr.*, 
        COALESCE(m.trade_name, pr.custom_name) AS medicine_name, 
        m.form AS medicine_form, 
        m.concentration AS medicine_concentration
      FROM ${DatabaseTables.tablePrescriptions} pr
      LEFT JOIN ${DatabaseTables.tableMedicines} m ON pr.medicine_id = m.id
      WHERE pr.consultation_id = ?
    ''';
    final res = await db.rawQuery(sql, [consultationId]);
    return res.map((m) => PrescriptionModel.fromMap(m)).toList();
  }

  /// Create consultation and its prescriptions within a single atomic transaction
  /// Deducts shelf stock ONLY for clinic-administered treatments with valid pharmacy medicine_id
  Future<int> createConsultationWithPrescriptions({
    required ConsultationModel consultation,
    required List<PrescriptionModel> prescriptions,
  }) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final resultId = await db.transaction((txn) async {
      // 1. Insert consultation
      final consultationId = await txn.insert(
        DatabaseTables.tableConsultations,
        consultation.toMap(),
      );

      // 2. Insert prescriptions & auto-deduct shelf stock if clinic administered
      for (final rx in prescriptions) {
        final rxMap = rx.copyWith(consultationId: consultationId).toMap();
        await txn.insert(DatabaseTables.tablePrescriptions, rxMap);

        // Deduct clinic shelf stock ONLY for in-clinic administered medications
        if (rx.isClinicAdministered && rx.medicineId != null && rx.medicineId! > 0) {
          final medRows = await txn.query(
            DatabaseTables.tableMedicines,
            where: 'id = ?',
            whereArgs: [rx.medicineId],
            limit: 1,
          );

          if (medRows.isNotEmpty) {
            final currentStock = medRows.first['clinic_stock'] as int? ?? 0;
            final updatedStock = (currentStock - rx.quantityDispensed).clamp(0, 999999);
            await txn.update(
              DatabaseTables.tableMedicines,
              {'clinic_stock': updatedStock},
              where: 'id = ?',
              whereArgs: [rx.medicineId],
            );
          }
        }
      }

      // 3. Automatically record income transaction in financial module
      if (consultation.visitCost > 0) {
        final petRows = await txn.query(
          DatabaseTables.tablePets,
          columns: ['owner_id'],
          where: 'id = ?',
          whereArgs: [consultation.petId],
          limit: 1,
        );
        final ownerId = petRows.isNotEmpty ? petRows.first['owner_id'] as int? : null;
        final paid = consultation.paidAmount;
        final remaining = (consultation.visitCost - paid).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);

        await txn.insert(DatabaseTables.tableTransactions, {
          'transaction_type': 'income',
          'category': 'consultation',
          'owner_id': ownerId,
          'pet_id': consultation.petId,
          'reference_id': consultationId,
          'reference_type': 'consultation',
          'amount': consultation.visitCost,
          'paid_amount': paid,
          'remaining_amount': remaining,
          'payment_method': consultation.paymentMethod,
          'transaction_date': consultation.visitDate,
          'notes': 'أتعاب كشف واستشارة سريرية: ${consultation.diagnosis}${remaining > 0 ? ' (متبقي آجل: ${remaining.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي)' : ' (خالص ومسدد بالكامل)'}',
        });
      }

      return consultationId;
    });
    DataSyncService.notifyConsultationChanged(petId: consultation.petId);
    return resultId;
  }

  Future<int> updateConsultation(ConsultationModel consultation) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final res = await db.update(
      DatabaseTables.tableConsultations,
      consultation.toMap(),
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [consultation.id],
    );
    DataSyncService.notifyConsultationChanged(petId: consultation.petId);
    return res;
  }

  Future<void> deleteConsultation(int consultationId) async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    int? petId;
    try {
      final rows = await db.query(
        DatabaseTables.tableConsultations,
        columns: ['pet_id'],
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [consultationId],
      );
      if (rows.isNotEmpty) petId = rows.first['pet_id'] as int?;
    } catch (_) {}

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      // 1. Find clinic-administered prescriptions to restore shelf stock
      final rxList = await txn.query(
        DatabaseTables.tablePrescriptions,
        where: 'consultation_id = ?',
        whereArgs: [consultationId],
      );

      for (final rx in rxList) {
        final isClinicAdministered = (rx['is_clinic_administered'] as int? ?? 0) == 1;
        final medId = rx['medicine_id'] as int?;
        final qty = rx['quantity_dispensed'] as int? ?? 0;

        if (isClinicAdministered && medId != null && medId > 0 && qty > 0) {
          final medRows = await txn.query(
            DatabaseTables.tableMedicines,
            where: 'id = ?',
            whereArgs: [medId],
            limit: 1,
          );
          if (medRows.isNotEmpty) {
            final currentStock = medRows.first['clinic_stock'] as int? ?? 0;
            await txn.update(
              DatabaseTables.tableMedicines,
              {'clinic_stock': currentStock + qty},
              where: 'id = ?',
              whereArgs: [medId],
            );
          }
        }
      }

      // 2. Delete consultation (cascades to prescriptions)
      await txn.delete(
        DatabaseTables.tableConsultations,
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [consultationId],
      );
    });

    DataSyncService.notifyConsultationChanged(petId: petId);
  }

  Future<int> getTodayConsultationsCount() async {
    final db = await _dbHelper.database;
    final today = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    final res = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ${DatabaseTables.tableConsultations} WHERE visit_date LIKE ?',
      ['$today%'],
    );
    return res.first['cnt'] as int? ?? 0;
  }
}

  Widget _buildFinancialInfoTile({
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required Color color,
    required Color bgColor,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bgColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            title,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              color: color,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            value,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              color: color,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildVitalCard({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required Color color,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 20, color: color),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            title,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              color: AppColors.textSecondary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            child: Text(
              value,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 13,
                color: color,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              maxLines: 1,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSoapBlock({
    required String letter,
    required String letterTitle,
    required String content,
    required Color color,
    required Color bgColor,
    bool isBold = false,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bgColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              CircleAvatar(
                radius: 11,
                backgroundColor: color,
                child: Text(
                  letter,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  letterTitle,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 13,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            content,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              color: isBold ? color : AppColors.textPrimary,
              fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
              height: 1.4,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailTableHeader(String text) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 6),
      child: Text(
        text,
        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          fontSize: 11,
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailTableCell(String text, {bool isBold = false}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 6),

        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
          fontSize: 11,
          color: AppColors.textPrimary,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

        // Remaining / Balance Due
        Expanded(

            title: s.hasDebt ? 'المتبقي والآجل' : 'حالة الحساب',

                : 'مسدد بالكامل',
            color: s.hasDebt ? Colors.amber.shade900 : AppColors.primary,

        ),

  Widget _buildDateFilterBar(
    BuildContext context,
    OwnerStatementController controller,
  ) {
    final start = controller.startDate.value;
    final end = controller.endDate.value;
    final isFiltered = start != null && end != null;

    final filterText = isFiltered
        ? 'الفترة: ${DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(start)} إلى ${DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(end)}'
        : 'كافة الحركات المالية (انقر لتحديد فترة زمنية)';

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isFiltered ? AppColors.secondaryLight : Colors.grey.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isFiltered ? AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.4) : Colors.grey.shade300,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            Icons.date_range,
            size: 20,
            color: isFiltered ? AppColors.primary : AppColors.textSecondary,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () async {
                final picked = await showDateRangePicker(
                  context: context,
                  firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                  lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365)),
                  initialDateRange: isFiltered
                      ? DateTimeRange(start: start, end: end)
                      : DateTimeRange(
                          start: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 30)),
                          end: DateTime.now(),
                        ),
                );
                if (picked != null) {
                  controller.setDateRange(picked.start, picked.end);
                }
              },
              child: Text(
                filterText,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: isFiltered ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isFiltered ? AppColors.primaryDark : AppColors.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (isFiltered)
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18, color: AppColors.critical),
              tooltip: 'إلغاء التصفية',
              onPressed: controller.clearDateRange,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMetricCard({
    required String title,
    required String amount,
    required Color color,
    required Color bgColor,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return Container(

        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
      ),
      child: Column(

          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            amount,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: color),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(
            title,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.85)),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatementTable(BuildContext context, OwnerAccountSummary s) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        child: DataTable(
          headingRowColor: WidgetStateProperty.all(AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08)),
          columns: const [
            DataColumn(label: Text('التاريخ', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
            DataColumn(label: Text('البيان / تفاصيل الحركة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
            DataColumn(label: Text('المريض', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
            DataColumn(label: Text('المطلوب (مدين)', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
            DataColumn(label: Text('المسدد (دائن)', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
            DataColumn(label: Text('الرصيد التراكمي', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
          ],
          rows: s.statementItems.map((item) {
            return DataRow(
              cells: [
                DataCell(Text(item.date, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DataCell(
                  ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 240),
                    child: Text(
                      item.description,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                DataCell(Text(item.petName ?? '-', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12))),
                DataCell(Text(
                  item.debit > 0 ? '${item.debit.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي' : '-',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: item.debit > 0 ? Colors.blue.shade900 : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                )),
                DataCell(Text(
                  item.credit > 0 ? '${item.credit.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي' : '-',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: item.credit > 0 ? Colors.green.shade800 : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                )),
                DataCell(
                  Text(
                    '${item.balance.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: item.balance > 0.001 ? Colors.amber.shade900 : AppColors.success,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPaymentLedgerList(BuildContext context, OwnerAccountSummary s) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      child: ListView.separated(
        shrinkWrap: true,
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        itemCount: s.paymentLedger.length,
        separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const Divider(height: 1),
        itemBuilder: (context, idx) {
          final p = s.paymentLedger[idx];
          return ListTile(
            leading: CircleAvatar(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.success.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
              child: const Icon(Icons.receipt_long, color: AppColors.success, size: 20),
            ),
            title: Row(
              children: [
                Text(
                  p.receiptNumber ?? '#${p.id}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 13),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: AppColors.secondaryLight,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    p.paymentMethodDisplayArabic,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: AppColors.primaryDark),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            subtitle: Text(
              'التاريخ: ${p.paymentDate.length >= 10 ? p.paymentDate.substring(0, 10) : p.paymentDate}${p.notes != null && p.notes!.isNotEmpty ? ' | ${p.notes}' : ''}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.textSecondary),
            ),
            trailing: Text(
              '${p.amount.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 14,
                color: AppColors.success,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openPdfPreview(
    BuildContext context,
    OwnerStatementController controller,
    OwnerAccountSummary s,
  ) {
    Get.to(() => Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text('كشف حساب PDF: ${s.ownerName}'),
            actions: [
              IconButton(
                tooltip: 'مشاركة PDF',
                icon: const Icon(Icons.share),
                onPressed: () => FinancialStatementPdfHelper.shareStatementPdf(
                  summary: s,
                  clinic: controller.clinic,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          body: PdfPreview(
            build: (format) => FinancialStatementPdfHelper.generateStatementPdf(
              summary: s,
              clinic: controller.clinic,
            ),
            pdfFileName: 'account_statement_${s.ownerName}_${s.ownerId}.pdf',
            canChangeOrientation: false,
            canChangePageFormat: false,
          ),
        ));
  }

  void _showAddPaymentDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    OwnerStatementController controller,
  ) {
    final amountController = TextEditingController();
    final notesController = TextEditingController();
    String paymentMethod = AppPaymentMethods.cash;

    Get.dialog(
      AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.receipt_long, color: AppColors.success),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text('سند قبض لحساب: ${controller.summary.value?.ownerName ?? ""}'),
          ],
        ),
        content: StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setState) {
            return Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                TextField(
                  controller: amountController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'المبلغ المسدد (ر.ي) *',
                    hintText: 'مثال: 5000',
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.money),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  isExpanded: true,
                  initialValue: paymentMethod,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'طريقة التحصيل *',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: AppPaymentMethods.fixedOptions.map((opt) {
                    IconData icon;
                    switch (opt) {
                      case AppPaymentMethods.jawali:
                      case AppPaymentMethods.jeeb:
                      case AppPaymentMethods.floosak:
                        icon = Icons.phone_android;
                        break;
                      case AppPaymentMethods.kuraimi:
                        icon = Icons.account_balance;
                        break;
                      case AppPaymentMethods.cash:
                      default:
                        icon = Icons.payments_outlined;
                        break;
                    }
                    return DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                      value: opt,
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(icon, size: 20, color: AppColors.primary),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(opt, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                  onChanged: (val) {
                    if (val != null) {
                      setState(() => paymentMethod = val);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: notesController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'ملاحظات السند (اختياري)',
                    hintText: 'سداد دفعة من الحساب الآجل...',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Get.back(),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.success,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
            onPressed: () {
              final amt = double.tryParse(amountController.text.trim()) ?? 0.0;
              if (amt <= 0) {
                Get.snackbar('خطأ', 'يرجى إدخال مبلغ صحيح');
                return;
              }
              Get.back();
              controller.recordPayment(
                amt,
                paymentMethod,
                notesController.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : notesController.text.trim(),
              );
            },
            child: const Text('حفظ سند القبض'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class OwnersListView extends GetView<OwnersListController> {
  const OwnersListView({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

                      icon: Icons.people_alt_rounded,

                      count: '${controller.owners.length}',
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                      bgColor: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),

                      bgColor: const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                    ),
                  ],
                )),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Modern Search Bar
                Container(

                    onChanged: controller.onSearch,

                      hintText: 'ابحث باسم المربي، رقم هاتفه أو عنوانه...',
                      hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.grey.shade500),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: AppColors.primary),
                      suffixIcon: Obx(() {
                        if (controller.filteredOwners.length != controller.owners.length ||
                            controller.searchController.text.isNotEmpty) {
                          return IconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_rounded, size: 20, color: Colors.grey),
                            onPressed: controller.clearSearch,
                          );
                        }
                        return const SizedBox.shrink();
                      }),
                      border: InputBorder.none,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 13),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // Main Owners List
          Expanded(
            child: Obx(() {
              if (controller.isLoading.value) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }

              if (controller.filteredOwners.isEmpty) {
                return EmptyStateView(
                  icon: Icons.people_outline_rounded,
                  title: 'لا يوجد مربين مسجلين',
                  subtitle: controller.searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                      ? 'لا توجد نتائج تطابق بحثك الحالي'
                      : 'يتم إضافة المربين تلقائياً عند تسجيل مريض جديد',
                  actionText: controller.searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                      ? 'إلغاء التصفية'
                      : null,
                  onAction: controller.searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                      ? () => controller.clearSearch()
                      : null,
                );
              }

              return ListView.separated(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 80),
                itemCount: controller.filteredOwners.length,
                separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  final row = controller.filteredOwners[index];
                  final owner = OwnerModel.fromMap(row);
                  final petsCount = row['pets_count'] as int? ?? 0;

                  return _buildOwnerCard(context, controller, owner, petsCount);
                },
              );
            }),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatPill({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required String count,
    required Color color,
    required Color bgColor,
  }) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: bgColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(icon, size: 16, color: color),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text(
              '$label: ',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade700, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
            Text(
              count,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: color),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
